raw.excerpt: Latitude AI () is building the future of Ford’s autonomy roadmap to make travel safer, less stressful, and more enjoyable for everyone.
raw.description:
Latitude AI () is building the future of Ford’s autonomy roadmap to make travel safer, less stressful, and more enjoyable for everyone. Bringing this vision to scale, our fully in-house developed hands-free ADAS platform will debut on the all-new Ford Fathom in 2027.

When you join the Latitude team, you’ll work alongside leading experts across machine learning and robotics, cloud platforms, mapping, sensors and compute systems, test operations, systems and safety engineering – all dedicated to redefining the relationship between people and their vehicles for millions of customers.

As a Ford Motor Company subsidiary, we operate independently to develop automated driving technology at the speed of a technology startup. Latitude is headquartered in Pittsburgh with engineering centers in Dearborn, Mich., and Palo Alto, Calif.

Meet the team:

The Virtual Test Ecosystem (VTE) team ensures that our simulation (fully synthetic) and resimulation (replay engine using vehicle logs) workflows run efficiently and reliably at large scale. We use a mix of open source and cloud provider services to implement a processing framework that’s cloud-agnostic as well as capable of running on-prem. The results of these simulations is business-critical for us - they’re used in order to allow autonomy developers and testers to do large-scale safety and performance testing of changes prior to in-vehicle testing. We interact with engineers throughout the onboard and offboard stack in order to ensure smooth end-to-end capabilities.

What you’ll do:

  • We run vehicle simulations at unprecedented scales in order to ensure we’re releasing a safe product. You’ll support this via improvements to our sim/resim cloud framework and applications that run on this framework. In terms of implementation, this involves a lot of Python coding, interacting with open source packages and various AWS/GCP services. In terms of analysis, we’re constantly looking for bottlenecks that limit scalability or otherwise hinder performance. You’ll put together benchmarking to identify these spots and associated dashboards to track and summarize the information. Then armed with that information, you’ll implement solutions to increase efficiency.
  • It’s not enough to have a framework that is functional - it needs to be intuitive and easy to use. We take our best guesses at this, but things evolve over time based on user interaction - both direct feedback as well as realizing how users are accidentally misusing or misinterpreting the results. VTE supports autonomy, systems, test, and a variety of other teams across the organization. Having an eye for how the system is being used, what users need, and a willingness to engage with these users on future improvements is critical.
  • We also can’t build it all, so we want to make the framework well-documented and as self-serve as possible for others to extend it (while being there to answer questions). For example, when there’s a new portion of the autonomy stack, we want that autonomy team to be able to update resim to add it in themselves so that they can iterate quickly.
  • In order to run logs through resim, we need to first know what logs are interesting. You’ll contribute to the ecosystem of how we manage storing and searching for these logs efficiently, including how we automate indexing the interesting actors and interactions in a scene and how we determine our dataset coverage.
  • Once we’ve run resim, we want to do something with the updated logs. Frequently this involves metrics to analyze the AV’s performance; these metrics could range from low-level performance of a particular detector in the stack to if the AV is meeting high-level business objectives. You’ll both work on the sim/resim cloud framework implementation to make this easy for all developers to add in their metrics and support the metrics implementation themselves as needs arise.

What you'll need to succeed:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics or a related field and 4+ years of relevant experience (or Master's degree and 2+ years of relevant experience, or PhD)
  • Expertise in writing Python code that’s efficient, well-documented, and well-tested
  • 2+ years’ experience writing scalable applications that execute in a cloud or HPC environment
  • 2+ years’ experience writing software that interacts with AWS and/or GCP services
  • Familiarity with NumPy and scientific programming
  • Willingness and desire to learn how onboard and offboard components interact with each other and propose solutions to improve how developers and testers work with both systems

Nice to have (optional):

  • C++ development experience
  • Experience with Kubernetes

What we offer you:

  • Competitive compensation packages
  • High-quality individual and family medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Health savings account with available employer match
  • Employer-matched 401(k) retirement plan with immediate vesting
  • Employer-paid group term life insurance and the option to elect voluntary life insurance
  • Paid parental leave and Adoption/Surrogacy support program
  • Paid medical leave
  • Unlimited vacation and 15 paid holidays
  • Daily lunches, snacks, and beverages available in all office locations
  • Pre-tax spending accounts for healthcare and dependent care expenses
  • Pre-tax commuter benefits
  • Monthly wellness stipend
  • Backup child and elder care program
  • Professional development reimbursement
  • Employee assistance program
  • Discounted programs that include legal services, identity theft protection, pet insurance, and more
  • Company and team bonding outlets: employee resource groups, quarterly team activity stipend, and wellness initiatives

Learn more about Latitude’s team, mission and career opportunities at !

The expected base salary range for this full-time position in California is $150,320 - $225,480 USD. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Latitude employees are also eligible to participate in Latitude’s annual bonus programs, equity compensation, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.

Candidates for positions with Latitude AI must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is available for this position.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a culturally diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status or protected veteran status.

raw.excerpt: Who Are Massive Rocket? Massive Rocket is a rapidly scaling Braze and Snowflake agency on a mission to transform how digital marketing, product, and engineering teams connect.
raw.description:
Who Are Massive Rocket?

Massive Rocket is a rapidly scaling Braze and Snowflake agency on a mission to transform how digital marketing, product, and engineering teams connect. In just five years, we’ve grown at speed and are now gearing up for our next big milestone: hitting $100M in revenue. We build human experiences at scale, powered by cutting‑edge web, mobile, cloud, data, and AI technologies. If you’re excited by innovation, love solving complex challenges, and want to help shape the future of digital experiences, you’ll feel right at home here.
Every role at Massive Rocket is entrepreneurial. The people who thrive here don’t just focus on their own remit — they understand the goals of the teams around them and actively contribute to the success of their colleagues, customers, and partners. We’re building a culture of ownership, collaboration, and growth, and we’re looking for people who want to make a real impact.

Who Are We Looking to Add to Our Team?

We’re looking for an experienced Technical Lead to lead the engineering delivery of MarTech platforms, data pipelines, and customer engagement integrations. You’ll work closely with Product Owners, Agile Delivery Managers, Data Architects, and cross-functional teams to turn business requirements into reliable, scalable technical solutions.

You’ll provide hands-on technical leadership within an established architecture, guide engineering standards, oversee implementation quality, and mentor engineers. The role combines strong expertise in mParticle, Braze, and Databricks with a focus on platform reliability, data governance, and continuous improvement.

What Will You Do?

  • Translate approved technical designs into implementation plans, sprint-ready tasks, and clear technical acceptance criteria.
  • Lead the development and delivery of MarTech data pipelines, integrations, and customer engagement solutions across mParticle, Braze, and Databricks.
  • Build and optimise batch and streaming data pipelines, APIs, webhooks, event schemas, and data models.
  • Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, security, observability, and cost efficiency.
  • Establish and maintain engineering standards across code quality, peer reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, release management, and rollback processes.
  • Guide the implementation of mParticle and Braze capabilities, including SDK instrumentation, identity resolution, event tracking, audiences, Liquid personalisation, and Connected Content.
  • Work with Product Owners and Agile Delivery Managers on feasibility, estimates, technical priorities, dependencies, and delivery risks.
  • Set up monitoring, alerting, and data-quality checks to track pipeline performance, integrations, and customer engagement data flows.
  • Lead incident response and root cause analysis, ensuring issues are resolved and preventive measures are implemented.
  • Ensure integrations follow data privacy, consent, security, and governance requirements, including GDPR and relevant data protection policies.
  • Coach and mentor engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, knowledge sharing, and onboarding.
  • Identify opportunities to use GenAI and automation to improve engineering productivity while following security and governance standards.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or MarTech, including technical leadership and mentoring engineers.
  • Hands-on experience delivering production solutions using mParticle, Braze, and Databricks.
  • Strong understanding of MarTech ecosystems, customer engagement platforms, event tracking, identity resolution, and customer data models.
  • Experience building and optimising batch and streaming data pipelines using SQL, Python, PySpark, and Delta Lake.
  • Familiarity with dbt for data transformations and orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect.
  • Experience designing and delivering secure, resilient API, webhook, and event-driven integrations.
  • Strong understanding of engineering practices, including version control, CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews, and release management.
  • Experience with monitoring, alerting, troubleshooting, and improving reliability across distributed data systems.
  • Knowledge of data privacy, consent management, GDPR, and data governance requirements.
  • Ability to translate business and marketing requirements into technical solutions and communicate trade-offs clearly.
  • Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to influence Product, Marketing, CRM, Data, InfoSec, and external vendors.
  • A pragmatic approach to technical leadership, balancing delivery speed with engineering quality and architectural standards.

Desirable

  • Experience with AWS services, Splunk, and CloudWatch for monitoring and operational support.
  • Familiarity with Braze Canvas, API-triggered messaging, Liquid personalisation, and Braze Currents.
  • Experience with mParticle Live Stream, connection rules, data filters, and event forwarding policies.
  • Knowledge of data reconciliation, consent synchronisation, data retention, and data subject request processes.
  • Experience working with Agile delivery teams and contributing to engineering guilds or technical communities.
  • Practical experience using GenAI tools for code generation, data modelling, documentation, and engineering workflows.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

• Rocket‑Fuelled Growth – Big challenges, fast learning, and the chance to level up quicker than anywhere else
• A Culture That Actually Gives a Damn – Supportive, positive, and built around people who want to see you win
• A Global Crew – Collaborate with brilliant teammates across Europe, the US, and beyond
• Remote‑First for Life – Work from wherever you feel your best
• Real Career Momentum – Clear progression, real ownership, and space to grow into your next chapter
• Moments That Matter – Meetups, events, and team experiences that make the journey unforgettable

A Few Things to Know Before We Get Started

Bring Your Own Device – We operate a BYOD policy, so you’ll use your own kit for work
Right to Work – You’ll need a valid work visa; we’re not able to offer sponsorship at the moment
ID Checks – We may ask for proof of identity (passport, ID card, or a recent utility bill)
References – We may request two references, so have names, relationships, and contact details ready
For Contractors – Proof of incorporation and up‑to‑date insurance is required

A Quick Note on Applications

We receive a high volume of applications, and while we’d love to reply to everyone personally, it’s not always possible. If you haven’t heard from us within two weeks, it sadly means you haven’t been successful this time. But don’t let that stop you—we’re growing fast, and new opportunities open up all the time.

raw.title: Team Lead: Functional Consultants
raw.excerpt: Role SummaryThe FC Team Lead is the people leader and quality owner for the Functional Consultant team.
raw.description:
Role Summary

The FC Team Lead is the people leader and quality owner for the Functional Consultant team. This role must lead, manage, and hold accountable a team of FCs, set and enforce the standards for configuration and process design across engagements, and build a program for onboarding and developing junior-level talent.

The FC Team Lead serves as a direct supervisor for assigned FCs. The role owns clear direction, weekly 1:1s, goal setting, performance and HR reviews, development plans, and compensation input. It also owns each FC's route through the competency ladder and brings FCs to calibration with evidence.

The FC Team Lead does not own engagement delivery or client relationships. Engagement Leads and Project Management own those outcomes. This role owns the quality of FC work on engagements, the readiness of FCs for staffing, and the growth of each FC. The role provides skill-fit input at the weekly allocation forum but does not make final staffing decisions.

Primary Accountabilities

People Leadership: Leading, Managing, and Holding Accountable

Own the performance, engagement, and growth of every FC on the team.

  • Serve as direct supervisor for assigned FCs, providing clear direction on role expectations, priorities, and standards.
  • Conduct regular 1:1s with each direct report and document key commitments and follow-ups.
  • Set goals with each FC at the start of each cycle and track progress against them throughout the year.
  • Complete performance reviews and other HR reviews on schedule, with specific, evidence-based feedback.
  • Address performance gaps early, document expectations and outcomes, and partner with People Ops on formal performance management when required.
  • Monitor team engagement and morale, and serve as the first point of escalation for team concerns.
  • Create alignment and connection between Isos direction, Isos leadership, and direct reports.
  • Support recruiting through candidate review, interviewing, and structured evaluation feedback.

Functional Standards and Quality Assurance

Own the quality of configuration and process design across engagements where FCs are assigned.

  • Define, document, and maintain functional standards for configuration, process design, and solution documentation, in partnership with the Technical Solution Architect team
  • Conduct periodic QA reviews of FC work product on active engagements and track findings to resolution.
  • Provide actionable coaching to FCs based on QA findings, and use recurring findings to refine standards and training.
  • Identify quality trends and risks across engagements, and escalate them to leadership when appropriate.
  • Serve as a resource for complex functional design questions and client situations.
  • Partner with peer Team Leads to keep standards consistent across the organization.

Career Pathing

Own each FC's development and growth within the organization.

  • Develop a deep understanding of individual skills, strengths, and opportunities to align talent with business needs and create meaningful growth plans.
  • Maintain a current view of each FC's career path and readiness for the next level or role.
  • Build promotion cases supported by evidence, such as engagement outcomes, QA results, client and peer feedback, and demonstrated competencies.
  • Counsel FCs on career options, including depth in a functional specialty, expansion into other practices, and movement toward lead or leadership roles.
  • Partner with leadership to inform career development standards and expectations for consulting.

Engagement Staffing and Skills Input

Understand the skills, strengths, and development needs of the FC team to inform staffing on new engagements.

  • Attend staffing meetings and come prepared with current knowledge of each FC's skills, certifications, and capacity.
  • Recommend FCs for assignments based on skill fit, client need, and development goals.
  • Flag mismatches between demand and available skills early, and recommend options such as shadowing, pairing, or targeted training.
  • Advocate for stretch assignments that support an FC's development plan and promotion readiness, balanced against client and utilization needs.
  • Raise workload, burnout, and prolonged underutilization risks for FCs on the team.

Junior Talent Pipeline

Own the onboarding and development of entry-level talent to support organizational growth.

  • Own onboarding for new Junior FCs, including documented processes, clear expectations, required training, and a defined ramp plan.
  • Own the shadowing path, including selecting engagements and experienced FCs to shadow, defining objectives for each stage, and tracking progress.
  • Define the criteria that make a Junior FC billable, and coordinate with the Director of Consulting and Support Services when those criteria are met.
  • Provide frequent coaching and feedback during ramp-up, and adjust the plan when progress stalls.
  • Partner with Engagement Leads and senior FCs to give Juniors structured exposure to real client work.
  • Track time-to-billable for Junior FCs and use the results to improve the onboarding and shadowing program.

Requirements

Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in a consulting role
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or supervising consultants, whether formally or informally
  • Hands-on experience with configuration and process design in Jira and other Atlassian tools

Working Conditions and Additional Requirements

Work Environment

This role operates in a remote-first or hybrid work environment, depending on location and business needs. Regular collaboration occurs via video conferencing, shared systems, and digital communication tools.

Travel Expectations

Some travel is expected for internal meetings and onsite client needs.

Physical Requirements

This position requires prolonged periods of sitting, regular use of a computer and other office equipment, and participation in video meetings. Occasional lifting of light materials may be required during travel.

Remote Work Expectations

When working remotely, this role is expected to maintain a dedicated, professional workspace with reliable internet connectivity. Availability during core business hours and responsiveness are required.

Hours Expectations

This role generally follows standard business hours; however, flexibility is required to accommodate client and internal meetings across time zones and support business needs. Occasional early mornings, evenings, or extended hours may be necessary.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Ability to balance team development and wellbeing with billable utilization targets
  • Strong understanding of functional best practices and quality standards across client engagements
  • Ability to identify skill gaps and turn them into practical development and training plans
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with technical and business audiences
  • Ability to partner with Engagement Leads, Project Management, the PMO, and peer Team Leads
  • Ability to meet or exceed annual individual and team success metrics
  • Ability to work in alignment with the Isos culture and values

About Isos Technology

Isos Technology partners with organizations to streamline, optimize, and modernize the way they work. As an Atlassian Platinum Solution Partner, our solutions combine Atlassian technology, industry expertise, and operational best practices to drive impactful business outcomes for clients. Clients trust our experience in service management, cloud upgrades, enterprise strategy and planning, AI adoption, and support services to create lasting value. Founded in 2005, Isos has helped thousands of commercial and public sector clients transform how they work and unlock the full potential of their organization.

This position is primarily a work from home position and we consider applicants throughout the United States.

Isos Technology is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, color, age, physical or mental disability, spousal affiliation, marital status, a serious medical condition, genetic information, veteran status or any other basis prohibited by federal, state, or local law. Candidates must be willing to participate in and successfully pass a background check and pre-employment drug testing and be authorized to work in the United States. Isos Technology is also an E-Verify participating employer.

  • Build, automate and improve infrastructure provisioning and lifecycle management.
  • Plan and execute infrastructure maintenance with minimal customer impact.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across compute, networking, virtualisation and storage layers.

Unsere Abteilung wächst. Wir entwickeln Strukturen, optimieren Prozesse und verbinden hohe Servicequalität mit modernen Technologien. Dabei setzen wir auf klare Verantwortlichkeiten, kurze Entscheidungswege und Führungskräfte, die Veränderungen nicht nur begleiten, sondern aktiv gestalten.

Unser Anspruch: Quality First. Human Always. AI Enabled.

Als Team Lead Client Enablement & Care übernimmst du die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung eines Serviceteams mit perspektivisch 10 bis 12 Mitarbeitenden. Du berichtest direkt an den Director Client Enablement & Care und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Serviceorganisation maßgeblich mit.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Führung und Mitarbeiterentwicklung: Du übernimmst die fachliche und disziplinarische Verantwortung für dein Team. Mit klaren Erwartungen, regelmäßigem Feedback und individuellem Coaching förderst du Leistung, Eigenverantwortung und persönliche Entwicklung. Du schaffst ein Umfeld, in dem Menschen gerne Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam erfolgreich sind.

  • Operative Steuerung und Performance: Du verantwortest die qualitative und quantitative Leistung deines Teams. Anhand relevanter Kennzahlen wie Service Level, Erstlösungsquote, Qualitätsbewertungen und Zufriedenheit der Kundschaft erkennst du Entwicklungen frühzeitig, leitest Maßnahmen ab und stellst deren nachhaltige Umsetzung sicher.

  • Qualität und Wissensmanagement: Du etablierst ein gemeinsames Qualitätsverständnis und stellst sicher, dass dein Team fachlich und prozessual auf dem neuesten Stand bleibt. Gemeinsam mit unserem Quality Management entwickelst du wirksame Coaching-, Schulungs- und Feedbackformate.

  • Prozessoptimierung und Automatisierung: Du hinterfragst bestehende Abläufe, identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den relevanten Schnittstellen effiziente, skalierbare Lösungen. Dabei berücksichtigst du insbesondere die Zusammenarbeit mit der Baader Bank.

  • KI und digitale Weiterentwicklung: Du begleitest den Einsatz KI-gestützter Technologien und moderner Servicetools. Du erkennst sinnvolle Anwendungsmöglichkeiten, förderst die Akzeptanz im Team und stellst sicher, dass Technologie unsere Mitarbeitenden unterstützt, ohne die menschliche Verantwortung zu ersetzen.

  • Organisationsentwicklung und Zusammenarbeit: Du wirkst aktiv am weiteren Aufbau unserer Abteilung mit, beteiligst dich an bereichsübergreifenden Projekten und arbeitest eng mit Produktmanagement, IT, Compliance und weiteren internen sowie externen Schnittstellen zusammen.

  • Recruiting und Teamaufbau: Du begleitest die Auswahl und Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeitender und entwickelst eine leistungsfähige Teamstruktur, die sowohl unseren Qualitätsansprüchen als auch unserem Wachstum gerecht wird.

  • Du kannst Menschen führen und entwickeln. Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der fachlichen und disziplinarischen Führung von Service- oder Customer-Care-Teams mit. Du setzt klare Erwartungen, triffst Entscheidungen und verstehst es, unterschiedliche Persönlichkeiten zu motivieren und weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Du kennst die Finanzwelt. Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse im Banking- oder Brokerage-Umfeld, idealerweise aus dem Service eines Online-Brokers. Wertpapierprodukte, Handelsprozesse und die Bedürfnisse privater Anlegerinnen und Anleger sind dir vertraut.

  • Du verstehst regulatorische Anforderungen. Du bist mit den grundlegenden Anforderungen an Kundenkommunikation und Beschwerdemanagement in einem regulierten Finanzumfeld vertraut. Kenntnisse der relevanten Vorgaben aus WpHG und MiFID II sowie eine entsprechende Sachkunde sind von Vorteil.

  • Du denkst analytisch und handelst lösungsorientiert. Du steuerst anhand relevanter Kennzahlen, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und übersetzt Erkenntnisse in konkrete Maßnahmen. Erfahrung mit Ticketsystemen, idealerweise Zendesk, und der Personaleinsatzplanung ist wünschenswert.

  • Du gestaltest Veränderung. Du hast Freude daran, bestehende Strukturen weiterzuentwickeln und neue aufzubauen. Du begegnest Automatisierung und künstlicher Intelligenz mit Neugier, Pragmatismus und einem klaren Blick für ihren tatsächlichen Mehrwert.

  • Du kommunizierst klar und verbindlich. Du gibst Orientierung, sprichst auch schwierige Themen offen an und arbeitest konstruktiv mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern zusammen. Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse.

Bei uns triffst Du auf ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit über 250 Kolleg:innen, das von Vertrauen, Flexibilität und echter Zusammenarbeit geprägt ist, ergänzt durch bis zu 15 Tage Workation innerhalb der EU pro Kalenderjahr.

Deine persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung fördern wir aktiv durch Trainings, Seminare und Konferenzen in den dynamischen FinTech- und Aktien/Finanzumfeld. Dabei legen wir großen Wert auf ein offenes Miteinander, Teamspirit und gemeinsame Erfolge.

Diese Benefits erwartet Dich außerdem:

  • Moderne Office Hubs

  • Weiterbildungsangebote im Bereich Finanzmarkt/Geldanlage

  • Regelmäßige Team-Events & starke Unternehmenskultur

  • Gesundheits- & Mobilitätsangebote (Jobrad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss)

  • Attraktive finanzielle Benefits & weitere Extras

Ein Umfeld, in dem Du Dich einbringen, weiterentwickeln und wohlfühlen kannst.

Die Finanzen.net Gruppe ist ein innovatives FinTech-Unternehmen, das private und professionelle Anleger bei ihren Investitionsentscheidungen unterstützt.

Zur Gruppe gehören:

  • finanzen.net – eines der führenden Finanzinformationsportale in der DACH-Region
  • finanzen.net ZERO – ein Neobroker für kostengünstigen Wertpapierhandel
  • TraderFox – ein Anbieter von Finanzinformationen und Trading-Tools für semi-professionelle Investoren und die, die es werden wollen

Unsere Vision ist:

We strive to be the best partner for our customers on their investment journey

Anfang 2025 wurde die Finanzen Gruppe von Inflexion, einer führenden europäischen Private-Equity-Gesellschaft im Mid-Cap-Segment, übernommen. Inflexion unterstützt ambitionierte Management-Teams dabei, wachstumsstarke Unternehmen weiterzuentwickeln und nachhaltig zu skalieren.

Im Zuge der Übernahme werden die bislang eigenständig geführten Geschäftseinheiten strategisch zusammengeführt. Durch diese Neuausrichtung und die starke Innovationskraft der Gruppe entstehen neue Wachstumschancen, um die Marktposition als führende Investment-Plattform weiter auszubauen.

Um die Wachstumsstrategie und das Wertsteigerungsprogramm erfolgreich umzusetzen, suchen wir engagierte Talente, die diesen Wandel aktiv mitgestalten möchten.

Flexibilität trifft Teamgefühl. Mehrmals im Jahr treffen wir uns vor Ort für Workshops, Team Events, etc. in Karlsruhe.

raw.description:
Description

Guesty is the all-in-one platform helping hospitality businesses around the world automate, optimize, and scale their operations. We’re a fast-growing global startup that’s transforming how the industry works — from guest experience to business growth.

With a powerful suite of features and integrations with 150+ industry partners — including Airbnb, Vrbo, , Expedia, Google Travel, and many more — Guesty empowers property managers to deliver top-tier guest experiences while running more efficient, data-driven operations.

We’re proud to have over 900+ team members across 16 countries worldwide, all working together to build the future of hospitality technology.

If you’re looking to grow your career in a dynamic, global, and impact-driven environment, we’d love to hear from you.

We are looking for a Shield Program Lead to take end-to-end ownership of the operations and ongoing performance of Guesty Shield globally.

You will lead the internal claims team, manage commercial relationships with insurers and program partners, and ensure customers receive a reliable experience from enrollment through claims resolution and payment. You will drive improvements in customer retention, operational efficiency and program profitability, while leading new product launches and improvements alongside Product and other internal teams.

This is a hands-on role for someone with experience in the short-term rental/vacation rental industry who can manage people, lead commercial discussions and follow through on operational details.

Responsibilities

Program Operations

  • Own the day-to-day operation of Shield across all active markets, with clear processes, accountability and consistent service delivery.
  • Establish reporting, controls and escalation procedures, and resolve recurring operational issues.
  • Drive automation and process improvements that enable the program to scale efficiently.
  • Maintain visibility into program performance, risks and action plans.

Team Leadership and Claims Oversight

  • Manage and develop the internal claims team, including workload allocation, coaching, performance management and quality assurance.
  • Oversee the claims journey from submission through decision and payment of approved claims, in coordination with insurers and claims partners.
  • Establish and monitor service levels, ensuring timely customer communication and payment.
  • Resolve overdue claims and complex escalations, holding partners accountable for agreed commitments.
  • Ensure claims are handled accurately and consistently with applicable coverage terms.

Customer Retention

  • Own Shield retention performance and lead initiatives to reduce churn in partnership with Customer Success.
  • Identify cancellation drivers and early signs of dissatisfaction, and translate findings into corrective actions.
  • Address retention issues related to pricing, coverage, claims experience and service delivery.
  • Distinguish Shield-specific cancellations from broader Guesty churn, and monitor reductions in coverage among existing customers.

Commercial Partnerships and Program Economics

  • Own ongoing relationships with insurers, claims administrators and other program partners.
  • Lead commercial discussions, renewals, performance reviews and escalations, coordinating with Finance and Legal.
  • Negotiate improvements to commercial terms, service levels and operating processes.
  • Track program revenue, margins and operating costs with Finance, and identify opportunities to improve profitability while maintaining service and coverage quality.
  • Manage partner transitions and ensure continuity of service.

Requirements

Must

  • Prior experience in the short-term rental (STR) / vacation rental industry, with a strong understanding of property manager operations, guest-related damage and protection needs.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in program management, insurance or protection programs, operations, or a closely related field.
  • Proven experience directly managing and developing an operational team.
  • Experience managing insurers or insurance partners, including commercial negotiations and service performance.
  • Strong understanding of claims workflows, customer service and operational controls.
  • Commercial and analytical judgment, with the ability to use data to improve retention, profitability and service quality.
  • A track record of leading cross-functional initiatives from planning through implementation.
  • Strong communication, negotiation and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work across markets and time zones and take ownership in a fast-moving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in embedded insurance or property protection programs.
  • Experience managing international programs and partner relationships.
  • Experience implementing workflow automation, operational dashboards or claims management systems.

Guesty is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.title: Amazon Operations Manager - Hustler Marketing
raw.excerpt: The main purpose of the Amazon Operations Manager is to support the management and day-to-day operations of Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts for Hustler Marketing's clients.
raw.description:
The main purpose of the Amazon Operations Manager is to support the management and day-to-day operations of Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts for Hustler Marketing's clients. This includes managing inventory, coordinating shipments, setting up promotions, supporting product launches, uploading content, preparing reports, and resolving operational challenges to help clients improve their performance and grow their businesses on Amazon.

As an Amazon Operations Manager, you will work across multiple client brands and Amazon marketplaces, primarily in the UK, EU, and US, as well as Canada, Mexico, Australia, and Japan. Your responsibilities will involve analyzing sales and inventory data, identifying operational issues and growth opportunities, making recommendations based on your findings, and executing tasks that support each client's goals. You will need to understand how different aspects of Amazon operations affect a brand's performance, from inventory availability and product listings to promotions and new product launches.

A significant part of this role involves problem-solving. Amazon is a constantly evolving platform, and you will regularly encounter situations that require you to investigate unfamiliar issues, evaluate available information, and find practical solutions. You will work closely with the team, receive training on the agency's processes and ways of working, and participate in regular training and feedback sessions to continuously develop your expertise.


About the Role:

Mission statement:

The primary mission of our Amazon Operations Manager is to ensure that the operational activities of our clients' Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts are managed accurately and effectively, while supporting their business growth through data-driven decisions, consistent execution, and proactive problem-solving.

As our Amazon Operations Manager, this will include monitoring and managing inventory, identifying replenishment priorities, supporting product launches and promotional activities, analyzing sales and operational performance, and providing recommendations that help clients make informed decisions. You will be expected to approach challenges logically, take initiative in finding solutions, improve existing processes, and maintain a high standard of accuracy across your work.


General Responsibilities:

  • Managing and supporting the day-to-day operations of assigned clients' Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts across different marketplaces
  • Setting up, monitoring, and managing inventory to support product availability and meet client requirements
  • Analyzing inventory levels, historical sales, and product performance to identify products that require replenishment or are at risk of running out of stock
  • Identifying products with excess inventory and recommending appropriate actions based on sales performance and available stock
  • Setting up and coordinating shipments to Amazon warehouses, ensuring that inventory-related activities are executed accurately
  • Supporting new product launches by completing the necessary operational setup
  • Uploading and updating product content within Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central
  • Monitoring product and listing performance, investigating potential issues, and identifying opportunities for improvement
  • Interacting with Amazon Support to investigate operational issues, resolve problems, and follow up on outstanding matters
  • Creating and maintaining reports that provide insights into sales performance, inventory levels, and other relevant business metrics
  • Analyzing product performance across different product lines, variations, and categories to identify potential growth opportunities
  • Supporting strategic decisions by identifying which products or product lines should be prioritized based on sales performance, available inventory, and other relevant data
  • Identifying products or activities that may need to be deprioritized and explaining the reasoning behind those recommendations
  • Recognizing limitations in available data and identifying additional information needed to make more accurate operational and business decisions
  • Preparing clear, structured explanations of findings, recommendations, and proposed next steps for clients and internal team members
  • Identifying operational problems, investigating their causes, and developing practical solutions to resolve them
  • Taking initiative to research and resolve unfamiliar Amazon-related challenges, with support from the wider team when required
  • Ensuring that assigned operational tasks and recommended actions are implemented effectively and in line with client objectives
  • Participating in regular training, feedback, and professional development sessions to strengthen Amazon platform knowledge and operational capabilities
  • Continuously developing knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, Vendor Central, and related tools to improve the quality and effectiveness of work
  • Contributing to the overall success of assigned clients by improving operational execution, identifying opportunities, and supporting business growth


Position Specs:

  • Fully remote position
  • Ready to start as soon as possible
  • Start on a probationary period at an hourly rate.
  • Opportunity to transition into a full-time position within the Amazon Operations team with a fixed-rate monthly salary following a successful probation period
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the probationary period
  • Regular training, feedback sessions, and professional development opportunities

Requirements

About You:

Profile:

The ideal candidate should have practical experience working with Amazon Seller Central or Vendor Central and a strong interest in Amazon, e-commerce, and digital marketing. You should be comfortable navigating Amazon's operational environment, working with product and inventory information, and using data to make logical decisions that support business performance. You should have a solid analytical mindset and enjoy working with spreadsheets, reports, and numerical data. You should be able to look beyond individual products to understand broader patterns across product lines, categories, and variations.

The Amazon Operations Manager should be a curious and resourceful problem-solver who can approach unfamiliar situations with confidence and determination. You will need to investigate issues, identify potential causes, research possible solutions, and take the necessary actions to resolve them. Since Amazon operations frequently involve unexpected challenges, the ability to learn independently, think critically, and adapt your approach is particularly important.

Experience using Amazon-related tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar platforms is expected. You should also be comfortable working with spreadsheets and using them to organize, interpret, and analyze information.

The right person will be detail-oriented, organized, and process-driven, with a strong sense of accountability for the quality and accuracy of their work. You should enjoy turning ideas and recommendations into practical actions and be able to communicate your reasoning clearly to both clients and internal team members. You should be comfortable working in a remote, collaborative environment and contributing to a growing team. A positive attitude, humility, willingness to receive feedback, and genuine motivation to develop your Amazon expertise are important qualities for this position.

Key Requirements:

  • Practical experience working with Amazon Seller Central or Vendor Central platforms
  • An understanding of Amazon's operational environment, including inventory management, product setup, shipments, promotions, and content uploads
  • Experience with Amazon-related tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar platforms
  • Strong spreadsheet skills and the ability to analyze, organize, and interpret numerical data effectively
  • Ability to analyze sales and inventory information to identify replenishment priorities, potential stockouts, and overstocked products
  • Ability to calculate inventory requirements using sales performance, average daily sales, replenishment timelines, and desired stock coverage
  • Strong analytical and logical thinking skills, with the ability to draw meaningful conclusions from available data
  • Ability to identify patterns and opportunities across different products, product lines, variations, or categories
  • Ability to use available data to recommend business priorities and explain why certain products or activities should receive more or less attention
  • Understanding of how inventory availability, product performance, pricing, promotions, and content can influence Amazon sales and growth
  • Ability to recognize gaps or limitations in available information and identify additional data needed for more confident decision-making
  • Strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to independently investigate challenges, evaluate possible solutions, and take practical action
  • Experience communicating with Amazon Support or handling operational issues within Seller Central or Vendor Central
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy when working with product information, inventory figures, and operational tasks
  • Ability to create clear reports and communicate findings, recommendations, and next steps in a logical and understandable manner
  • Ability to take initiative, execute ideas effectively, and follow through on assigned responsibilities
  • Ability to work across different Amazon marketplaces and support the operational needs of multiple client brands
  • Genuine interest in Amazon, e-commerce, and digital marketing, with a willingness to continuously expand your technical knowledge
  • Ability to adapt to changes in the Amazon platform and learn unfamiliar processes or tools when required
  • Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills, with a positive, humble, and team-oriented attitude
  • Willingness to receive feedback, participate in training, and continuously improve professional performance
  • Comfortable working remotely and collaborating with a distributed team
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Fluency in additional European languages is a plus
  • A long-term mindset and motivation to grow within the Amazon Operations team
  • Ready to start as soon as possible

raw.description:
AI Risk Engineer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: AI Risk Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (Continental United States)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000 to $150,000 annually
Experience: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an AI Risk Engineer to lead the design and implementation of security controls, threat models, and incident response capabilities specifically tailored to AI and machine learning systems. The role addresses the unique security challenges posed by LLMs, model APIs, training data pipelines, and AI-powered applications, including prompt injection, model abuse, data exfiltration, and supply chain risks. The ideal candidate has strong security engineering fundamentals and a deep understanding of how modern AI systems work in practice, with hands-on experience designing defenses for both AI-powered applications and the AI infrastructure that supports them.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Define and implement security controls specifically targeting LLM and AI-powered application risks.
  • Build threat models for AI systems, including prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration, and abuse patterns.
  • Design and deploy guardrails, content filters, and policy enforcement layers around model endpoints.
  • Implement runtime detection and response capabilities for adversarial prompts and abusive behavior.
  • Secure training and fine-tuning pipelines, including data provenance, integrity, and access controls.
  • Design controls for sensitive data handling, retention, and redaction in LLM workflows.
  • Lead red-team exercises against AI systems and drive remediation of identified weaknesses.
  • Evaluate and harden third-party AI services and open-source AI components used internally.
  • Implement identity, authorization, and tenant-isolation patterns for multi-tenant AI services.
  • Drive supply chain security for ML artifacts including weights, datasets, and inference dependencies.
  • Collaborate with privacy, legal, and compliance teams to ensure AI systems meet regulatory obligations.
  • Develop monitoring, logging, and detection strategies tailored to AI workloads.
  • Lead incident response for AI-specific security events and drive durable improvements.
  • Stay current with adversarial ML, LLM security research, and emerging regulatory developments.
Required Qualifications:

Peraton is seeking a Privileged Access Management (PAM) Identity Lead to join our Team. Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit .

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

You embody our core values of Keep it Simple, Be Inquisitive, Win Together, and Own It. You are passionate and motivated. Driven, happy to deal with and remove ambiguity, and have a strong entrepreneurial spirit. Versatile, autonomous high performer in multiple disciplines, and specifically in augmenting each discipline with an AI practice. You are skilled at building consensus, making data-driven decisions, and delivering world-class development experiences, especially when AI serves as a force multiplier. You persuasively advocate for an idea while always staying open-minded and rigorously prioritizing. You have a bias towards action. Most of all, you love to dig in and build amazing things with your team, always pushing the envelope.

THE ROLE

Live Nation Core Data Services is seeking a Test Data Engineering Manager to lead and evolve a team of primarily QA-background engineers into a high-performing, engineering-driven function. This role focuses on building scalable, automated data testing solutions, including synthetic data generation, test harnesses, and regression frameworks integrated into deployment pipelines.The manager will partner with internal stakeholders to define data validation requirements and establish reusable testing frameworks across the organization. This is a globally distributed team spanning the US, UK, and offshore, requiring strong cross-time-zone collaboration.

This is a high-impact role within an entrepreneurial team backed by the scale and reach of a global live entertainment leader. The role leads the transformation of data quality into a scalable, engineering-driven capability by building and managing a team focused on automated validation frameworks, test data engineering, and data observability within a Databricks-based platform.

The position requires driving research-led, iterative validation using TDD (Test Driven Development) practices, while managing multiple roadmaps and shared-service backlogs supporting diverse engineering teams. Highly visible, this role operates across North America, Europe, and Asia, partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver reliable, scalable data solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Data Quality Platform Engineering

  • Design and build reusable data quality frameworks integrated into Databricks pipelines.

  • Develop standardized validation libraries (schema checks, freshness, volume, anomaly detection)

  • Define and enforce data quality standards and “Definition of Done” across pipelines.

Test Data Engineering

  • Build scalable solutions for synthetic data generation and masking.

  • Develop replay frameworks for validating pipeline changes against production scenarios.

  • Create automated regression testing harnesses for batch and streaming pipelines.

Data Observability & Reliability

  • Establish monitoring, alerting, and SLA/SLO frameworks for data pipelines.

  • Build tools to measure and track data quality, pipeline health, and reliability metrics.

  • Enable proactive detection of data issues in production environments.

Team Leadership & Collaboration

  • Lead and grow a team of data quality engineers and test data engineers.

  • Partner with Data Engineering, Product, and Analytics teams to embed quality practices.

  • Drive adoption of frameworks and standards across global engineering pods.

Strategy & Execution

  • Define and execute a long-term roadmap for enterprise data quality.

  • Prioritize initiatives across multiple stakeholders and global teams.

  • Eliminate manual validation processes through automation and engineering best practices.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • 5+ years in Data Engineering, Test Data Engineering, or related fields.

  • 2+ years in a technical leadership or management role.

  • Strong experience with Databricks, Spark, distributed data systems, Python and SQL.

  • Experience building automated validation or data quality frameworks.

  • Hands-on with data observability or validation tools (e.g., Great Expectations, Deequ, Soda).

  • Familiarity with streaming architectures and real-time validation.

  • AI orchestration experience a huge plus; ability to automate test data practices such as synthetic data generation, data profiling, and pipeline regression testing.

  • Solid understanding of anomaly detection and large-scale data validation patterns (e.g., hash/Merkle-based validation), and/or major TDM tools for data profiling and sampling.

  • Comfortable juggling multiple concurrent projects and setting priorities.

  • Experience with JIRA / agile user story and acceptance criteria writing.

  • Willingness to work with cross-functional teams across time-zones and odd hours as necessary.

  • Excellent analytical skills required, experience with user behavior data will be a leg up.

  • Track record of success launching test data solutions or BI validation applications.

  • Versatile, hands-on mindset with a bias for execution.

  • Passion for live music and events is a plus.

  • Optimism with drive, drive, drive.

What Success Looks Like

  • Data quality checks embedded in all critical pipelines.

  • Reduced time to detect and resolve data issues.

  • Elimination of manual QA validation processes.

  • Scalable frameworks adopted across global engineering teams.

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days
  • WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program
  • FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave and baby bonuses, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support
  • CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment
  • OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. raw.description:
NVIDIA is seeking talented engineers to join the TensorRT team and advance high-performance AI inference on NVIDIA GPUs. Our team develops software that accelerates state-of-the-art generative AI models for local and enterprise deployments. We solve challenging problems in GPU code generation, just-in-time compilation, and inference optimization to deliver high performance across diverse models and hardware configurations.


As a Senior Software Engineer, you will develop advanced GPU inference software for TensorRT. We’re looking for engineers with strong experience in GPU optimization and compiler development who can translate a deep understanding of GPU execution into efficient code generation and measurable improvements in generative AI inference.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Design and implement efficient GPU code generation techniques in TensorRT that balance generated code performance, compilation overhead, and startup latency.
  • Develop compiler optimizations, including operator fusion, dynamic scheduling, and specialization for model shapes, data types, and GPU architectures.
  • Profile workloads and analyze generated GPU code to identify bottlenecks and guide compiler and runtime improvements.
  • Develop robust, maintainable software in C++, and Python for tooling, testing, and performance analysis.
  • Collaborate with GPU architects, kernel developers, compiler engineers, and deep learning experts to guide hardware and software design.

What we need to see:

  • BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 4+ years of relevant software development experience, including contributions to a substantial codebase or project.
  • Strong proficiency in C++ and experience building performance-critical software.
  • Understanding of GPU architecture and parallel programming concepts, including memory hierarchies, thread execution, synchronization, and resource utilization.
  • A rigorous approach to performance analysis and debugging, with the ability to validate numerical correctness and explain performance tradeoffs.
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills, and the ability to work independently and collaborate across teams.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience developing or optimizing GPU kernels using CUDA, Triton, CuTe DSL, CUTLASS, or other GPU programming languages.
  • Experience with MLIR compiler infrastructure, familiarity with intermediate representations, lowering, optimization passes, and GPU code generation.
  • Familiarity with NVIDIA Tensor Core architecture, mixed-precision computation, quantization, or low-level GPU performance analysis using tools such as NVIDIA Nsight.
  • Experience developing inference frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, and SGLang.
  • A track record of measurable performance improvements in production software or contributions to GPU programming and compiler projects.

At NVIDIA, you’ll work with engineers across GPU architecture, compilers, and AI software to solve demanding performance problems. If you are curious and enjoy understanding how hardware executes code and building software that pushes its capabilities, join us in shaping the future of generative AI inference.


Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:

raw.description:
Location: UK

Salary: £44,554

Hours: Full Time

Contract Type: Permanent

Reports To: Head of MEAL

Key Internal Contacts/Relationships: Transformation Directorate, Operations Group, Programmes, Strategy, Comms & Philanthropy

Key External Contacts/Relationships: Research partnerships, External evaluators, Donors

Job Purpose: To provide senior technical leadership and strategic advisory support on Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (MEAL) across HALO programmes, ensuring organisational best practice, quality assurance, and continuous improvement in the use of evidence for decision-making, learning, and external accountability.

About HALO:

HALO is the leading global NGO addressing the impact and drivers of conflict in 30 countries and territories, with over 8,000 staff. Most of our staff are local employees and include a growing number of women.

Our primary duty is to serve people affected by conflict, clearing landmines and the explosive remnants of war that threaten lives and livelihoods long after fighting has finished. We make land safe where war has ended, while also assisting those affected by active conflict and endemic violence.

HALO addresses human suffering caused by armed violence in some of the world’s most fragile places, securing weapons and ammunition and working with both state and community actors to reduce the prevalence of armed violence.

Sitting within the Transformation Department and working closely with the Programmes, Operations Group and Strategy, the Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (MEAL) team drives the implementation of MEAL across the organisation.

About the role:

The Global MEAL Advisor reports to the Head of MEAL and advises programmes on the design, development and implementation of all MEAL processes. HALO’s MEAL team drives the implementation of MEAL across the organisation, to understand our impact, respond to donor information needs and inform programme and operational planning.

The Global MEAL Advisor is a senior technical role, operating above programme level MEAL implementation. The post provides expert advice, quality assurance, and strategic guidance rather than routine data collection or delivery level monitoring. The role is expected to exercise professional judgement, influence organisational practice, and challenge where necessary to uphold MEAL standards, donor compliance, and ethical accountability.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide technical advisory support and quality assurance to programmes on MEAL-related methods, processes, tools and to develop internal guidelines specific to their programmes.
  • Lead and advise on the design and development of data collection and data analysis tools and ensure these are fit for purpose for all external and internal requirements.
  • Guide and assist programmes in using data to improve their efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Guide and assist programmes to develop systems of accountability to the communities we serve.
  • Identify, analyse, and share lessons learned from programmes.
  • Ensure all teams worked with are aware of and abiding by global definitions of beneficiaries and standard output measurements.
  • Provide remote and on-site technical support and advice to programmes.
  • Carry out scheduled M&E visits to programmes to assist with development or implementation of processes, training new staff, or other MEAL-related needs. Visits will also be used to assess challenges, gaps in delivery, and opportunities for making processes more efficient or effective.
  • Represent HALO as a MEAL technical expert in external forums, donor discussions and sector working groups, contributing to organisational credibility and sector learning.
  • Analyse and present data on the outcomes and impact of HALO’s work.
  • Lead the development and continuous improvement of HALO’s global MEAL capacity building approach, ensuring training content reflects best practice, organisational priorities and evolving donor requirements.
  • Coordinate and implement the training of national staff M&E focal points within the geographic region of focus.
  • Strengthen disability and inclusion across programmes, including improving disability data collection methods and data quality, supporting the establishment and use of referral systems, and analysing disability-related data and trends to inform programme design and decision-making.
  • Support programmes to undertake and apply gender-responsive analysis, including analysis of sex- and age-disaggregated and qualitative data, to understand differences in needs, access, participation and outcomes and inform programme design and decision-making.
  • Provide technical advice and quality assurance to ensure gender considerations are appropriately integrated into MEAL frameworks, indicators, data collection tools, evaluations and learning processes.
  • Train Programme Officers and Field Officers as part of the PO and FO training courses as requested. Suggest training modules as gaps are identified.
  • Develop and update online courses in HALO’s learning management system (Litmos) to assist with onboarding new staff and ongoing refresher training related to MEAL.
  • Support external evaluation processes from tender stage to final report review and dissemination of lessons learned.
  • MEAL review of proposals and reports as required.

General:

  • Uphold HALO’s core values and standards, promoting its ethos and mission statement.
  • Ensure familiarity with and adherence to all HALO policies and procedures, especially the code of conduct and safeguarding

Requirements

Essential

  • Demonstrable experience in development of MEAL processes and guidance for programmes
  • Extensive experience with design and implementation of quantitative data collection tools in S123
  • Design and implementation of qualitative data collection tools such as focus group discussions and key informant interviews
  • Experience with quantitative and qualitative data analysis
  • Development and delivery of online and face-to-face training
  • Development of logframes, results frameworks, theories of change to comply with donor reporting requirements
  • Experience working across multiple countries or regions with diverse donor requirements
  • Writing project baseline documentation
  • Design and implementation of accountability mechanisms
  • Implementation of learning and feedback loops
  • Strong presentation and communication skills
  • Ability to quickly build positive relationships with diverse groups
  • Ability to work autonomously and to short deadline

Desirable:

  • Experience working with external evaluators and or donors evaluating project impact
  • Field experience in the humanitarian sector
  • Data visualisation in Power BI
  • Experience in cross-cutting issues such as Gender, Conflict sensitivity or Environment
  • Strong understanding of HMA operations

Physical Requirements for the role: Ability to sustain extensive travel to remote and high security locations

Travel Requirements: Approximately 50% of time

Benefits

  • Contributory pension, HALO will match up to 5% of contributions
  • 25 days annual leave and 8 Public Holidays
  • Non-contributory Life assurance
  • Occupational Health Services
  • Private Medical insurance
  • Flexible Working
  • Cycle to work scheme

Please submit a CV (no more than 2 pages) and a cover letter (no more than 1 page) outlining how your experience matches the key skills and competencies required by 16/11/2026.

Applications without a cover letter tailored to this position will not be considered.

We reserve the right to amend the closing date depending on the number of applications received.

The HALO Trust is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against any applicant for employment because of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

The HALO Trust is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining talented individuals from a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

The HALO Trust is committed to ensuring that it provides a safe and trusted environment which safeguards and promotes the welfare and wellbeing of anyone who comes into contact with, or is part of, the Charity, with a zero-tolerance approach to behaviours which challenge this.

The HALO trust participates in the Inter Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme, and we will request information from job applicants’ previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during employment, or incidents under investigation when the applicant left employment.

Title: Volunteer Interpreter (across approximately 7 or more languages)

Department: Refugee Sponsorship and Resettlement Program (RSRP)

Reports To: Director, Refugee Sponsorship and Resettlement Program (RSRP)

Status: On-Call Volunteer

Location: Remote (Canada)

Compensation Type: Volunteer / Unpaid

PURPOSE:

World Renew is recruiting volunteers to support interpretation needs across approximately eight or more priority languages to support our Refugee Sponsorship and Resettlement Program (RSRP). We anticipate selecting one or more volunteers for each of the following languages based on applicant availability, language proficiency, and program needs:

  • Dari
  • Tigrinya
  • Swahili
  • Somali
  • Kurdish (Kurmanji)
  • Dinka
  • Amharic

Applicants must be fluent in English and at least one of the above languages. Individuals who speak additional newcomer languages are also encouraged to apply.

These volunteers will help by facilitating communication during newcomer monitoring interviews and play an important role in supporting refugee settlement and ensuring newcomers feel heard, understood, and supported during their journey in Canada.

This volunteer opportunity provides a meaningful way to use your language skills to serve newcomers and contribute to World Renew's mission of demonstrating God's love through justice, compassion, and reconciliation.

World Renew is a Sponsorship Agreement Holder (SAH) with Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC). As part of our commitment to supporting refugees resettled in Canada, we conduct periodic newcomer monitoring interviews during sponsored newcomers’ first year in Canada to better understand settlement experiences and identify any support needs.

Volunteer translators/interpreters assist by facilitating communication between World Renew staff and newcomers during virtual monitoring interviews.

We do not discriminate based on disability, culture, ethnicity, or gender, and welcome and encourage people from diverse backgrounds to apply.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide verbal interpretation during virtual newcomer monitoring interviews.
  • Assist with communication between newcomers and World Renew staff.
  • Review interview materials prior to scheduled interviews.
  • Support culturally respectful and accurate communication.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality of all information shared during interviews.
  • Communicate availability and scheduling needs with World Renew staff.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES REQUIRED:

  • Fluency in English and at least one of the following languages relevant to newcomer populations (e.g., Arabic, Farsi, Dari, Pashto, Tigrinya, Spanish, Swahili, French, etc.).
  • Strong listening and communication skills.
  • Respect for cultural, religious, and linguistic diversity.
  • The ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment.
  • Reliable access to a computer, internet connection, and private location for virtual meetings.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Teams or similar virtual meeting platforms.

The following are considered assets:

  • Translation or interpretation experience.
  • Experience working with newcomers, refugees, or immigrant communities.
  • Knowledge of refugee sponsorship or settlement services in Canada.

VOLUNTEER COMMITMENT:

  • Flexible and remote.
  • Assignments are scheduled based on newcomer needs and volunteer availability.
  • No minimum commitment is required; however, volunteers should be willing to respond to requests in a timely manner when available.

SCREENING AND PRE-SERVICE REQUIREMENTS:

Because volunteers may interact with vulnerable populations and have access to confidential information, successful candidates will be required to complete the following before beginning service:

  • Reference check
  • Vulnerable Sector Check
  • Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)
  • Code of Conduct acknowledgement
  • Completion of any required onboarding, privacy, confidentiality, safeguarding, or role-specific training

Accessibility and Inclusion

World Renew is committed to building an inclusive and accessible volunteer program. Accommodations are available throughout the volunteer recruitment and onboarding process. Individuals requiring accommodation are encouraged to notify World Renew at any stage of the process so that appropriate arrangements can be made.

World Renew welcomes applications from people of all backgrounds and lived experiences and is committed to creating an environment of dignity, respect, and belonging for all volunteers.

Volunteer Status

This is an unpaid volunteer opportunity. Participation in this role does not create an employment relationship with World Renew. Successful volunteers will be matched with newcomer families based on language needs and availability.

Sapiens is a global leader in intelligent SaaS-based software solutions for the insurance industry, serving more than 600 insurers worldwide. We are transforming the insurance landscape through innovative technology, cloud-based platforms and AI-powered solutions that help insurers modernize operations and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

We are seeking a Senior Product Director – Life, Annuities, Long-Term Care & Group to lead the strategic direction, development and commercial success of our US Life and Annuity portfolio, while expanding our capabilities across Long-Term Care (LTC) and Group Insurance.

This is a hands-on leadership position combining product strategy, market development and day-to-day product management. The successful candidate will work closely with Engineering, Delivery, Sales, Marketing and executive leadership to shape the product roadmap, drive innovation and position Sapiens as a leading technology partner for US insurance carriers.

Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Roadmap
  • Define and execute the product vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap across Life, Annuities, Long-Term Care and Group Insurance.
  • Identify market opportunities, emerging industry trends and customer requirements to guide product investment and innovation.
  • Develop business cases and prioritize product initiatives based on commercial value, customer needs, regulatory requirements and platform capabilities.
  • Drive the expansion of Sapiens' product offerings into LTC and Group Insurance markets.
  • Collaborate with senior leadership to establish investment priorities and support overall portfolio growth.

Product Development & Execution
  • Lead hands-on product management activities within an Agile development environment.
  • Own and prioritize product backlogs, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria and product requirements.
  • Partner with Engineering, Domain Modelers and Solution Designers to translate business needs into scalable product solutions.

Market & Customer Engagement

Regulatory & Industry Expertise

  • Understand regulatory considerations impacting LTC, including rate increases, claims handling and state partnership programs.
  • Support Group Insurance requirements, including ERISA, ACA, COBRA, portability and conversion.

Commercial & Business Leadership

  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing to develop product positioning, messaging and go-to-market strategies.

  • Previous experience as a Product Manager or Business Analyst supporting insurance platform implementations.

Why Join Sapiens?

At Sapiens, you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of insurance technology and contribute to the evolution of AI-powered, intelligent insurance platforms.
You'll work alongside talented professionals across Product, Engineering, Delivery and Commercial teams, with the opportunity to influence strategic product decisions, drive innovation and make a meaningful impact across the North American insurance market.
