raw.description:
Who We Are:

Moneycorp powers global payments for corporates, institutions and high net worth individuals, combining worldwide reach with local expertise. With over 45 years of market experience, two banking licences and offices in 11 countries, our technology delivers 24/7 accessibility, while our people deliver award-winning service. In 2024, we supported $1tn+ of payment volume, reaching 190 countries in 130 currencies. Our 32k+ corporate clients benefit from our regulatory resilience with 63+ permissions globally, access to major payment rails, and our proprietary technology.

Moneycorp is a place where energy, commitment, and collaboration are core to our values of shared success. We’re restless in our drive to surpass the expectations of our customers and unlock opportunities to support them at every stage of their journey. The foundation of our success is our people, and nurturing a culture of belonging for all our colleagues is central to our journey as a global business.

Role Purpose:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Platform Engineer to join our multifunctional Cloud Platform Team as a senior individual contributor responsible for executing complex technical delivery and providing healthy challenge to architectural and delivery approaches.

As Senior Platform Engineer, you are the "show me the code" voice - the experienced engineer who validates feasibility through execution, challenges designs with implementation reality, and delivers platform capabilities with excellence. You work alongside Cloud Architects and Technical Leads as a peer contributor, bringing deep hands-on expertise and delivery experience that grounds decision-making in practical reality.

This is a senior IC role, not a leadership position - you lead through expertise, execution quality, and constructive challenge. You own complex technical problems, mentor through pairing, and set the standard for what great delivery looks like.

Role Responsibilities:

Hands-On Technical Delivery

  • Own and deliver the most complex, risky, or ambiguous technical challenges
  • Implement infrastructure-as-code (Terraform): networking, security, governance, compute, PaaS - modules, stacks, policies
  • Build CI/CD pipelines, automation scripts, self-service tooling, and observability infrastructure
  • Write comprehensive tests (unit, integration, validation) and documentation (runbooks, diagrams, implementation notes)
  • Troubleshoot complex issues spanning networking, identity, security, and infrastructure layers
  • Optimize implementations for performance, cost, security, and maintainability - secure-by-design in every delivery
  • Participate in on-call rotation and lead incident response for critical platform issues

Healthy Challenge & Technical Validation

  • Challenge architectural designs with implementation reality: "will this actually work?"
  • Provide constructive pushback on approaches that ignore delivery constraints or compromise quality
  • Validate technical feasibility during refinement - flag hidden complexity, dependencies, risks
  • Push back on unrealistic timelines with data and experience - ground planning in delivery reality
  • Propose alternative approaches based on hands-on experience: "I've tried that and here's what happened"
  • Question standards and patterns to ensure they serve real needs - challenge both over-engineering and under-engineering
  • Advocate for technical excellence while remaining pragmatic about business constraints

Collaborative Design & Refinement

  • Participate in design sessions - contribute implementation insights to architectural discussions
  • Review ADRs and design patterns for implement-ability - validate designs can be decomposed into stories
  • Participate in refinement - help decompose features into implementable stories with clear acceptance criteria
  • Validate story sizing, complexity estimates, and technical feasibility before "Ready" state
  • Identify technical prerequisites, dependencies, missing context, or unclear requirements
  • Conduct thorough code reviews: Terraform modules, Azure Policy definitions, pipeline configurations
  • Provide mentorship through constructive review feedback - balance quality with pragmatic delivery

Knowledge Sharing & Mentorship

raw.excerpt: About This RoleK1x turns tax documents (K-1s, K-3s, state schedules, 990s, and a growing range of other filings and statements) into filing-grade structured data for CPA firms, family offices, and institutional investors.
raw.description:
About This Role

K1x turns tax documents (K-1s, K-3s, state schedules, 990s, and a growing range of other filings and

statements) into filing-grade structured data for CPA firms, family offices, and institutional investors.

Accuracy and rework are the first thing our buyers ask about, and the models, prompts, and rules that

produce each extracted value are the product surface that answers them. That surface needs a

product manager fluent in how ML systems behave: how they are evaluated, where they fail, what

they cost, and when to replace a component rather than tune it. This role is the product manager for

the AI team: how its models and services are supplied to every K1x product line, partnering with the

Head of AI on delivery and with the other product managers on where those capabilities land.

What You'll Do

The AI roadmap. A rolling six-to-twelve-month roadmap for extraction coverage, accuracy, and the

platform underneath them, sized against real team capacity, sequenced with dependencies made

explicit, and re-planned when the evidence changes. You represent it in portfolio planning alongside

the other product roadmaps.

The demand queue. Intake and prioritization of new document types, forms, and fields requested by

Product, Tax Content, Sales, and Client Success. You rank the queue with a defensible framework

(RICE, WSJF, Kano, opportunity scoring, voice-of-customer synthesis), make sure each item arrives

with the definition and test data needed to validate it, and explain the ranking to those who did not get

their item first.

Accuracy as a product metric. Own how accuracy is defined and reported for each audience:

executive, customer, product, engineering. Translate model-level measures (per-field precision,

coverage, straight-through rate) into what a user experiences: what we missed, what they had to

touch, how many touches it took to reach a filing-ready result. Own the recurring accuracy report.

Product requirements for model and vendor decisions. Engineering evaluates and recommends

what serves each stage of the pipeline: a frontier model, one of our own models, or a vendor service.

You supply the product side of that decision: which accuracy, cost, and latency thresholds actually

matter to customers, the business case and budget for a change, and the acceptance criteria a

release must clear. You keep the decision record so the reasoning survives.

Capacity and the tax calendar. Filing peaks in September, October, and November drive usage; a

tax-year release lands every January. You plan engineering reserve around the peaks, own scope and

dates for the tax-year release, set the defect-intake service level with Client Success and QA, and

keep proof-of-concept work time-boxed.

The correction loop. Users correct extraction output inside our products. You partner with those

product managers and UX so corrections become a usable signal with field-level provenance, and over time a confidence-driven review experience.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of product management on shipped B2B software, ideally fintech or regtech where a wrong number costs more than a slow one, with at least 2 years owning an AI/ML-powered product surface: document AI or extraction, search and ranking, LLM features, or an ML platform.

raw.description:
Who We Are

Solera is a global leader in data and software services, transforming every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our teams work on mission‑critical platforms that demand reliability, scalability, and thoughtful evolution of complex systems.


Atlassian Administrator


The Role
The Atlassian Administrator is responsible for the secure, reliable and effective administration of Solera's Atlassian platform portfolio. The environment includes Jira Software, Jira Service Management and Confluence across Atlassian Cloud and Data Center/on-premises instances.

This is a hands-on role that combines day-to-day platform administration with governance, lifecycle management, automation and continuous improvement. The role partners with technology and business teams to provide scalable solutions while maintaining appropriate standards, controls and platform stability.


Key responsibilities

Platform administration and operations


  • Administer and support Jira Software, Jira Service Management and Confluence across Cloud and Data Center/on-premises environments.
  • Manage projects and spaces, schemes, workflows, screens, fields, permissions, notifications, issue types, service portals, queues, SLAs and knowledge bases.
  • Maintain platform health through monitoring, housekeeping, indexing, log review, capacity planning and proactive remediation.
  • Manage user access, groups, roles and administrative privileges in line with least-privilege and segregation-of-duties principles.
  • Own the administration and lifecycle of Marketplace applications, including evaluation, licensing, compatibility testing, upgrades and removal.
  • Maintain accurate platform documentation, configuration records, runbooks, support procedures and technical standards.

Governance, security and compliance


  • Define and enforce standards for project, space and repository creation, naming, ownership, permissions, retention and archiving.
  • Partner with Cybersecurity, Risk, Privacy and Internal Audit teams to implement platform controls and provide evidence for reviews and audits.
  • Support identity integrations such as SAML-based single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, SCIM provisioning and directory services including Entra ID/Active Directory or LDAP.
  • Review administrative access, external sharing, anonymous access, application permissions and data exposure risks on a recurring basis.
  • Coordinate vulnerability remediation, security patches, certificates, platform hardening and supported-version compliance for Data Center/on-premises instances.

Automation, integration and continuous improvement


  • Design and maintain automation rules, forms, templates, dashboards, filters and reports that improve usability and reduce manual effort.
  • Build and support integrations with identity platforms, service management tools, development toolchains and business applications using native connectors, webhooks and REST APIs.
  • Use scripting or Atlassian applications such as Script Runner, where approved, to implement controlled and maintainable extensions.
  • Analyze platform usage, performance, licensing and support trends; recommend consolidation, optimization and cost-control opportunities.
  • Translate business needs into scalable Atlassian solutions and challenge requests that would create unnecessary complexity, duplication or long-term support risk.

Lifecycle, change and resilience


  • Plan, test and deliver platform upgrades, patches, application updates, configuration changes and migrations using formal change-management practices.
  • Support migrations and consolidations between Cloud and Data Center/on-premises instances, including discovery, data preparation, testing, validation and cutover activities.
  • Maintain backup, restore and disaster-recovery arrangements; participate in recovery testing and ensure recovery procedures remain current.
  • Coordinate with infrastructure, database, network and vendor teams for Data Center hosting, performance, resilience and incident resolution.
  • Manage incidents and service requests within agreed service levels, lead root-cause analysis for recurring issues and communicate clearly during service disruption.

Stakeholder support and enablement


  • Act as a trusted platform adviser to engineering, IT, product, project-management and business teams.
  • Provide guidance, training and self-service materials for project administrators, space owners, service teams and end users.
  • Work with process owners to simplify and standardize ways of working while allowing justified business-specific requirements.
  • Coordinate with Atlassian and third-party vendors on licensing, support cases, product changes and technical escalations.

Required experience and skills


  • Strong hands-on experience administering enterprise Atlassian environments, particularly Jira and Confluence.
  • Experience supporting both Atlassian Cloud and Data Center/on-premises deployments in a complex or global organization.
  • Deep understanding of Jira configuration, including workflows, schemes, custom fields, permissions, automation, dashboards and reporting.
  • Practical knowledge of Confluence space administration, permissions, templates, content governance and lifecycle management.
  • Experience with identity and access management, SSO, SAML, SCIM, directory integration and role-based access control.
  • Experience planning and executing upgrades, migrations, application changes and technical releases in controlled production environments.
  • Ability to troubleshoot across application, operating system, database, proxy, network and authentication layers.
  • Knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks and at least one scripting language such as Groovy, Python or PowerShell.
  • Strong documentation, analytical, stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to balance usability, control and maintainability.

Desirable qualifications and experience


  • Atlassian certification or equivalent demonstrated expertise in Jira administration or Atlassian Cloud/Data Center operations.
  • Experience with Jira Service Management capabilities such as Assets, forms, virtual agent, service catalogues, SLAs and knowledge management.
  • Experience with Atlassian Guard, organization administration, cloud security policies and managed accounts.
  • Experience with Linux, SQL databases, reverse proxies, TLS certificates, clustering, load balancing and high-availability architectures.
  • Experience administering common Marketplace applications and managing application rationalization or license optimization.
  • ITIL, Agile, DevOps or formal change-management experience.

Key competencies


  • Ownership - Takes end-to-end responsibility for platform reliability, controls and customer outcomes.
  • Technical judgement - Chooses solutions that are secure, scalable, supportable and proportionate to the need.
  • Customer focus - Understands user goals and improves the experience without weakening governance.
  • Collaboration - Works effectively across technical teams, business functions and external partners.
  • Continuous improvement - Uses data and feedback to simplify, standardize and automate the platform.

Measures of success


  • Stable, secure and supported Atlassian services with incidents and changes managed within agreed targets.
  • Reduced configuration duplication and improved consistency across projects, spaces, repositories and instances.
  • Timely completion of upgrades, patches, access reviews, recovery tests and audit actions.
  • Improved user adoption and satisfaction through effective solutions, guidance and self-service enablement.
  • Transparent license usage
  • and measurable optimization of applications, automation and platform operating cost.

Working arrangements

The role supports a global service and may occasionally require work outside normal business hours for planned maintenance, major changes or critical incidents. Participation in an on-call or escalation role may be required, subject to local arrangements.

    • Planning Models: Build and maintain practical models for pipeline coverage, bookings, revenue, renewals, and sales productivity.
    • Revenue Risk Analysis: Identify potential contraction, churn, or forecast risks and support root-cause analysis with clear, actionable data.
  • Sales Operating Rhythm and Collaboration
    • Operating Cadence: Prepare recurring weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales reports, meeting materials, and follow-up trackers.
    • Cross-Functional Support: Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, and Operations to gather requirements, validate data, and deliver analysis and process improvements.
    • Documentation and Follow-Through: Document definitions, workflows, decisions, and action items to improve consistency and accountability.
  • Data Management and Analytics
    • Data Quality: Monitor CRM and related data for completeness, accuracy, and consistency; investigate issues and coordinate corrections with process owners.
    • Data Analysis: Analyze pipeline, bookings, revenue, retention, and customer data to identify trends, variances, and business drivers.
    • Reporting and Dashboards: Provide the BI team with business requirements to build, maintain, and improve recurring reports and dashboards that provide clear visibility into sales performance and key SaaS metrics.
    • Business Insights: Summarize findings in concise presentations and written updates tailored to business stakeholders.
  • Performance Management
    • KPI Monitoring: Track funnel conversion, pipeline coverage, sales velocity, win rates, productivity, customer acquisition cost, churn, and retention metrics.
    • Variance Analysis: Compare actual performance with targets, forecasts, prior periods, and relevant benchmarks; explain key drivers.
    • Continuous Improvement: Recommend practical improvements to reports, metrics, and workflows based on recurring analysis and stakeholder feedback.
  • Process Optimization
    • Workflow Improvement: Map current sales and customer-success workflows, identify manual steps or control gaps, and help implement simpler, more scalable processes.
    • Process Standardization: Create and maintain process documentation, templates, definitions, and standard operating procedures.
    • Sales Enablement Support: Build simple tools, reference materials, and reporting views that help sales teams use processes and systems effectively.
  • Sales Technology and Automation
    • CRM and Tools: Support day-to-day use of Salesforce and related sales tools by testing reports, documenting requirements, and helping troubleshoot data or workflow issues. Partner with the BI team so the single source of truth is clear and well-defined.
    • System Support: Work with Operations and BI teams to validate integrations and ensure data moves accurately across platforms.
    • Automation: Build or support lightweight automation for recurring reports, data preparation, quality checks, and routine workflows.
  • Customer Lifecycle Management
    • Customer Lifecycle Analysis: Analyze customer acquisition, onboarding, adoption, renewal, expansion, and retention data.
    • Renewal and Expansion Support: Maintain tracking and reporting that helps account teams prioritize upcoming renewals and expansion opportunities.
    • Churn Analysis: Support analysis of churn and contraction drivers, including recurring root-cause reporting and data validation.
  • Compliance and Risk Management
    • Data and Process Compliance: Follow established controls and data handling practices.
    • Risk Identification: Flag material data issues, process gaps, and revenue risks to the appropriate business owners.

WHAT WE REQUIRE
  • 2–4 years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, business analytics, FP&A, or a related analytical role; Subscription software experience is required.
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience working with sales, pipelines, bookings, revenue, or customer data.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel; experience building repeatable models and analyses.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce or another CRM, including reports, dashboards, and core data structures.
  • Professional proficiency in written and spoken English is required.
  • Experience with business intelligence or data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik) is highly desired
  • Ability to translate business questions into structured analysis and communicate findings clearly.
  • Identify and implement process improvements that increase operational efficiency and productivity, including the practical use of AI tools.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and ownership of recurring deliverables.
  • Comfort working through ambiguity, learning new tools, and managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative working style and willingness to perform hands-on data, reporting, documentation, and process-building work.
  • Be adaptable, take ownership of deliverables, and build practical, scalable solutions that get results.

EDUCATION
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, economics, analytics, information systems, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

TERMS OF CONTRACT
  • This is a direct contractor position and therefore not eligible for benefits.
  • Prior to the start of your contract, you must provide documentation proving authorization to work as an independent contractor (self-employed) as well as a Police Clearance Certificate.
OUR CULTURE

raw.description:
We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to this link directly.

Who we are

At Aquila, we invest in category-defining B2B/B2G software companies globally, acting as a thought-partner, striving for the success of our companies in the long term. We are a well-managed, profitable company that operates like a startup with the financial backing of a parent company. For our people, this means limitless possibilities.

We are unapologetically unique, pivoting to respond to the needs of the multiple markets we operate in. We have ambitious goals, and we are looking for genuine contributors with integrity, energy, flexibility, and loyalty. We are investing in building future leaders who can take an idea and make things happen.

Who we need

At SymPro, an Aquila company and part of Constellation Software, we provide treasury management software that supports investment, debt, and cash management operations for public sector organizations across North America. With more than 400 customers, we help government agencies and public institutions improve financial accuracy, reporting, and operational efficiency in complex treasury environments. Backed by the stability of Constellation Software and the long-term ownership model of Aquila, SymPro combines the strength of an established business with the agility of a focused, product-led software company.

Reporting to the Sales and Marketing Manager, we are hiring a Business Development Representative to help expand our presence in the public sector market across North America. As our new Business Development Representative, you will connect with finance and treasury decision-makers at government agencies and public institutions, introducing our investment, debt, and cash management software solutions and creating opportunities for our sales team. Through targeted outbound prospecting, research, and personalized outreach, you will build relationships with prospective customers, identify opportunities to introduce additional solutions to existing organizations, and book meetings that move sales conversations forward.

This is a full-time, remote role based in the United States or Canada.

What’s in it for you

A proven product with a compelling story to take to market. We have built a strong reputation and established presence in the public sector treasury management market. You will have the opportunity to introduce our broader suite of investment, debt, and cash management solutions to organizations that may already know and trust us, while opening doors with new customers. You will build your sales skills around technology that addresses real financial challenges, supported by the credibility of an established business and the opportunity to help expand our market reach.

Learn from experienced sales professionals. You will have the opportunity to learn from an experienced business development colleague and gain exposure to the broader sales process, including sales conversations and product demonstrations. You will develop an understanding of how initial outreach turns into meaningful customer relationships while building the confidence, communication skills, and commercial knowledge to take on greater responsibility.

Build a career with room to grow. Whether you are looking to break into technology sales or build on your existing experience, you will join us as we strengthen our sales and marketing capabilities. As your skills and interests evolve, you may have opportunities to move into inside sales, account management, customer success, or other commercial roles across SymPro and the broader Aquila organization. You will have the chance to explore different paths and discover where your strengths can take you.

As our new Business Development Representative, you will

  • Create targeted sales opportunities. You will research public sector organizations and identify finance, treasury, investment, accounting, and operational contacts who may benefit from SymPro’s solutions. Using CRM data, online research, sales tools, and thoughtful prospecting, you will build targeted outreach lists and focus your efforts on the accounts and contacts most likely to generate meaningful conversations.

  • Open conversations that lead to meetings. You will reach out to prospective customers and existing contacts through phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels. You will tailor your message to the audience, communicate professionally, navigate gatekeepers, handle objections, and maintain momentum through follow-up with the goal of booking qualified meetings and demos for the sales team.

  • Support a healthy early-stage funnel. You will help increase activity, demos, and early-stage pipeline by qualifying inbound interest, following up on marketing and event leads, and handing off opportunities with clear context. Because SymPro works in a defined market, you will balance quality and volume, ensuring meetings are with the right contacts in the right organizations.

  • Strengthen outreach through market insight. You will learn SymPro’s product suite, including investment, debt, and cash management solutions, as well as the broader public sector treasury management landscape. You will use that knowledge to understand customer challenges, refine messaging, and share prospect feedback with Sales and Marketing to improve target lists, outreach cadences, and early-stage opportunity quality.

  • Use tools and technology to work smarter. You will maintain accurate records of activity, contacts, follow-up, and meeting outcomes in the CRM. You will use research tools, AI-enabled tools, and available sales technology to improve account research, personalize outreach, and work efficiently while applying judgment before anything reaches a prospect.

You bring

  • The sales drive. You are goal-focused, persistent, and motivated by the opportunity to create conversations from the ground up. You can handle unanswered calls, rejection, and objections without losing momentum, and you understand that consistent, thoughtful outreach is part of building a strong sales career.

  • The prospecting mindset. You can identify, research, and qualify potential customers using account information, online research, CRM data, and sales tools. You are curious about organizations, buyers, competitors, and customer challenges, and you know that effective outreach starts with understanding who you are contacting and why it matters.

  • The communication and professionalism. You can speak and write clearly, tailor your message to the audience, and represent SymPro with credibility from the first interaction. You are comfortable contacting finance and treasury stakeholders, asking thoughtful questions, handling objections, and creating enough trust and interest to move a conversation forward.

  • The follow-through. You take ownership of your work, manage follow-up carefully, and keep accurate records. You understand that booking a meeting is only part of the job. The details, notes, timing, and handoff all contribute to the customer experience and the sales team’s success.

  • The learning agility. You are interested in learning SymPro’s products, the public sector market, and the treasury management space, including investment, debt, and cash management workflows. Previous experience in technology, SaaS, sales development, business development, customer service, banking, financial services, public sector, or another customer-facing environment is an asset.

  • The technology mindset. You are comfortable learning CRM systems, sales tools, and AI-enabled research or outreach tools. You can use technology to improve your work while applying good judgment, reviewing content carefully, and making sure outreach feels human, relevant, and professional.

Why join?

SymPro and Aquila are part of Constellation Software Inc., one of Canada's largest and most successful software companies and its most successful technology stock over the last 10 years [TSE: CSU].

Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. This is a place where high performance and hard work are rewarded, where leaders are grown, and where the best ideas win. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support.

We spend our days asking questions and challenging the status quo, manipulating our structure, roles, and internal operations in order to stay ahead in a competitive landscape.

If you share our growth mindset, relationship-focused approach, and high moral fibre, you will thrive at Aquila.

Compensation

At Sympro and Aquila, we believe compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of both experience and impact. The salary range for this role is $60,000 to $70,000 plus bonus and commission.

Compensation is determined based on skills, experience, and the scope and complexity of the role. We value open conversations about compensation and are happy to discuss our approach at any stage of the hiring process.

Apply now.

Diversity and inclusion are not mere words on paper to us. We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have most of the qualifications we are seeking, and want to play an integral role in our success, apply to express your interest.

What you can expect from our interview process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining SymPro and Aquila and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.

  • A virtual interview with the General Manager focused on your communication style, motivation, professionalism, persistence, and interest in building a career in sales.

  • A final virtual interview with the General Manager and the Portfolio Manager focused on your approach to outreach, follow-up, learning, and customer communication.

Aquila and SymPro promote equal employment opportunities for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status, marital status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and accommodations are available on request.

We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to this link directly.

Job Title: Data / Context Engineer

Location: Remote

Company Overview
Glint Tech Solutions is a women-owned, global IT staffing and recruiting firm supporting enterprise clients across the USA and Canada.

Project Description
A leading enterprise client, a multinational telecommunications technology company, is seeking a Data / Context Engineer to play a pivotal role in shaping how knowledge flows across a massive, multi-region operation. This is a high-visibility opportunity to architect and scale a knowledge base (KB) system that will directly power decision-making across 12 regions and beyond. The role sits at the intersection of AI infrastructure, data engineering, and real-world business impact, with contributions visible across a nationwide operation from day one.

Key Responsibilities

  • Sign and implement the multi-regional KB architecture in P1 alongside SA
  • Seed the KB across 12 regions during P2 (cohort 1 wk1, cohort 2 wk2, cohort 3 wk3 of July)
  • Build and operate the ingestion pipeline (machine-readable regional standards embeddings retrievable patterns) with sampled human approval gate
  • Add MOD-specific retrievable context as regional overlays during Sep-Oct
  • Own KB integrity checks, retrieval evaluation, and weekly health reporting

Mandatory Skills

  • 4-6 years of hands-on RAG / retrieval / vector store engineering in production
  • Experience building a multi-tenant or multi-region retrieval architecture with overlay / inheritance semantics, not just "one big index"
  • Vertex AI Vector Search or transferable depth (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector with strong tenancy, OpenSearch hybrid)
  • Embedding model evaluation discipline — retrieval quality metrics (recall@k, precision@k, MRR), not vibes
  • Python; familiar with structured-doc ingestion pipelines (PDF / XML / spreadsheet chunked, normalized, embedded)

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Designed a promotion path between draft/approved/retired patterns with audit log
  • Sampled human-review workflows integrated with the writeback path
  • RF / telecom standards format familiarity

raw.excerpt: About ImprovadoImprovado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams.
raw.description:
About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the Role

We are looking for a technical specialist who owns the performance of the Improvado website end to end: how it is found (SEO and GEO), how fast and healthy it is, and how well it converts visitors into pipeline. This is an analytics-driven, hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable in Google Search Console, GA4, and the browser dev tools as in a keyword report. Because the website is our main product-facing marketing surface, you will also shape how the product is presented on it. In practice, the role covers part of what product marketing would otherwise do.

What You Will Do

Technical SEO and GEO

  • Own the technical health of the site: crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, page speed, structured data and schema, rendering, redirects, internal linking, and site architecture.
  • Optimize the site for AI search (generative engine optimization): make Improvado understandable, citable, and recommended in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and similar engines.
  • Monitor visibility in both classic and AI search, and turn the findings into prioritized fixes.

Website optimization and conversion

  • Continuously improve page performance, UX, templates, and key conversion paths (demo requests, sign-ups, high-intent pages).
  • Plan and run experiments (A/B tests, template and layout changes, messaging tests) and measure their impact on conversions and pipeline.
  • Work with engineering, design, and external contractors to ship improvements to the website stack (CMS, CDN, caching, tracking).

Analytics and measurement

  • Build and maintain dashboards that connect organic and on-site behavior to leads, pipeline, and revenue.
  • Own tracking quality: events, attribution, and data accuracy across GA4, Search Console, and related tools.
  • Analyze data to find growth opportunities, and report findings in clear, decision-ready form.

Product and messaging input

  • Use search demand, AI-visibility, and on-site behavior data to guide positioning, messaging, and landing page strategy.
  • Work with stakeholders so website content reflects ICP needs and the product’s value propositions.

What We Are Looking For

Must have

  • 3+ years in SEO and/or website optimization, with measurable results in organic growth or conversion.
  • Strong technical SEO skills and a good understanding of how websites are built, served, and rendered.
  • Ability and willingness to work in the Eastern Time (EST) time zone, with working hours aligned to the US East Coast.
  • Hands-on experience with GEO or AI search optimization, or a clear, demonstrable track record of working on it.
  • Strong analytics experience: GA4, Google Search Console, and BI or dashboard tools (Looker Studio, Superset, or similar). You build your own reports and draw conclusions from the data.
  • Proficiency with SEO tooling (Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or equivalents).
  • Ability to work effectively with developers, designers, and marketers in a distributed team.

Nice to have

  • B2B SaaS or marketing technology background.
  • Experience with Webflow or a similar CMS, plus basic HTML/CSS and JavaScript.
  • SQL or advanced spreadsheet skills; experience with AI-assisted or automated workflows.
  • Experience with CRO and experimentation platforms.
  • Exposure to product marketing, positioning, or messaging.

You are

  • Analytical, curious, and driven by measurable outcomes.
  • Self-directed and comfortable owning a channel without heavy supervision.
  • A clear communicator across time zones.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first environment
  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises
  • 20 working days of PTO per year
  • US holidays and additional days off
  • Professional development reimbursement

About Atlas Technica

Atlas Technica’s mission is to shoulder IT management, user support, and cybersecurity for our clients, who are hedge funds and other investment firms. Founded in 2016, we have grown year over year through our uncompromising focus on service.

We value ownership, execution, growth, intelligence, and camaraderie. We are looking for people who share our Core Values, thrive, and contribute to this environment while putting the customer first. At Atlas Technica, we offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and great perks to our global Team. We strive to maintain a professional yet friendly environment while promoting professional and career development for our Team Members. Join Atlas Technica now!

Position Overview

We are seeking an Associate Director, Professional Services to lead day-to-day operations across our Professional Services Delivery, Cloud Solutions, and Cloud Solutions Architecture functions. Reporting to the Director, Professional Services, this leader will be responsible for delivery quality, team performance, utilization, capacity, project profitability, and consistent execution across project-based and managed cloud services.

The Associate Director will lead and develop managers and technical leaders while coordinating priorities across Professional Services, Cloud Solutions, Architecture, PMO, and other business partners. This role will ensure client engagements are appropriately scoped, staffed, governed, and delivered while maintaining strong technical standards, operational discipline, and financial performance.

The successful candidate will combine strong people leadership, technical and cloud-services knowledge, operational judgment, and client-facing communication with the ability to scale delivery across multiple teams. This role is central to creating sustainable execution within Professional Services while enabling the Director to focus on broader department strategy and service portfolio growth.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Lead, coach, and hold accountable leaders across Professional Services Delivery, Cloud Solutions, and Cloud Solutions Architecture while building sustainable team capability and succession
  • Own operational delivery performance across Professional Services and Cloud engagements, including delivery quality, client outcomes, utilization, capacity, forecast accuracy, project budgets, and profitability
  • Coordinate demand forecasting, resource planning, staffing, and delivery priorities across Professional Services, Cloud Solutions, and Architecture, resolving cross-team capacity conflicts as needed
  • Oversee shared and dedicated-client Cloud managed-services delivery, including service health, technical escalations, client commitments, and continuous improvement
  • Establish clear delivery ownership across Cloud and Professional Services engagements based on capability, capacity, complexity, and client needs
  • Partner with PMO to maintain credible scopes, schedules, budgets, risk management, change controls, project reporting, and client communication while preserving clear PMO ownership
  • Ensure appropriate architecture review and technical design validation based on engagement risk and complexity, in alignment with standards established by Cloud Solutions Architecture
  • Oversee technical discovery, scoping, solution estimates, and delivery handoffs for existing-client opportunities in partnership with Professional Services, Cloud Solutions, Sales Engineering, and other stakeholders
  • Improve Professional Services and Cloud offerings, delivery standards, templates, processes, and technical capabilities in alignment with the department service portfolio
  • Drive hiring, development, training, succession planning, knowledge transfer, documentation, and collaboration across Professional Services teams
  • Own operational and client escalations within the department and coordinate with Onboarding, Specialized Services, FDE, Support, Sales, and other stakeholders to deliver consistent client outcomes

Requirements:

  • 8+ years of relevant IT services experience, including 3+ years leading engineering, cloud, or professional-services teams within a Managed Service Provider, systems integrator, or similar technology-services environment
  • Demonstrated success leading multidisciplinary technical delivery teams with accountability for utilization, capacity, project budgets, delivery quality, and profitability
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, AWS, cloud operations, systems infrastructure, and professional-services project delivery
  • Proven ability to manage complex delivery portfolios, balance competing resource demands, and drive execution across multiple teams and client engagements
  • Strong people-leadership experience with the ability to coach managers and technical leaders, build team capability, and establish clear accountability
  • Experience managing client escalations and complex cross-functional delivery issues with sound judgment and executive-level communication
  • Strong operational and financial acumen with the ability to understand delivery economics, utilization, capacity, forecasting, and project performance
  • Excellent cross-functional coordination, stakeholder-management, and communication skills with the ability to influence across technical and business teams
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience

Desirable Qualities:

  • Experience managing both shared managed-cloud services and dedicated-client engineering delivery models
  • Microsoft Azure, AWS, or related cloud architecture or engineering certifications
  • Project-management, service-management, or related professional certification
  • Experience with PSA or project-management platforms such as ConnectWise Manage
  • Experience using financial reporting, operational metrics, or business-intelligence dashboards to manage delivery performance
  • Experience delivering technology services to financial services, investment management, alternative investments, or other regulated client environments
  • Experience helping scale Professional Services organizations, delivery models, service offerings, or cross-functional operating processes

Atlas Technica is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

raw.excerpt: OverviewWho We AreBecause health is personal.  That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform—bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place.
raw.description:
Overview

Who We Are

Because health is personal. That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform—bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.

Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.

At Personify Health, we value and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We believe in creating teams made up of individuals with various backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Why? Because diversity inspires innovation, collaboration, and challenges us to produce better solutions. But more than this, diversity is our strength, and a catalyst in our ability to #changelivesforgood.

Location: Remote (U.S.) | Preferred: New York/New Jersey-based talent

Responsibilities

What You'll Actually Do

The role

The Head of Client Success, Wellbeing is the senior-most Customer Success leader within the Wellbeing division at Personify Health. Reporting to the Chief Growth Officer, Wellbeing, you will lead a global organization of managers and their teams serving about 1,000 large direct employer, channel, and health plan clients, and you will be accountable for the renewal, retention, and expansion results that drive our growth. This is a remote role.

Your organization owns client satisfaction, renewals, retention, and growth within our existing client base, along with the health and engagement outcomes our clients expect from us. As a member of the Personify Wellbeing Commercial Leadership Team (CLT), you will help the executive team and board shape strategy and cross-functional plans, set the vision and operating model for Customer Success, advise on client strategy and program design, and serve as the executive escalation point across our global book of business.

Who you are

You are a senior executive who has led customer success or account management at scale, ideally in digital health, health plans, or health systems. You care about health and wellbeing, you keep a close eye on the industry, the competition, and the regulatory environment that affect our clients, and you work with client executives as a trusted advisor, not just a point of contact.

Essential Functions/Responsibilities/Duties

This is a broad executive role. These are the areas where you will make the biggest difference:

  • Lead and develop a global organization, building a strong leadership bench of managers with a range of experience and tenure
  • Lead transformative change: set the vision for Customer Success and realign team structures and ways of working to optimize results as our business and clients evolve
  • Be accountable for client satisfaction, annual renewals, and net growth targets across a complex, demanding client base
  • Own client health scoring and retention forecasting, and hold the organization accountable for spotting and acting on risk early
  • Drive “Land and Expand” within existing clients, cross-selling and upselling our growing set of technology and services, and driving adoption of product expansions
  • Help clients see the value they are getting by reporting on outcomes and ROI, and turn successful clients into references
  • Act as a strategic advisor and executive sponsor to senior client decision makers, step into select quarterly and annual reviews, and set the standard for how Customer Success Managers (CSMs) build strategic recommendations and action plans tied to each client’s goals
  • Stay close to your clients’ business models and their employee health, wellbeing, and engagement priorities, and make that the standard for your team
  • Own the Customer Success P&L, including workforce planning, forecasting, and cost-to-serve, using automation and AI where they help
  • Share the product roadmap with clients clearly and with energy, and be the voice of the client at the executive table, partnering with internal leaders to meet client needs and improve our offering
  • Represent Customer Success in the mid and late stages of strategic sales pursuits
  • Partner with fellow executives to break down silos and drive continuous improvement across the organization
  • Stay on top of the health technology market and serve as a key influencer of strategy and execution as it changes

Qualifications

What You Bring to Our Team

Education and Experience

To represent the best of what we have to offer, you bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA preferred
  • 10+ years in progressively senior leadership roles in customer success, account management, or professional services, preferably in technology or tech-enabled services, including leading managers and large teams
  • Domain experience in digital health, wellbeing, total rewards, health plans, or benefits administration preferred
  • Proven success in a consultative account executive environment, building relationships with senior client decision makers
  • Experience leading a global organization in a complex, matrixed, cross-functional environment, including P&L accountability
  • Experience driving transformative change
  • Experience leading a Customer Success function with a commercial mindset, with a strong focus on being a strategic advisor to clients and driving adoption of product expansions
  • A track record of building leadership teams that deliver profitable results, and of holding them accountable for analyzing client health metrics and catching retention risks early
  • Strategic thinker with experience realigning team structures to optimize success, and the skill to turn vision into a working plan
  • Executive presence, emotional intelligence, an innovative spirit, and a data-driven mindset
  • Excellent communicator who can brief executives and boards, with diplomacy, confidence as a public speaker, and attention to detail
  • Passion for client success, health, and wellbeing, and energy for a fast-paced, innovative environment

Physical Requirements

  • Must be willing to travel 25 - 50% of the time.
  • Constantly operates a computer and other productivity equipment.
  • Must communicate information and ideas so others understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.
  • Must be able to observe details at close range.

Disclaimer

This job description is not intended to contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties, or responsibilities, but constitutes a general description of the scope and function of the role within the company. Activities, duties, and responsibilities are subject to change at any time with or without notice.

Benefits

The Highlights:

  • Competitive base salary and benefits effective day one
  • Comprehensive medical and dental through our own health solutions (yes, we use what we build)
  • Unlimited PTO—rest and recharge time is non-negotiable
  • Mental health support, retirement planning, and financial protection
  • Professional development with clear career progression and learning budgets
  • Mission-driven culture where diverse perspectives drive real impact on people's health

Want the full picture? Visit personifyhealthbenefits.com to explore our complete benefits package, wellness programs, and other employee perks.

Compensation: This position offers a base salary range of $265,000 - $295,000, depending on location, skills, and experience. You're eligible for our full benefits package starting day one.

Our Commitment: Personify Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We cultivate a work environment where differences are celebrated, and employees of all backgrounds are empowered to thrive—because diversity is core to who we are and critical to our work in health and wellbeing.

Stay Safe: Personify Health will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information like social security numbers during hiring. All official communication comes from verified company email addresses and or our secure applicant tracking system. Suspicious requests? Report them to . View all legitimate openings at personifyhealth.com/careers.

raw.description:
At Globe Life, we are committed to empowering our employees with the support and opportunities they need to succeed at every stage of their career. We take pride in fostering a caring and innovative culture that enables us to collectively grow and overcome challenges in a connected, collaborative, and mutually respectful environment that calls us to help Make Tomorrow Better.

Role Overview:

Could you be our next Reconciliation Administrator? Globe Life is looking for a Reconciliation Administrator to join the team!


In this role, you will be responsible for serving as the primary system administrator and technical liaison for both the Workday ERP and Trintech reconciliation platforms, ensuring data integrity, resolving technical issues, and providing first-level user support. You will manage system configuration, file transmission processes, and reconciliation matching rules while supporting bank and GL reconciliations in compliance with SOX guidelines and company policy. This role works closely with the Reconciliation Department Manager to implement new systems, train staff, and drive continuous process improvement.


This is a remote / work-from-home position.


What You Will Do:


  • Own system configuration, matching rules, user access and security, and performance monitoring for both Workday ERP and Trintech platforms.
  • Test system updates and enhancements and document all configuration changes.
  • Perform daily verification and balancing of all file transfers to and from Workday and Trintech.
  • Troubleshoot transmission errors and automated feed failures, validate data accuracy, and maintain transmission logs.
  • Provide first-level technical troubleshooting for reconciliation staff and escalate complex issues to Workday, Trintech support, or IT as needed.
  • Document issues and resolutions, tracking them through to closure.
  • Configure new accounts and templates in Trintech and support system implementations.
  • Train other departments and end users on reconciliation best practices and software use.
  • Perform and review bank and general ledger reconciliations in accordance with SOX guidelines and company policy.
  • Research and resolve outstanding reconciliation items, including unmatched items, paid-not-issued items, and amount differences.
  • Serve as a liaison with banking partners to resolve issues and improve processes.
  • Monitor and research suspense account items, notify relevant departments, and prepare journal entries to clear discrepancies.
  • Escalate aging or unresolved suspense items as appropriate.
  • Review Reconciliation Specialists' work for quality, SOX compliance, and adherence to company policy.
  • Identify control weaknesses, recommend process improvements, and support audits with appropriate documentation.
  • Assist the Reconciliation Department Manager with staff evaluations, workflow prioritization, and performance input.
  • Participate in team meetings and support special projects as needed.

What You Can Bring:


  • Associate degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or Information Systems is required.
  • 5+ years of accounting or reconciliation experience is required.
  • Strong analytical, technical, and communication skills with a high attention to detail are required.
  • Solid understanding of GAAP and accounting principles and reconciliation processes is required.
  • Advanced proficiency in Workday ERP, including system configuration and administration, is required.
  • Advanced proficiency in Trintech reconciliation suite, including system administration, is required.
  • Expert-level Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, and macros, are required.
  • Experience with file transmission processes and data integration is required.
  • Background in bank reconciliations and positive pay processes is required.
  • Experience with SOX compliance and internal controls is required.
  • Experience training and supporting end users is required.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field is preferred.
  • 3+ years of system administration or technical support experience is preferred.
  • Technical certifications related to Workday or Trintech are a plus.
  • Background in process improvement and system implementations is preferred.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and drive process improvement both independently and collaboratively.


Applicable To All Employees of Globe Life Family of Companies:

  • Reliable and predictable attendance of your assigned shift.

  • Ability to work full time and/or part time based on the position specifications.

How Globe Life Will Support You:

Looking to continue your career in an environment that values your contribution and invests in your growth? We've curated a benefits package that helps to ensure that you don’t just work, but thrive at Globe Life:

  • Competitive compensation designed to reflect your expertise and contribution.

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans because your well-being is fundamental to your performance.

  • Robust life insurance benefits and retirement plans, including company-matched 401k and pension plan.

  • Paid holidays and time off to support a healthy work-life balance.

  • Parental leave to help our employees welcome their new additions.

  • Subsidized all-in-one subscriptions to support your fitness, mindfulness, nutrition, and sleep goals.

  • Company-paid counseling for assistance with mental health, stress management, and work-life balance.

  • Continued education reimbursement eligibility and company-paid FLMI and ICA courses to grow your career.

  • Discounted Texas Rangers tickets for a proud visit to Globe Life Field.

Opportunity awaits! Invest in your professional legacy, realize your path, and see the direct impact you can make in a workplace that celebrates and harnesses your unique talents and perspectives to their fullest potential. At Globe Life, your voice matters.

Join a team that’s transforming mental healthcare. Founded by psychiatrists, Headlight is more than a company: it’s a movement. A movement that exists on the front lines of the mental health crisis, transforming the way people access care and the way clinicians deliver it. In order to help people in their time of need and ensure that every person who comes to us has options, we are transparent about our capabilities, treatments, and coverage, we champion innovation, and we leverage our rich data to continuously implement better ways of delivering care. Our mission is simple but powerful: Improving lives, one session at a time.
Our highly skilled and principled clinical team enjoys autonomy and institutional support so they can put their focus where it should be: on improving patient outcomes. Our clinicians want to do more than help individual clients, so they work to affect the system as a whole, elevating standards of care so that their efforts reverberate far beyond what they could do in private practice.
As the most trusted behavioral health partner in the Western U.S., we’ve established deep relationships that give us unparalleled access, interoperability, and first-priority referrals. This exclusivity, combined with our best-in-class coordinated care and feedback loops, results in superior outcomes and cost savings.
Our services are convenient, accessible, and expert, combining personalized client engagement with advanced technology to enhance, not replace, human connection. Indeed, we hold that human-to-human relationships are indispensable, so from the match to the session to the time between sessions, we provide whole person care so nobody falls through the cracks and there is a brighter path forward for all.

Our clinicians chose Headlight because…

  • Clinician Led Expertise : Headlight was founded and led by clinicians. Our Clinical Leadership team is at the forefront of every decision we make.
  • Admin Work on Autopilot: We handle insurance, billing, and marketing so you can focus on what you love – seeing clients.

  • Competitive Benefits: We provide industry-leading benefits, sick leave, 401(k) contributions, and more.
  • Clinical Support: Consult with our Clinical Consult Groups or schedule case consultations with our leading clinician.

  • Collaborative Teams: Be a part of a collaborative team environment and a supportive community. Our clinicians are separated into small teams of 10 to 12, with a licensed clinical lead for assistance. You’re never alone in your journey.

Our Pillars

  • Make things easier.
  • Forge genuine connections.
  • Elevate the standard.

Headlight by the numbers

  • Access: The typical wait time to see a W2 Clinician is 4 weeks, Headlight significantly reduces this to an average of 8.9 days to see a W2 Clinician, with 80% of clients being seen within two weeks.
  • Retention and Therapeutic Relationships: Industry data indicates approximately 70% of clients return for a second therapy session. Headlight boasts a 92% return rate, reflecting Headlights ability to match clients to the right clinician.
  • Continuity of care: Of Clients who attend at least four sessions, only 36% continue with the same clinician in the broader industry. Headlight surpasses this with a 94% continuity rate.

  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) skills are a plus, but not required
  • Maintain professional licensure and/or certification throughout employment with this agency
  • Ability to work as a team member and cooperatively
  • Superb organizational skills
  • Ability to guide, direct, or influence people
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Able to establish and maintain effective working relationships with clients and their families
  • Electronic Health Record (EHR) Proficiency: Must have demonstrated experience in utilizing electronic health record systems efficiently to manage patient data, document clinical information, and access patient histories. Familiarity with NextGen is highly desirable.
  • Computer Skills: Strong computer literacy with proficiency in a range of software applications including word processing, spreadsheets, databases, and presentations. Ability to quickly adapt to new technologies and troubleshoot common issues.

Benefits

  • CEU support which includes earned CEU days and CEU reimbursements
  • Vacation, Sick, Holiday

  • Convenient work from home or hybrid options

At Fortive, we believe in growth. We're honest about what's working and what isn't, and we never stop improving and innovating.

THIS OPENING IS AVAILABLE FOR CANDIDATES IN LATIN AMERICA, NOT LIMITED TO ONLY COLOMBIA.

Sonatafy Technology, headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, is an award-winning nearshore software development company with a strong reputation. They have a dedicated in-house team of engineers, offering end-to-end software solutions and supporting client development staff augmentation. Catering to companies of all sizes and industries, including some of the world's largest brands, Sonatafy Technology is a trusted provider of nearshore enterprise-level cloud and mobile application software development services.

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented QA Engineer with extensive manual and Automation experience using Playwright. You will be part of a collaborative engineering team focused on ensuring product quality through robust test automation and efficient QA practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive automated testing efforts across the platform (50%–50% manual).
  • Contribute to social media reporting initiatives.
  • Conduct thorough automation code reviews to maintain high engineering standards.

Manual Testing (≈50%)

  • Review requirements, user stories, and designs to identify gaps, edge cases, and testability concerns early in the sprint.
  • Write and maintain clear test plans, test cases, and checklists in BrowserStack Test Management.
  • Perform functional, exploratory, regression, smoke, and UAT-support testing across web and mobile.
  • Execute cross-browser and cross-device testing, including responsive layouts and real-device checks.
  • Validate APIs and back-end behavior manually (e.g., Postman) to support UI findings.
  • Reproduce, document, and triage defects with clear steps, evidence (screenshots, videos, logs), severity, and priority.
  • Partner with Product and Development during sprint ceremonies to clarify acceptance criteria and sign off on releases.

Test Automation with Playwright (≈50%)

  • Design, build, and maintain end-to-end and API automated tests using Playwright with TypeScript.
  • Apply maintainable framework patterns (Page Object Model, fixtures, reusable helpers, test data management).
  • Identify which manual test cases should be automated and convert stable, high-value scenarios into automated regression coverage.
  • Investigate and fix flaky tests using Playwright Trace Viewer, logs, screenshots, and video.
  • Integrate test suites into CI/CD pipelines with parallel execution and run cross-browser tests on BrowserStack Automate.
  • Report automation results and quality metrics (coverage, pass rate, defect trends) to the team and stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience with Playwright using TypeScript
  • Proficiency in Playwright Trace Debugging
  • Experience with BrowserStack Test Management
  • Experience with BrowserStack Automate
  • Proven ability to scope and implement automation requirements for new features
  • Strong Computer Science fundamentals
  • Experience setting up and maintaining Continuous Integration systems
  • Skilled in reporting, tracking, and triaging bugs, and solving complex technical problems
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with meticulous attention to detail
  • Solid experience in manual testing: test case design, exploratory testing, regression, and smoke testing
  • Strong knowledge of QA methodologies and test design techniques (boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning, risk-based testing)
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams and with defect tracking tools (e.g., Jira)
  • Hands-on experience with API testing, both manual (Postman or similar) and automated (Playwright API testing)
  • Comfortable with Git, code reviews, and pull request workflows
  • Advanced English, written and spoken

Nice to Haves

  • Hands-on experience with native mobile and web QA automation (Appium, WDIO)
  • Familiarity with GitLab CI/CD
  • Experience with GitHub Actions or other CI tools
  • Basic SQL for data validation
  • Exposure to accessibility testing (WCAG) and visual regression testing
  • Familiarity with performance testing tools (k6, JMeter)
  • ISTQB or similar QA certification

Why Work with Sonatafy?

At Sonatafy, you'll join a community of highly skilled engineers across Latin America supporting innovative U.S.-based teams. You'll be part of a fast-moving, client-first culture where your code has real-world impact. We offer competitive compensation, a remote-first lifestyle, and career growth opportunities across industries and technologies.

If you have reached this point and believe you are our ideal candidate, it's time to apply! To apply, please submit your resume in English.

Recruitment Scam Notice

Sonatafy recruitment communications will only come from @sonatafy.com email addresses. We do not request fees or sensitive financial information, nor do we conduct hiring solely through online forms without interviews. If you happen to receive a suspicious message, please contact us at .

About Nerdio

Nerdio adds value on top of the powerful capabilities in Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, and Microsoft Intune by delivering hundreds of features that simplify management, ensure efficient operations, and lower Azure compute and storage costs by up to 80% via automation.

Leveraging Nerdio, partners can manage customers’ cloud environments through streamlined, multi-tenant, workflow-powered technology that allows them to create and grow cloud-based recurring revenues. Enterprise IT professionals can deliver and maintain a wide range of virtual Windows endpoints across hybrid workforces with ease and fine-tune end-user computing (EUC) approaches for maximum effectiveness using powerful monitoring and analytics capabilities.

We are a fast-moving, nimble company looking for individuals who are collaborative, empathetic, driven and who love to move at the speed of light. If you want to be part of the AVD transformation that Microsoft and Nerdio are leading, then we want to speak with you.

About the role

As a Strategic Account Executive, you will partner and align with Microsoft’s sales teams, including but not limited to Cloud & AI Specialists, AI Workforce Specialists, Global Black Belts, Channel Managers and Account Technology Specialists to uncover AVD opportunities where Nerdio can plugin and help companies deploy, manage, optimize, and secure an AVD environment. Alignment with Microsoft is essential.  

We need relationship builders with a strong understanding of VDI and EUC technologies to continue to grow our most prized partnership with Microsoft and its sales teams. You must be highly motivated and take an entrepreneurial approach to growing the relationship and revenue in addition to being a team player.

Our ideal SAE is highly skilled with a partnership selling approach. You’ll be juggling lots of opportunities at the same time – so being organized and having a positive outlook is key – and don’t be afraid to ask those stupid questions, working together is how we roll here!

Integrity means everything to us – so you will need to do what you say you are going to do. This may involve coordinating with other departments in the wider team, putting your excellent listening, written and verbal communication skills to good use!

What you'll do

  • Partnership & Pipeline Development: Collaborate with Microsoft's sales teams, channel partners, and direct customers to identify AVD opportunities where Nerdio can offer solutions. Build and nurture relationships with key stakeholders to drive business growth and increase Nerdio's market presence. Leverage your understanding of VDI and EUC technologies to position Nerdio as the preferred solution for AVD deployments.
  • Sales Management: Manage a portfolio of opportunities, ensuring accurate forecasting and pipeline management. Drive the sales process from lead qualification to closing deals, meeting or exceeding sales targets. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver comprehensive solutions and exceed customer expectations.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay up to date with industry trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies related to AVD and EUC. Conduct market research to identify new opportunities and drive strategic decision-making. Provide feedback to the product and marketing teams to enhance Nerdio's offerings and go-to-market strategies.

Qualifications

  • Proven track record of sales success, preferably in the technology industry, with experience in VDI or SaaS sales. 
  • Strong understanding of VDI and EUC technologies, including AVD and Windows365. 
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain strong relationships. 
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented, with a strong entrepreneurial mindset. 
  • Exceptional organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple opportunities simultaneously. 
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills to identify customer needs and provide tailored solutions.

Required Experience

  • A minimum of 5 to 7+ years' experience in sales, preferably in the technology industry. 
  • Proven track record of success in sales, including meeting or exceeding sales targets and quotas. 
  • Previous experience working within an enterprise global sales team and/or aligned to a regional sales territory. 
  • Strong understanding of sales processes, techniques, and strategies. 
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build relationships with customers and manage a team effectively. 
  • Proficiency in using CRM software and other sales tools for managing sales pipelines and tracking performance. 

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in selling cloud computing, IT services, or software-as-a-service (SaaS) solutions. 
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Azure and other cloud technologies. 
  • Previous experience in managing remote or distributed sales teams. 
  • Proven ability to develop and execute sales strategies to drive revenue growth. 
  • Experience in building and maintaining partnerships or channel relationships. 
  • Strong leadership skills to motivate and inspire the sales team to achieve their targets.

Benefits and Incentives

  • Competitive Base + Incentive Plan
  • Stock Options
  • Health and Welfare Plans*
  • Life and Disability Plans*
  • Retirement Plan*
  • Unlimited Flexible Paid Time Off......including your birthday off!
  • Collaborative Team Culture

* Benefits for international employees, outside the US, vary by country.
