The future is full of possibilities. At Banner Health, we’re excited about what the future holds for health care. That’s why we’re changing the industry to make the experience the best it can be. If you’re ready to change lives, we want to hear from you!

The future is full of possibilities. At Banner Plans & Networks, we’re changing the industry to reduce healthcare costs while keeping members in optimal health. If you’re ready to change lives, we want to hear from you.

Banner Plans & Networks (BPN) is an integrated network for Medicare and private health plans. Known nationally as an innovative leader, BPN insurance plans and physicians work collaboratively to keep members in optimal health while reducing costs. Supporting our members and vast network of providers is a team of professionals known for innovation, collaboration, and teamwork. If you would like to contribute to this leading-edge work, we invite you to bring your experience and skills to BPN.

As a Behavioral Health Utilization Care Manager, you will be assigned to various hospitals where you will authorize initial admitting and do concurrent reviews for medical necessity. You will be working with facilities and out-patient providers and will collaborate with other reviewers if there is a change to patients continuum of care. You will utilize your clinical experience, excellent collaboration skills, strong time management, and your ability to be a strong communicator to meet requirements for compliancy and member care.

Your work schedule will be Monday-Friday primarily 8:00 a.m.- 5:00 p.m. Arizona Time Zone. Your work location will be entirely remote. This position does require Arizona residency for compliance. If this role sounds like the one for you, apply today!

Banner Plans & Networks (BPN) is an accountable care organization that joins Arizona's largest health care provider, Banner Health, and an extensive network of primary care and specialty physicians to provide the most comprehensive healthcare solutions for Maricopa County and parts of Pinal County. Through BPN, known nationally as an innovative leader in new health care models, insurance plans and physicians are coming together to work collaboratively to keep members in optimal health, while reducing costs.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is the point person for all utilization activities for assigned members. As part of an interdisciplinary team, this position reviews and authorizes behavioral health and substance abuse services in inpatient, residential and outpatient settings using approved medical necessity criteria. Monitors care to ensure treatment is appropriate and effective. This position assesses the member’s plan of care and develops, implements, monitors and documents the utilization of resources and progress of the member through their care, facilitating options and services to meet the member’s health care needs. This position provides telephonic or electronic document review. This position engages internal and external resources to ensure members receive appropriate care plan and discharge planning services. This position monitors for quality of care concerns. Will staff regularly with medical directors. Within the scope of their position and licensure, this position will provide education and recommend alternative care plans for treatment not meeting medical necessity criteria. This position is accountable for the quality of clinical services delivered by both them and others and identifies/resolves barriers which may hinder effective care delivery to members. May conduct prior authorization, concurrent, retrospective, and appeal reviews.


CORE FUNCTIONS

1. Manages individual members across the health care continuum to achieve the optimal clinical, financial, operational, and satisfaction outcomes.


2. Acts in a leadership function with process improvement activities for populations of patients to achieve the optimal clinical, financial, operational, and satisfaction outcomes.


3. Evaluates the medical necessity and appropriateness of care, optimizing patient outcomes.


4. Establishes and promotes a collaborative relationship with physicians, other payers, and other members of the health care team. Collects and communicates pertinent, timely information to fulfill utilization and regulatory requirements.


5. Acts in a leadership function to collaboratively develop and manage the interdisciplinary patient discharge plan. Effectively communicates the plan across the continuum of care.


6. Educates internal members of the health care team on case management and managed care concepts. Facilitates integration of concepts into daily practice.


7. Has the freedom to determine how to best accomplish functions within established procedures. Confers with supervisor on any unusual situations. Positions are facility based with potential for remote work, with no budgetary responsibility. Internal customers: All levels of health plan staff, medical staff, and all other members of the interdisciplinary health care team. External Customers: Hospitals, physicians and their office staff, payers, community agencies, provider networks, and regulatory agencies.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Requires master’s degree in social work, counseling or related field or with independent or associate licensure. Licensure in at least one of the following categories as required by state law: Social work, professional counseling or marriage and family. Appropriate licenses include: LCSW, LMSW, LPC, LAC, or Licensed Psychologist. Requires a proficiency level typically achieved with three years clinical experience (i.e. counseling, care management, case management, care coordination in inpatient or outpatient levels of care).

Must have a working knowledge of care management, case management, hospital and community resources. Must demonstrate critical thinking skills, problem-solving abilities, effective communication skills, and time management skills. Must demonstrate ability to work effectively independently and in an interdisciplinary team format.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Previous experience with behavioral health utilization management.


Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

Position Summary:

Cherokee Federal is seeking a Senior Cloud Security Engineer to support cloud security operations for the U.S. National Science Foundation. This role identifies and mitigates vulnerabilities in cloud environments, monitors for security breaches, responds to incidents, and assesses cloud infrastructure. The engineer will use cloud security expertise and critical thinking to strengthen security controls, protocols, and risk management practices.

Compensation & Benefits:

Starting Salary Range for Senior Cloud Security Engineer: $160,000 – $165,000

Benefits That Set Us Apart

When considering your next opportunity, compensation is only part of the picture. We offer a benefits package designed to invest in your future and support your life outside of work.

Highlights include:

  • Up to a 6% 401(k) company match to help you build long-term financial security
  • Paid time off as part of our comprehensive benefits package, so you have the flexibility to rest, recharge, and enjoy what matters most
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus prescription drug coverage

  • Short-term and long-term disability coverage

•Paid holidays

  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options
  • Professional development, training, and certification support

Because taking care of our employees isn’t just a promise, it’s part of who we are.

Benefits are subject to change and eligibility requirements apply.

Essential Functions, Duties & Responsibilities:

Includes the following:

  • Identify, analyze, and mitigate vulnerabilities and configuration issues in cloud-based systems.
  • Monitor cloud environments for security breaches and respond to incidents to minimize their impact.
  • Assess cloud systems, identify security weaknesses, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Develop, implement, and update cloud security protocols and procedures.
  • Conduct gap analyses and recommend improvements to security controls and risk management processes.
  • Develop and implement risk management programs to strengthen the security of cloud assets.
  • Use and optimize cloud security tools to detect, prevent, and respond to threats.
  • Improve monitoring and response capabilities.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to align security measures with business objectives and industry best practices.
  • Advise internal stakeholders on cloud security policies, procedures, and standards.
  • Track emerging cloud security threats, vulnerabilities, and practices, and adapt security measures accordingly.
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

No supervisory/management authority

Basic Qualifications:

  • At least eight years of cybersecurity experience, including at least three years focused on cloud security and vulnerability management.
  • In-depth knowledge of cloud infrastructure, such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, and cloud security tools, such as AWS GuardDuty or Prisma Cloud Compute.
  • Experience in security incident response, risk management, and vulnerability mitigation in cloud environments.
  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to conduct gap analyses and develop actionable plans to address security weaknesses.
  • This position requires an active Public Trust clearance.
  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer; may occasionally require standing or moving about the office for extended periods.
  • Must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Relevant certification, such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate, or CISSP.
  • Experience with cloud-native security tools and security information and event management (SIEM) solutions for cloud environments.
  • Knowledge of risk management frameworks and compliance standards, such as NIST and ISO 27001.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, including the ability to work across teams and explain technical concepts to nontechnical stakeholders.

Work Environment:

This is a remote position.

Behind every government mission stands skilled, mission-driven talent: people whose expertise and dedication turn complex challenges into successful outcomes. Criterion Systems, part of Cherokee Federal, the federal contracting division of Cherokee Nation Businesses, is that team. We modernize aging systems, deliver care where it’s needed most, and keep missions supplied, staffed, and moving across defense, intelligence, and civilian agencies. For more than 60 federal clients, we take on the work others won’t, and deliver where it counts. If that’s the kind of work you’re looking for, you’ve found your team. Why you should join our At-Bay Security team:

At-Bay is a fast-growth InsurSec company (Insurance × Cybersecurity) on a mission to protect businesses from digital risk. As an InsurSec provider, we uniquely combine insurance with mission-critical security technologies, threat intelligence, and human expertise to close the security capability gap that leaves SMBs exposed. Our model has earned recognition as both a Forbes Fintech 50 and Fortune Cyber 60 company, serving more than 35,000 customers.

We believe InsurSec is an $80B market opportunity, and we’re building our first BDR function to match that ambition. This is a ground-floor role: you’ll set the foundation for how At-Bay develops its security business, working directly alongside Account Executives to drive outbound pipeline.

Role overview:

Your primary focus is outbound prospecting: identifying, engaging, and qualifying opportunities across a defined account base. You’ll reach technical and financial buyers using a mix of research-led outreach, phone, email, and LinkedIn to build pipeline that converts.

You’ll be reaching an existing customer base that already trusts At-Bay. Your job is to open the conversation on security. With At-Bay, our customers experience 5X fewer ransomware attacks. You’ll carry that story to an audience that needs it and isn’t hearing it yet.

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Develop a thorough understanding of our business, including how MDR, insurance, and our product tiers serve customers end-to-end

By 60 days...

By 90 days...

  • Consistently hitting or exceeding pipeline targets and meeting metrics
  • Leading top-of-funnel feedback loops with marketing
  • Articulating At-Bay’s MDR value prop confidently to both buyer types

What you’ve accomplished already:

  • You’ve prospected into SMB or mid-market accounts, ideally selling a cybersecurity offering or complex technical solution

raw.excerpt: Symetra is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead Symetra's Digital Experience engineering organization, driving the technology behind customer, partner, and employee experiences.
raw.description:
Symetra is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead Symetra's Digital Experience engineering organization, driving the technology behind customer, partner, and employee experiences.

About the role

This role is responsible for defining technology strategy, building and developing high-performing engineering teams, and delivering secure, scalable digital products that create measurable business value.

As a strategic technology leader, you will partner across Product, Architecture, UX, and business teams to modernize capabilities, accelerate delivery, and shape the future of Symetra's digital ecosystem. You will play a key role in fostering an engineering culture centered on innovation, accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

What you will do

  • Lead and develop a high-performing engineering organization, creating an inclusive culture that promotes collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
  • Define and execute technology strategies aligned with business priorities, customer needs, and long-term organizational goals.
  • Partner closely with Product, Architecture, UX, and business leaders to deliver modern digital experiences and enterprise capabilities.
  • Drive large-scale modernization, cloud transformation, and digital product initiatives from concept through production delivery.
  • Champion engineering best practices including Agile delivery, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automation, security, quality, and reliability.
  • Oversee the design, development, and operation of secure, scalable, cloud-native solutions leveraging AWS and modern engineering frameworks.
  • Build, coach, and retain exceptional engineering talent, including leaders, architects, and individual contributors.
  • Establish strong partnerships with vendors and technology partners to support product delivery, platform evolution, and operational excellence.
  • Balance innovation, technical debt reduction, risk management, and operational stability across the technology portfolio.
  • Provide executive-level leadership, strategic guidance, and investment recommendations related to technology priorities and engineering resources.

Why Work at Symetra

“I truly believe there’s something for everyone at Symetra. No matter what your passion is, if you enjoy being part of something bigger than yourself and want to make a meaningful difference, this is the place for you. We’re more than just an insurance company—we’re a community with purpose.” - Joanne S., AVP Compliance

"Symetra will spoil you. There aren't many companies that will put as much effort into you being a success as Symetra. The culture will challenge you but simultaneously put you at ease. Failure is seen as integral to the learning process so there is less reason to be fearful of it." - Kerry S., Sr. Systems Analyst

What we offer you

We don’t take a “one-size-fits-all” approach when it comes to our employees. Our programs are designed to make your life better both at work and at home.

  • Flexible full-time or hybrid telecommuting arrangements
  • Plan for your future with our 401(k) plan and take advantage of immediate vesting and company matching up to 6%
  • Paid time away including vacation and sick time, flex days and ten paid holidays
  • Give back to your community and double your impact through our company matching
  • Want more details? Check out ourSymetra Benefits Overview

Compensation

Salary Range: $171,300 - $285,600 plus eligibility for the company annual bonus program.

Who You Are

  • 12+ years of progressive experience leading software engineering teams and delivering enterprise technology solutions, including experience leading managers and senior technical talent.
  • Proven success leading engineering organizations responsible for customer-facing digital products, platforms, or experiences.
  • Strong track record of translating business strategy into technology roadmaps and successfully delivering complex, large-scale initiatives.
  • Experience building and scaling cloud-native applications and platforms in AWS, including modern architecture and serverless technologies.
  • Deep expertise in Agile development, DevSecOps, CI/CD, software delivery, platform reliability, and engineering operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to attract, develop, and retain high-performing teams while fostering an inclusive and growth-oriented culture.
  • Skilled at influencing and partnering with executives, business stakeholders, product leaders, and technical teams to drive alignment and results.
  • Experience balancing innovation, operational excellence, risk management, and technology modernization efforts.
  • Demonstrated experience enhancing engineering practices and transforming SDLC with AI.
  • Strong business and financial acumen, including prioritization, resource planning, budgeting, and investment decision-making.
  • Exceptional communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills with the ability to inspire teams and drive organizational change.
  • Experience within insurance, financial services, or another highly regulated industry preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of experience and a high school diploma.
  • Relevant cloud or technology certifications are a plus.
  • Ability to travel as needed to support the business.

Travel:

Required Training & Professional Development
All newly hired people leaders with direct reports are required to complete a comprehensive leadership development program within their first year. This program includes both virtual and in-person training. The in-person sessions will take place at Symetra’s corporate headquarters in Bellevue, Washington. Symetra covers all travel and accommodation expenses.

Reasonable Accommodations
Symetra is committed to providing equitable access to all job-related responsibilities, including required travel. If reasonable accommodations are needed for travel, Symetra’s HR department will work to provide appropriate solutions in alignment with individual needs and company policies.

We empower inclusion
At Symetra, we aspire to be the most inclusive insurance company in the country. We're building a place where every employee feels valued, respected, and has opportunities to contribute.
Inclusion is about recognizing our assumptions, considering multiple perspective, and removing barriers. We accept and celebrate diverse experiences, identities, and perspectives, because lifting each other up fuels thought and builds a stronger, more innovative company. We invite you to learn more about our efforts here.
Creating a world where more people have access to financial freedom
Symetra is a national financial services company dedicated to helping people achieve their financial goals and feel confident about the future. In our daily work, we're guided by the principles of Value, Transparency and Sustainability. This means we provide products and services people need at a competitive price, we communicate clearly and openly so people understand what they're buying, and we design products--and operate our company--to stand the test of time. We're committed to showing up for our communities, lifting up our employees, and standing up for diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI). Join our team and help us create a world where more people have access to financial freedom.
For more information about our careers visit:
Work Authorization
Employer work visa sponsorship and support are not provided for this role. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States at hire and must maintain authorization to work in the United States throughout their employment with our company.
Please review Symetra's Remote Network Minimum Requirements:
As a remote-first organization committed to providing a positive experience for both employees and customers, Symetra has the following standards for employees' internet connection:
  • Minimum Internet Speed:100 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload, in alignment with the FCC's definition of "broadband."
  • Internet Type:Fiber, Cable (e.g., Comcast, Spectrum), or DSL.
  • Not Permissible:Satellite (e.g., Starlink), cellular broadband (hotspot or otherwise), any other wireless technology, or wired dial-up.
When applying to jobs at Symetra you'll be asked to test your internet speed and confirm that your internet connection meets or exceeds Symetra's standard as outlined above.

Identity Verification

Symetra is committed to fair and secure hiring practices. For all roles, candidates will be required (after the initial phone screen) to be on video for all interviews. Symetra will take affirmative steps at key points in the process to verify that a candidate is not seeking employment fraudulently, e.g. through use of a false identity.
Failure to comply with verification procedures may result in:
  • Disqualification from the recruitment process
  • Withdrawal of a job offer
  • Termination of employment and other criminal and/or civil remedies, if fraud is discovered

raw.description:
Ready to be a Titan?

The Senior Analyst, Marketing Strategy & Operations is an analytical and operational partner to the Marketing team, helping Marketing make smarter decisions about strategy, operations, and spend. As part of your role, you will drive three connected areas: funnel performance, ROI modeling, and planning. You'll translate ambiguous, cross-functional questions into clear analysis and a plan, and drive that plan yourself.

This role sits on the Revenue Strategy & Operations team and reports to the Director, Marketing Strategy & Operations. Our team owns tangible business outcomes (pipeline, revenue, and retention) without directly generating them: we build the programs, analysis, and operating rhythm that help frontline Titans succeed, and we hold cross-functional partners accountable to shared goals. We're also committed to being the best RevOps organization in using AI to supercharge our work.

What you'll do

  • Support the operating cadence: day-to-day metrics, business reviews, readout memos, and program management, flagging risks and opportunities proactively and driving them to resolution
  • Own weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting and forecasting and build SQL/Tableau datasets and dashboards from various data sources that give leadership a trusted view of Marketing's health
  • Own high-impact special projects from opportunity identification through recommendation to ongoing execution and iteration, deliver stakeholder-ready analysis and recommendations with a clear "so what"
  • Use AI to create leverage: automate recurring reporting and analysis, build tools and templates the broader team adopts, and redirect the time saved toward judgment-heavy work: what to build, why it matters, and what the data actually means in context
  • Contribute to the broader Revenue Strategy & Operations team by documenting processes, sharing frameworks, and onboarding peers on the work you own

What you'll bring

  • 2-4+ years of experience in a combination of high-growth tech companies and/or management consulting
  • Functional experience in operations, strategy, go-to-market, growth, or marketing/revenue operations within SaaS is preferred
  • Experience running quantitative analyses and leveraging AI tools to conduct and report analytical work
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot and Salesforce is preferred
  • Ability to distill complex, ambiguous problems into a concrete plan, and then drive execution of that plan yourself
  • Genuinely energized by variety and ambiguity
  • Excellence in cross-functional communication: you can explain a complex problem to a senior leader and an analyst with equal clarity

Be Human With Us:
Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.


Use of AI Technology:

We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.


What We Offer:

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

  • Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer-nominated awards, and more.
  • Holistic health and wellness benefits: Company-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical.
  • Support for Titans at all stages of life: Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more.

At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), genetic information, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

ServiceTitan is committed to fair and equitable compensation for all of our employees. We thoughtfully consider a wide range of factors when determining individual compensation, which may change over time. We comply with all applicable minimum wage laws. For candidates in the United States, the good faith salary ranges estimate for this role isZone 1: $111,800 USD - $167,600 USD Applicable for: CA, CT, DC, MD, MA, NJ, NY, VA, and WAZone 2: $104,500 USD - $156,700 USD Applicable for: All other US locations.International Compensation for candidates residing outside the United States will vary by location and will be discussed during the hiring process. Actual compensation within a range is determined by factors including relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and performance. In addition to base salary, our total compensation package includes an annual bonus, equity, and a holistic suite of benefits.

raw.description:
Join a team that’s transforming mental healthcare. Founded by psychiatrists, Headlight is more than a company: it’s a movement. A movement that exists on the front lines of the mental health crisis, transforming the way people access care and the way clinicians deliver it. In order to help people in their time of need and ensure that every person who comes to us has options, we are transparent about our capabilities, treatments, and coverage, we champion innovation, and we leverage our rich data to continuously implement better ways of delivering care. Our mission is simple but powerful: Improving lives, one session at a time.
Our highly skilled and principled clinical team enjoys autonomy and institutional support so they can put their focus where it should be: on improving patient outcomes. Our clinicians want to do more than help individual clients, so they work to affect the system as a whole, elevating standards of care so that their efforts reverberate far beyond what they could do in private practice.
As the most trusted behavioral health partner in the Western U.S., we’ve established deep relationships that give us unparalleled access, interoperability, and first-priority referrals. This exclusivity, combined with our best-in-class coordinated care and feedback loops, results in superior outcomes and cost savings.
Our services are convenient, accessible, and expert, combining personalized client engagement with advanced technology to enhance, not replace, human connection. Indeed, we hold that human-to-human relationships are indispensable, so from the match to the session to the time between sessions, we provide whole person care so nobody falls through the cracks and there is a brighter path forward for all.

Our clinicians chose Headlight because…

  • Clinician Led Expertise : Headlight was founded and led by clinicians. Our Clinical Leadership team is at the forefront of every decision we make.
  • Admin Work on Autopilot: We handle insurance, billing, and marketing so you can focus on what you love – seeing clients.
  • Innovative Technology: By using Blueprint AI to capture session notes, clinicians can focus less on documentation and more on meaningful client interaction and connection
  • Competitive Benefits: We provide industry-leading benefits, sick leave, 401(k) contributions, and more.
  • Clinical Support: Consult with our Clinical Consult Groups or schedule case consultations with our leading clinician.
  • Clinical Autonomy: You have the autonomy to make decisions about patient care and treatment while having the backing and guidance of our experienced Executive Therapists and Psychiatrists for case consultations.
  • Collaborative Teams: Be a part of a collaborative team environment and a supportive community. Our clinicians are separated into small teams of 10 to 12, with a licensed clinical lead for assistance. You’re never alone in your journey.

Our Pillars

  • Make things easier.
  • Forge genuine connections.
  • Elevate the standard.

Headlight by the numbers

  • Access: The typical wait time to see a W2 Clinician is 4 weeks, Headlight significantly reduces this to an average of 8.9 days to see a W2 Clinician, with 80% of clients being seen within two weeks.
  • Retention and Therapeutic Relationships: Industry data indicates approximately 70% of clients return for a second therapy session. Headlight boasts a 92% return rate, reflecting Headlights ability to match clients to the right clinician.
  • Continuity of care: Of Clients who attend at least four sessions, only 36% continue with the same clinician in the broader industry. Headlight surpasses this with a 94% continuity rate.
  • Client Engagement and Attendance: Industry average for clients attending their first scheduled appointment is 65%. Headlight improves upon this with an 81% attendance rate, indicating effective initial engagement strategies.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Establish positive, trusting rapport with patients
  • Diagnose and treat mental health disorders
  • Create individualized treatment plans according to patient needs and circumstances
  • Meet with patients regularly to provide counseling, treatment and adjust treatment plans as necessary
  • Conduct ongoing assessments of patient progress
  • Involve and advise family members when appropriate
  • Plan outreach and referral activities in surrounding communities

Qualifications

  • Minimum requirement of 12 months in a clinical setting after you have become fully licensed.
  • Master’s Level Degree or higher (Required) in related fields
  • Full, unencumbered LMFT, LCSW, LPC, LPCC or Psychologist license (license based on office location). Applicants without a valid, active license will not be considered. We are currently not hiring associate/intern level therapists.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) skills are a plus, but not required
  • Maintain professional licensure and/or certification throughout employment with this agency
  • Ability to work as a team member and cooperatively
  • Superb organizational skills
  • Ability to guide, direct, or influence people
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Able to establish and maintain effective working relationships with clients and their families
  • Electronic Health Record (EHR) Proficiency: Must have demonstrated experience in utilizing electronic health record systems efficiently to manage patient data, document clinical information, and access patient histories. Familiarity with NextGen is highly desirable.
  • Computer Skills: Strong computer literacy with proficiency in a range of software applications including word processing, spreadsheets, databases, and presentations. Ability to quickly adapt to new technologies and troubleshoot common issues.

Benefits

  • W-2 role with medical, dental and vision effective on the first of the month after employment
  • Base Salary and monthly Bonus based on billed hours
  • CEU support which includes earned CEU days and CEU reimbursements
  • Vacation, Sick, Holiday
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) provides confidential counseling services, resources, and support to help you navigate personal or professional challenges.
  • 401(k) plan with company contribution
  • Credentialing Support, Training and Development Opportunities, Growth Opportunities
  • Convenient work from home or hybrid options
  • Flexible schedule
If you need any accommodations for your interview please email prior to scheduling.
Not meeting all the requirements? Research indicates that women, communities of color, and historically underrepresented individuals are often hesitant to apply for jobs unless they meet every qualification. We are committed to cultivating a diverse, inclusive, and genuine workplace. If you're enthusiastic about this position but your previous experience doesn't precisely match every qualification listed, we enthusiastically encourage you to submit your application. You could be the ideal candidate for this role or others!
Headlight is committed to the principles of diversity, equity, and inclusiveness and seeks to create a working environment reflective of this commitment. We seek to provide a diverse clinician base to support the diversity of our clients. Headlight supports and respects diversity of people, culture, and ideas throughout our organization. Headlight thrives to be a welcoming, diverse and discrimination- and harassment-free workplace.

Secur-Serv is a leading managed services provider of IT, print, and hardware services, with a security focus at the core of every service. Secur-Serv provides nationwide, on-site service to businesses of every size, focusing on the financial, manufacturing, transportation, and healthcare industries.

Secur-Serv is headquartered in Omaha, NE, and able to service our customers throughout the continental United States and Canada.

Why Secur-Serv?

Join Secur-Serv because we are committed to professional and personal growth, working with employees to develop a defined career path and helping them achieve their career goals with internal and external training and tuition reimbursement. We empower our employees to innovate and be a part of solutions that improve processes, systems, and transformation. We recognize and provide an environment where each and every employee can make an impact.

  • We have a generous benefits package for our full-time employees, which includes a copay medical plan option, HSA medical plans with employer contributions to your HSA Account, dental, vision, company-paid life insurance, and company-paid short- and long-term disability coverage.
  • Plan for your future with Secur-Serv’s 401K savings plan with a generous company match. You are vested on your first day of eligibility in the plan.
  • Participate in our wellness program to improve your health and earn a discount on your health insurance premiums.
  • Explore new education and training opportunities with our Tuition Reimbursement Plan which covers up to $5,250.

This is a remote, work-from-home position, and all qualified candidates are encouraged to apply in the continental U.S., with the exception of candidates from Colorado, California, Washington, Maryland, Hawaii, New York, Maine, Illinois, Virginia, Connecticut, DC, Vermont, or New Jersey.


POSITION SUMMARY
The Mid-Market Account Executive - New Business is focused exclusively on generating new net business and strategically solving complex IT and cybersecurity challenges within the mid-market segment. The ideal candidate has experience navigating longer sales cycles, engaging multiple stakeholders, and positioning managed services solutions for organizations with more sophisticated IT environments and higher-value contracts. This is a true hunter role. The right candidate thrives on prospecting, building pipeline, and closing new logos rather than managing an existing book of business.


ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

raw.title: Sr. Internal Communications Manager
raw.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

We’re looking for an exceptional Internal Communications Manager to join our Communications team! We’re looking for someone who is a Swiss Army knife for Internal Comms, with experience in doing everything from newsletters and large scale employee meetings, to change management and program communications. We are looking for someone who will partner closely with our Head of Internal Communications and work closely with a variety of departments across the organization. This is a great opportunity to get experience working across many different stakeholders, learning about the different parts of the company, and shape internal communications for a high-growth organization with a great culture and leaders.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except Alaska, Austin Metro, Boulder Metro, California, Chicago Metro, Connecticut, Dallas Metro, Denver Metro, Houston Metro, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, Seattle Metro, and Washington, D.C.

You should apply if:

  • You want to have an outsized impact on the industries that run our world: Helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by building something: You get excited about stepping in and establishing new processes and channels and building an Internal Communications engine that can scale with the company over time.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to become the best you can be.

In this role, you will:

  • Execute the internal communications strategy for Samsara, helping communicate the company’s vision and strategy to our employees and demonstrating progress throughout the year, amplifying our global brand, and supporting the needs of the business.
  • Support a wide range of internal communications working closely with key stakeholders such as leadership, People team, Legal, Go-to-Market, etc. You should be as comfortable working on a variety of comms, from writing change and organizational announcements to producing a newsletter or video.
  • Keep a pulse on the organization and run feedback loops as you go, in order to optimize communications updates and channels.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team).

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of internal communications experience – building and executing strategic internal communications programs. Start-up experience preferred.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills (written, verbal, and visual) with experience originating creative content across a variety of channels.
  • Experience partnering and proven track record working cross-functionally.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, high growth environment with continuous change.
  • Design and video editing skills are a plus
  • You’re curious about AI and use it regularly, whether that’s drafting, synthesizing, or automating, and you’re excited to keep learning as the tools evolve.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Tech and SaaS company experience (strongly preferred)

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$95,200—$128,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Valocity is trusted digital infrastructure for property decisions. Across India, Australia, New Zealand and the United Arab Emirates, we help leading financial institutions transform property decisioning through AI-enabled technology, trusted data and connected digital workflows.

    • Oversee the regular governance reporting for each client, report on customer onboarding status and customer satisfaction levels

7-Eleven is an iconic family of brands with over 86,000 locations, surpassing every retailer in the world. We revolutionize convenience, restaurants and fuel through cutting edge innovation — working hard to be the customer's first choice. 7-Eleven empowers our employees to "activate awesome" and make a meaningful impact in their stores and communities every day. If you're ready to grow, lead and make a difference, come join our team and help shape the future of convenience.

JOB SUMMARY:

Serves as subject matter expert for assigned regions of the country for technical, food safety, and quality assurance related areas including regulatory compliance, product development and implementation, supplier and facility approvals, and in-store procedures and execution as it relates to quality, food safety, and compliance with federal, state, and local regulations.


Candidate must reside in the primary location or additional locations listed (Remote WA or Remote OR) and must be commutable to the territory they support.


KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Facility Auditing and/or Quality Visits to third party or owned commissary, bakeries and distribution centers to assess food safety and food production for process controls and compliance to specification and/or for initial vendor and plant approvals. Will involve use of standardized forms but can include counseling, assistance in developing corrective actions and timelines. May require follow-up visits to assess/track progress.
  • Product evaluations for compliance to specification through surveillance/cuttings and/or complaint investigations for fresh food, beverage, or private brand suppliers and others as requested.
  • Quality and food safety material development or review through creation/development of standards, spec training, or specific tools to support quality knowledge and assessments.
  • Store food safety and regulatory support and compliance (key contact/liaison for assigned area) as it relates to food safety controls, equipment, regulatory issues/inquiries, recalls, non-compliance issues/citations, local HACCP or OSHA issues, permitting assistance for remodels/new store construction.
  • FSQA (Food Safety Quality Assurance) Training SME (Subject Matter Expert) for differing audiences such as Operations, Merchandising, Store Leaders, etc. and for major events such as 7-Eleven University.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

EDUCATION: Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant work experience required.

YEARS OF MANAGEMENT EXPERIENCE: 1+ years

CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES: Registered Sanitarian, Certified Professional of Food Safety or similar certifications; degree preferred in Food Science, Environmental Science, Biology, or similar.


SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:

  • Strong knowledge of Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
  • Thorough understanding of HACCP, GMPs, SSOPs, SOPs, Food Defense, Auditing Principles, FDA and USDA regulations
  • Strong counseling, facilitation, training, and modeling skills; self-confident and able to speak one on one or before larger groups
  • Strong communication and analytical skills, attention to detail for technical reports
Pay: $70,000.00 -$107,500.00 Annual

If an hourly or salary range is included in this ad it represents the range 7-Eleven in good faith believes is the range of compensation for this role at the time of this posting. The Company may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range is only applicable for jobs to be performed in this state. This range may be modified in the future. No amount is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable under the terms and conditions of the applicable policies and plans. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, long-term incentive compensation, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative For Hiring.

raw.description:
We're hiring a Developer Relations Manager to lead strategic engagement across developer ecosystems in rapidly evolving technology domains. In this role, you’ll help develop how NVIDIA partners with software providers, developers, and industry teams to expand the use of our AI and computing platforms. We're looking for someone with strong architectural depth who can guide partner product direction and support developers building on NVIDIA technologies. If you're passionate about influencing the next wave of AI and accelerated computing, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Build and deepen technical expertise in computer-aided engineering (CAE), serving as a technical advocate and trusted resource for developers in industrial engineering, with cross-functional partners to drive adoption of NVIDIA technologies.

  • Demonstrate and integrate NVIDIA’s software stack (tools, SDKs, libraries, NIMs, and blueprints) into real-world partner or developer projects to accelerate adoption.

  • Support developers and partners through onboarding and integration by providing code samples, guides, demo pipelines, and hands-on assistance that enable CAE-specific use cases.

  • Research and monitor developer ecosystem trends to identify opportunities for growth, sharing insights with engineering, product, and marketing teams to improve adoption strategies.

  • Collaborate with partner technical leaders and internal engineering stakeholders to troubleshoot challenges, guide best-practice integrations, and feed technical takeaways back to NVIDIA teams.

What We Need to See:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

  • 5-8+ years of overall professional experience in software engineering, developer relations, technical partnerships, solutions architect, product management, including hands-on experience crafting and/or deploying software tools for CAE.

  • Experience working with or supporting developer programs, technical ecosystems, or CAE ISVs, or within relevant verticals.

  • Proficiency in developing CAE workflows, software tools for physical simulation,and familiarity with modern software frameworks or SDKs.

  • Comfort collaborating with cross-functional teams to discuss architecture, share feedback, and deliver technical presentations or demos.

  • Ability to manage and implement technical projects, solve integration challenges, and effectively communicate complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strong communication skills and a passion for helping developers innovate with NVIDIA tools and technology.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • Experience creating or optimizing vertical-specific technical solutions i.e. simulation tools, virtual twins, and/or solutions for CAE, high-performance computing, applied machine learning, or deep learning.

  • Hands-on familiarity with NVIDIA platforms and frameworks: CUDA-X Libraries, PhysicsNeMo, Omniverse, NeMo, etc.

  • Demonstrated involvement in growing developer communities and supporting technical enablement programs.

  • Skilled in developing systems and tools to measure developer sentiment and track market trends, turning ecosystem insights into practical recommendations that guide product direction and strategic planning.

  • Experience with AI physics models and model architecture including developing, defining, training, and deploying open or proprietary models.

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the world’s most desirable employers! We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to outstanding growth, our best-in-class engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous person with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:
152,000 USD – 241,500 USD for Level 3; and 184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

raw.description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a Full-Stack Developer to build and evolve an AI-powered software development environment using Kiro (or similar agentic AI platforms). In this role you will be a hands-on engineer who implements the platform’s core components, reusable frameworks, and AI-assisted workflows, enabling Product, Design, Engineering, and Business teams to collaboratively build applications faster and with consistent quality. You will work within the architectural direction set by the platform’s architects and contribute to technical decisions, while owning the delivery of features end to end.

Key Responsibilities

Agentic Development Platform

  • Build and maintain components of an enterprise-grade agentic development environment using Kiro or similar platforms.
  • Implement multi-agent workflows that support requirements generation, design, code generation, testing, and documentation.
  • Contribute to scalable development patterns and reusable frameworks for application delivery.

Rapid Prototyping & AI-Assisted Development

  • Develop MVPs and proofs of concept, working closely with Product and Design partners.
  • Turn business requirements and natural language inputs into user stories, technical designs, UI prototypes, and working applications.
  • Iterate on and refine concepts through AI-assisted development cycles, gathering stakeholder feedback along the way.

Full-Stack Engineering & Reusability

  • Build and maintain reusable assets, including:
    • Application templates and starter kits
    • Angular component libraries
    • NestJS/Node.js service frameworks
    • AI agent workflows and prompt libraries
  • Apply and promote consistent architecture and coding standards across teams.
  • Write clean, well-tested, and well-documented code, and participate actively in code reviews.

AI Agent Integration

  • Implement and tune workflows involving requirements, design, code generation, testing, and documentation agents.
  • Integrate LLM-based tools into the software delivery lifecycle, including CI/CD pipelines.
  • Evaluate AI-generated output for correctness, security, and maintainability, and improve prompts and workflows based on results.

Adoption & Quality

  • Support adoption of AI-native development practices across Product, Design, and Engineering teams.
  • Help implement governance, security, quality controls, and validation processes for AI-generated artifacts.
  • Contribute to workshops, demos, and documentation, and mentor mid-level and junior developers.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional full-stack development experience, with strong hands-on expertise in NestJS, TypeScript, and Angular.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture, REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, and cloud-native application development.
  • Experience building or contributing to developer platforms, internal tools, accelerators, or platform engineering solutions.
  • Track record of delivering rapid prototypes, MVPs, or innovation initiatives.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD, DevOps practices, and automated testing frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end).
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Product, Design, and Engineering stakeholders and communicate technical concepts clearly.
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools, agentic AI platforms, or multi-agent frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Kiro.
  • Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, MCP (Model Context Protocol) architectures, or AI orchestration platforms.
  • Background in Developer Experience (DevEx), Platform Engineering, or Internal Developer Platforms (IDP).
  • Experience building or contributing to enterprise design systems and reusable UI libraries.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or contributing to AI adoption and innovation programs.

All our positions are Remote and are available as Full Time Employment or B2B Contracts

raw.description:
Inbound Sales Specialist (Part Time Seasonal, Remote)

Storage Scholars is a high-growth company that’s undergone 100% year-over-year growth since its inception in 2017. Our goal is to change the way college students across the country move in and out of residence halls with our all-inclusive moving, storage and shipping service. Storage Scholars is fast-moving, tenacious, innovative, and core-product-focused. We strive to be the premium option among the competition by offering the best user experience available, which is dependent on continuously improving our technology. We expect passion and buy-in from every team member, no matter the role. We believe everyone, regardless of their position, brings unique knowledge, skills, and perspective that makes us who we are. All voices are not just welcomed but encouraged to be a part of the decisions and direction of the organization. At Storage Scholars, egos are left at the door, wins are celebrated as a team, and learning never stops.

As an Inside Sales Representative (Part Time Seasonal) at Storage Scholars, your primary responsibility is being a consultative guide for customers seeking solutions for student move-in, move-out, storage, and shipping. As a member of the greater Customer Experience Team, you will be a crucial link between the customer and their understanding and adoption of the services that we offer.

What you’ll do:

  • Field inbound leads from both lead form submissions and inbound calls.
  • Make proactive phone calls to existing and former customers to promote service usage.
  • Provide service estimates for customers via call, SMS, and email.
  • Guide customers through their order flow in our online portal to book their moves.
  • Promote additional services and service upgrades to customers, as well as generate referrals.

Required:

  • Exceptional communication with strong sales aptitude.
  • Strong critical thinking skills.
  • Ability to handle fast-paced changes and intense workloads.
  • Strong phone presence.
  • High emotional intelligence to understand fellow team members and clients alike.
  • Technologically savvy, with the ability to learn new software rapidly.

Preferred:

  • 1–2 years of customer-facing experience (such as retail, hospitality, or customer service).

Scope:

  • Part time, seasonal role: 15–25 hours/week on average, up to 40 hours/week during March - May.
  • The ability to work a flexible schedule on evenings and weekends as necessary during our peak season (March - September).
  • Preferred Start Date: 1/25/27
  • Contract End Date: 9/13/27

Compensation:

  • Estimated seasonal earnings: $4,500 – $10,000+
    • Base pay plus per-customer commission. Earnings depend on hours worked (15–25 hrs/week) and monthly sales performance.

Other Benefits:

  • Fully Remote
  • Ability to grow with our rapidly growing company and team.

Location:

  • Remote

How Our Core Service Works:

Customers sign up on our web portal to schedule services on their respective campuses. Packing supply kits are shipped out to students as requested. The student packs their items, uploads a few photos to our portal, selects their desired insurance, locks it in their room, and can leave at will. Thanks to our partnership with the university, our staff comes in once the campus is vacant and moves all of the student belongings into a storage facility for the summer. The best part is that the items will be ready and waiting in the customer’s new housing assignment whenever they return.

Storage Scholars is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Salary: $4,500 – $10,000 / year

You will set technical direction, lead cross-team development, and mentor other engineers while shipping high-quality, production-ready software.

raw.description:
Description

The Site Contracts & Budget Manager provides operational leadership for site contracting and budget

negotiation activities across awarded clinical trials. The role is primarily accountable for contracting strategy,

Clinical Trial Agreement negotiation and execution, site budget negotiations, amendments, and resolution of

complex contractual and financial issues.

Working in close partnership with the Site Budget & Proposal Manager, the role translates proposal-stage

budget assumptions into effective study- and site-level contracting and negotiation strategies. Together, the

roles provide complementary leadership across the site budget and contracting lifecycle, with distinct primary

areas of accountability.

The Site Contracts & Budget Manager serves as a key contact and escalation point for sponsors, sites, and

internal stakeholders and provides functional guidance, training, and support to Site Budget & Contracting

personnel

Requirements

More specifically, the Site Contracts and Budget Manager must:

· Lead and manage Site Budget & Contracting staff, providing direction, coaching, development,

workload oversight, and support to ensure consistent quality and delivery across assigned studies.

· Oversee site contracting and budget negotiation activities across the portfolio, ensuring appropriate

resourcing, prioritization, quality, timelines, and escalation of risks or issues.

· Provide oversight of site contracting for awarded clinical trials, including Clinical Trial Agreements,

associated financial exhibits, amendments, negotiation parameters, and country-specific requirements.

· Establish and maintain contracting strategies, standards, and negotiation approaches that support

timely site activation while balancing sponsor requirements, organizational standards, site

expectations, and contractual risk.

· Serve as functional escalation point for complex or high-risk contract and budget negotiations,

providing guidance to team members and facilitating decisions with sponsors, sites, Legal Affairs, and

other stakeholders.

· Oversee the operational implementation of study-specific site budgets, including negotiation

parameters, approval pathways, exceptions, and escalation requirements.

· Translate proposal-stage budget assumptions into executable study- and site-level budget and contracting strategies. · Collaborate with Legal Affairs, Project Management, Study Start-Up, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, Finance, and other stakeholders to ensure contracting and budget activities align with study requirements and operational plans. · Provide site contracting expertise during proposal development, including input on country-specific contracting requirements, anticipated timelines, institutional considerations, negotiation trends, risks, and resource needs. · Participate and/or support bid defence meetings, client presentations, and sponsor strategy discussions when site contracting, budget negotiation, timelines, or associated risks are relevant. · Monitor portfolio-level contracting and budget performance, identifying emerging risks, delays, capacity constraints, quality concerns, and opportunities for improvement. · Own and oversee the business assets supporting Site Budget & Contracting, including contract and budget templates, negotiation tools, country intelligence, guidance documents, trackers, reference materials, and other functional resources. · Ensure business assets remain current, fit for purpose, consistently applied, appropriately governed, and aligned with evolving operational and business needs. · Oversee the integrity, consistency, and usability of Site Budget & Contracting data across applicable tools, trackers, and systems. · Use contracting and negotiation outcomes to strengthen institutional and country intelligence and, in partnership with the Site Budget & Proposal Manager, inform future budget assumptions and benchmarks. · Lead functional process improvement initiatives to improve contracting and budget negotiation quality, efficiency, consistency, scalability, and stakeholder experience. · Support digital transformation and automation opportunities that reduce manual activities, strengthen controls, and improve the availability and quality of contracting and budget data. · Establish and monitor relevant performance indicators and use operational data to identify trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for corrective action or continuous improvement. · Ensure Site Budget & Contracting staff are appropriately trained and consistently apply relevant SOPs, processes, templates, tools, and quality standards. · Partner with senior leadership on resource and capacity planning, functional priorities, process maturity, systems and tools, quality, and continuous improvement. · Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, proactive risk management, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement within the Site Budget & Contracting team. Employee may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.

PROFILE

Our company

The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability, and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

  • Permanent full-time position
  • Flexible schedule
  • Vacation
  • Home-based position

About Indero

In 2024, a group of lifelong friends in Brisbane turned a small number of properties into a fast-growing short-term rental business — driven by grit, ownership, and a commitment to doing things better.

Today, Smart Suites manages short-term rental accommodation across Rocklea, Sunnybank, Acacia Ridge, and nearby areas in Queensland, Australia. We adopt AI-driven tools, structured systems, and clear operating standards to improve efficiency, decision-making, guest experience, and business growth.

Our culture feels more like a sports team than a traditional company: accountable, collaborative, curious, and focused on results.

We're now looking for a Junior Marketing Specialist who is organized, creative, analytical, and excited to support digital marketing, content, lead generation, research, campaigns, and brand-building initiatives.

Important Notes Before You Apply

Role Type: Full-time independent contractor, not a permanent employee role

Compensation: AUD $1,000 – $1,300 per month, all-inclusive

Schedule: Flexible full-time role, Monday to Sunday as required

Location: Work from anywhere in the Philippines

Time & Productivity Tracking: All contractors use Hubstaff for time and activity tracking to ensure transparency and accountability

AI-Driven Work Environment: You must be comfortable using AI tools, automation, and digital systems to improve productivity and work quality

Why Our Recruitment Process Is Thorough

We believe long-term success comes from the right fit — for both the contractor and the business. Our multi-stage recruitment process helps ensure clarity, alignment, and realistic expectations.

You can expect:

  • Initial Interview: Background, motivation, communication style, and role fit
  • Technical Live Assessment: Practical marketing, research, content, and campaign-related tasks
  • Behavioral Interview: Ownership, adaptability, coachability, and problem-solving
  • Pre-Offer Role Fit Assessment
  • Meet the Founder / Final Interview: Expectations, growth, and long-term alignment
  • Pre-Engagement Steps:
  • IT Audit / systems readiness
  • Reference Check

What You'll Do

  • Website, SEO & Digital Content: Assist with website updates, basic SEO, keyword research, metadata updates, landing pages, and content improvements
  • Social Media & Content Management: Draft captions, social posts, newsletters, and promotional materials; schedule posts and monitor engagement
  • Lead Generation & Market Research: Research potential customers, partners, property opportunities, agencies, and market segments
  • Prospect Database Management: Build and maintain lead lists, research trackers, and prospect databases
  • Digital Campaign Support: Assist with Meta, Google, email, and other digital campaigns
  • Email Marketing & CRM: Support email campaign creation, segmentation, scheduling, automation, and CRM updates
  • Brand Management: Help maintain consistent messaging and presentation across Smart Suites' digital channels
  • Partnership Support: Research partnership opportunities and assist with outreach, follow-ups, and documentation
  • Analytics & Reporting: Track website, social, campaign, email, lead, and engagement metrics
  • Project Coordination: Maintain marketing trackers, SOPs, files, dashboards, and project updates
  • AI & Automation: Use AI and workflow automation tools to improve research, content creation, reporting, and repetitive marketing tasks
  • Ad Hoc Marketing Support: Assist with award submissions, pitch decks, photoshoot coordination, event logistics, vendor sign-offs, and time-sensitive marketing projects

What We're Looking For

  • 1–2 years of experience in digital marketing, social media, lead generation, content marketing, or a related role
  • Strong entry-level candidates with relevant practical experience may also be considered
  • Basic understanding of social media, SEO, paid advertising, email marketing, and lead generation
  • Good written communication and copywriting skills
  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets, reports, trackers, and basic marketing data
  • Strong research skills and attention to detail
  • Organised, proactive, coachable, and able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
  • Comfortable learning new digital tools and marketing platforms
  • Confident using AI tools to research, create, analyse, and improve work
  • Experience in hospitality, property, accommodation, travel, or service-based businesses is an advantage

Tools & Technology

  • Meta Business Suite / Meta Ads Manager
  • Google Ads
  • Google Analytics 4
  • WordPress or other CMS platforms
  • HubSpot, Zoho, or similar CRM systems
  • Apollo, La Growth Machine, LinkedIn, or similar lead-generation tools
  • Zoho Campaigns or other email marketing tools
  • Canva and/or Adobe Photoshop
  • Microsoft 365, Excel, Outlook, and Teams
  • AI tools and workflow automation platforms

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Consistent and timely execution of the marketing content calendar
  • Growth in website and social media engagement
  • Number and quality of marketing, partnership, and lead-generation opportunities identified
  • Accuracy and completeness of lead and market research databases
  • Improvement in email, website, social, and campaign engagement metrics
  • Contribution to qualified lead generation and conversion
  • Timely completion of assigned marketing projects and deliverables
  • Quality and usefulness of market and competitor research
  • Effective use of AI and automation to improve marketing efficiency
  • Consistent adherence to Smart Suites' brand standards and marketing processes

About Smart Suites

Smart Suites is redefining hospitality in Australia by combining operational discipline, technology-driven execution, and a strong focus on guest experience.

As we continue to grow, every contractor plays a meaningful role in building scalable, reliable systems that support our guests, our properties, and our team.

This is a great opportunity for a junior marketer who wants hands-on exposure to digital marketing, AI-enabled workflows, lead generation, campaign execution, and brand growth within a fast-moving hospitality business.

Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. Deployed by over 85 health plans, including many of the top 20, and representing more than 270 million lives, Machinify brings together a fully configurable and content-rich, AI-powered platform along with best-in-class expertise. We’re constantly reimagining what’s possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize financial outcomes and drive down healthcare costs.

We’re seeking a Senior or Staff Frontend Engineer to join our web application engineering team!

Our Culture @ Machinify

We embrace complex challenges with curiosity, having genuine interest and drive to understand the hard problems at hand and how to move the needle forward. Our engineers empower each other to take action, learn deeply about our customers' needs and unlock innovation with a strong sense of product ownership. We build with our users in mind, thoughtfully shipping outcomes, not just features. The technology we build shapes real healthcare decisions, demanding a high bar for engineering excellence and what we ship carries real weight. We pressure-test new AI tools, shape how they're used, and set the example for what disciplined, AI-driven engineering looks like...fast, but always under structured human oversight.

The Role

The ideal candidate brings a range of skills across web application development, with a passion for building user-centric, high-performance UI platforms. As a primary contributor to frontend development, you'll lead new feature work and shape architectural patterns in collaboration with backend-services engineers to optimally serve the user interface. You work alongside AI coding agents as a core part of how you deliver, directing and reviewing their output while holding the bar on quality. You bring strong experience in application design and system architecture, along with a proven ability to drive adoption of new languages, tools, and agentic development practices across a team. Above all, you excel at transforming complex requirements into scalable, responsive interfaces that deliver an exceptional user experience.

Every day offers a chance to work on something intellectually stimulating! We've built a team of strong programmers and problem solvers! You'll join a highly visible engineering team trusted to solve complex, high-stakes problems using the best of AI, data and software systems. You're responsible for writing code that has a significant impact on our customers and future product lines. Our team partners cross-functionally to influence product direction, work directly with customers, and own systems positively impacting millions of lives, where your technical decisions truly matter.

Click here to learn more about our customer-facing product lines.

Does this sound like the right opportunity to explore?... Lets connect!

  • Deepen your understanding of the healthcare claims and payments domain
  • Developer Coach/Multiplier - an experienced frontend engineer who not only ships production-grade UI, but also contributes to setting standards, mentors others, and elevates the team's overall frontend maturity
