  • Develop new applications and contribute toward UI and potentially middle-layer development
  • Own projects aligned with our product development strategy
  • Design and implement solutions that achieve a delightful and intuitive user experience
  • Balance customer-facing features and technical debt cleanup to keep the software suite sustainable
  • Bring agentic engineering practices into the team's day-to-day work and help the team adopt them effectively
  • Collaborate with team and external stakeholders such as Product Managers, Backend Engineers, the UX team, and our customers

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of production-ready application development experience with high-traffic users
  • Proven experience developing thoughtful UI system design and architecture with extensibility in mind
  • Proficiency in modern JavaScript, TypeScript, and CSS/HTML
  • Expert at reading and understanding complex enterprise-grade code, quickly contributing to it, and suggesting improvements

  • Excitement to make an impact in rewiring US healthcare!

What We Offer

  • Work from anywhere in the US! Machinify is digital-first.
  • Top Medical/Dental/Vision offerings
  • FSA/HSA
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Competitive salary, 401(k) with company match
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Additional health and wellness benefits and perks
  • Flexible and trusting environment where you’ll feel empowered to do your best work

Our interview process is designed to evaluate candidates across our engineering career ladder. The level, title, and compensation range we're able to offer are determined by your overall performance and the competencies you demonstrate throughout the process which allows us to place each candidate at the level that best reflects their experience and abilities!

The salary for this position is based on an array of factors unique to each candidate: Such as years and depth of experience, set skills, certifications, etc. We are hiring for different levels, and our Recruiting team will let you know if you qualify for a different role/range. Salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes meaningful equity, excellent healthcare, flexible time off, and other benefits and perks.

Pay Range: $200,000-250,000 ~

Equal Employment Opportunity at Machinify

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Machinify is an employment at will employer. We participate in E-Verify as required by applicable law.   • Strong facilitation and public speaking skills

  • Strong understanding of adult learning principles and content design best practices
  • Experience with enterprise cloud platforms, preferably in regulated or professional industries (legal, financial, corporate, or government)

title: Regulatory Affairs Director (P&C Insurance)
description: State regulators and departments of insurance, industry advocacy groups and more are actively deciding how aerial imagery and AI can be used in underwriting and rating.

raw.title: Regulatory Affairs Director (P&C Insurance)
raw.excerpt: State regulators and departments of insurance, industry advocacy groups and more are actively deciding how aerial imagery and AI can be used in underwriting and rating.
raw.description:
State regulators and departments of insurance, industry advocacy groups and more are actively deciding how aerial imagery and AI can be used in underwriting and rating. More than a dozen departments of insurance have issued bulletins on the subject, with imagery recency limits running from 180 days to two years, constraints on what evidence supports an adverse action, and new disclosure and appeal requirements for consumers. Legislation is moving in several more states, and a national model act is in draft. These rules determine how much of Nearmap's value a carrier can realize, and in the most restrictive states they shape whether particular use cases are viable at all.

This role owns Nearmap's answer. You will build and lead our insurance regulatory affairs function, setting our regulatory strategy, engaging with regulators and legislators to help inform and understand the latest changes, and advising insurance customers on best practices for using Nearmap AI products in admitted markets. You will track every bulletin and bill that touches imagery and AI, and you will publish the positions our customers and our field can rely on.

The framework for imagery and AI for the insurance industry is still being written, and you will put Nearmap in the room, arguing standards that reflect what current imagery and AI can support.

You will be starting from a solid foundation. Nearmap data is approved in more than fifty rate filings, and we maintain a working database of state bulletins and legislation. What we do not have is a single owner. This is a builder role with immediate impact: you will step into active filing engagements from week one, and you will build the function behind them, which includes the state playbooks and the positions Nearmap stands behind.

You will report into Insurance Product, which puts you close to where new attributes and scores are designed, and you will work daily with data science, actuarial, Legal, and our customer-facing teams.

You'll be the regulatory face of Nearmap:

  • Act as the named Nearmap contact across the filing lifecycle, from pre-filing consultation through objection response and post-approval maintenance.
  • Own Nearmap regulatory strategy, which includes where we will register, where and what we will file, and how. You’ll partner with insurance carriers to jointly design regulatory approaches that suit their needs.
  • Lead objection response strategy, drawing analytical inputs from our actuarial and data science teams.
  • Own our advisory organization relationship and the subscriber mechanics that sit between us and our carrier customers, and establish where those requirements are regulatory and where they are commercial.
  • Develop a recommendation on advisory organization registration beyond our existing Arizona registration and own this strategy on an ongoing basis as the regulatory landscape continues to evolve.
  • Partner with Legal on the privilege, contractual, and compliance questions that arise from filings and regulator engagement.

You'll own the filing program:

  • Own Nearmap rate filing approach end-to-end to support carrier filing programs: scoping, materials, submission coordination, tracking, objection response, and close.
  • Coordinate on and collaborate with cross functional teams to support a rate filing materials library, including model memos, validation summaries, and methodology documentation, for every Nearmap attribute and score used in rating.
  • Maintain state-by-state command of filing requirements, permissible confidentiality treatment, and filer eligibility.
  • Manage version control and re-filing triggered by model updates, new attributes, validation findings, or regulator feedback.
  • Monitor regulatory filings across all states and maintain up-to-date database of rating plans that use aerially derived data.

You'll help shape the rules, not just follow them:

  • Track NAIC, NAMIC, and NCOIL activity on insurance AI and imagery, including the NAIC AI Systems Evaluation Tool, and represent Nearmap's perspective in those venues.
  • Advise product and data science on filing implications before new attributes and scores ship, so regulatory risk is designed out and new products are released in a “filing-ready” state.

You'll make the field credible:

  • Equip Sales, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success with accurate positioning on what our filing history does and does not transfer to a given state.
  • Build the filing schedules, metrics, and playbooks the whole insurance vertical works from.

Experience

  • 8 to 12 years in property and casualty rate filings, regulatory affairs, or state product management. Personal lines property especially.
  • Hands-on experience managing complete filing lifecycles and interacting directly with state insurance regulators. California experience is a significant advantage.
  • Experience preparing regulator-ready materials: filing narratives, methodology summaries, actuarial exhibits, statistical plans, forms, and rate pages.
  • Bachelor's degree in insurance, actuarial science, public policy, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Skills

  • You know SERFF and multi-state prior-approval processes cold, and you know which states behave differently and why.
  • You can translate model documentation and validation output into language a regulator will accept the first time.
  • You work towards many parallel deadlines you do not control, and you do not drop them.
  • You hold your own in a room with carrier actuarial and regulatory teams.
  • You write clearly, and you can explain a technical method to a reviewer without losing the substance.

What makes you stand out

  • Actuarial credentials such as ASA or ACAS, or relevant regulatory training or certification.
  • Prior regulator-side experience inside a department of insurance.
  • Experience with AI, predictive model, or catastrophe model filings, and familiarity with model governance frameworks.
  • Experience standing up or maintaining advisory or rating organization status.

You’ll be successful if you are:

  • Comfortable being the first person in a function and writing the playbook while the work is live.
  • Calm under deadlines set by other people, which is most of them.
  • Commercially aware. You understand that filing approval is a revenue event, and a delay is not just an inconvenience.
  • A strong communicator in writing, in conversation, and on a call with a regulator.

Why you'll love working at Nearmap:

We move fast and work smart; often wearing multiple hats. We adapted to remote working with ease and are continually looking at ways to improve. We’re proud of our inclusive, supportive culture, and maintain a safe environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging and can be themselves.

In addition to your annual leave, Nearmap offers:

  • 4 extra "YOU" days off each year—take a break, no questions asked!
  • Company-sponsored volunteering days to give back.
  • Generous parental leave policies for growing families.
  • Work from Overseas Policy - explore the world in the approved list of cities while you work!
  • Discounted Private Health Insurance plans.
  • A Nearmap subscription (naturally!).

Learn More About The Work We Do:

YouTube Page

LinkedIn Page

Thanks, but we got this! Nearmap does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies and search firms. Please do not email or send unsolicited resumes to any Nearmap employee, location or address. Nearmap is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Property intelligence is reshaping how the world understands the built environment, and Nearmap is driving that. We put powerful aerial imagery, AI-driven analytics, and geospatial tools into the hands of the people who plan, build, insure, and govern the places we all live and work. Our technology turns property uncertainty into decisive action, and our culture brings out the best in the people who build it.

title: Regulatory Affairs Director (P&C Insurance)
description: State regulators and departments of insurance, industry advocacy groups and more are actively deciding how aerial imagery and AI can be used in underwriting and rating.

raw.title: Regulatory Affairs Director (P&C Insurance)
raw.excerpt: State regulators and departments of insurance, industry advocacy groups and more are actively deciding how aerial imagery and AI can be used in underwriting and rating.
raw.description:
State regulators and departments of insurance, industry advocacy groups and more are actively deciding how aerial imagery and AI can be used in underwriting and rating. More than a dozen departments of insurance have issued bulletins on the subject, with imagery recency limits running from 180 days to two years, constraints on what evidence supports an adverse action, and new disclosure and appeal requirements for consumers. Legislation is moving in several more states, and a national model act is in draft. These rules determine how much of Nearmap's value a carrier can realize, and in the most restrictive states they shape whether particular use cases are viable at all.

This role owns Nearmap's answer. You will build and lead our insurance regulatory affairs function, setting our regulatory strategy, engaging with regulators and legislators to help inform and understand the latest changes, and advising insurance customers on best practices for using Nearmap AI products in admitted markets. You will track every bulletin and bill that touches imagery and AI, and you will publish the positions our customers and our field can rely on.

The framework for imagery and AI for the insurance industry is still being written, and you will put Nearmap in the room, arguing standards that reflect what current imagery and AI can support.

You will be starting from a solid foundation. Nearmap data is approved in more than fifty rate filings, and we maintain a working database of state bulletins and legislation. What we do not have is a single owner. This is a builder role with immediate impact: you will step into active filing engagements from week one, and you will build the function behind them, which includes the state playbooks and the positions Nearmap stands behind.

You will report into Insurance Product, which puts you close to where new attributes and scores are designed, and you will work daily with data science, actuarial, Legal, and our customer-facing teams.

You'll be the regulatory face of Nearmap:

  • Act as the named Nearmap contact across the filing lifecycle, from pre-filing consultation through objection response and post-approval maintenance.
  • Own Nearmap regulatory strategy, which includes where we will register, where and what we will file, and how. You’ll partner with insurance carriers to jointly design regulatory approaches that suit their needs.
  • Lead objection response strategy, drawing analytical inputs from our actuarial and data science teams.
  • Own our advisory organization relationship and the subscriber mechanics that sit between us and our carrier customers, and establish where those requirements are regulatory and where they are commercial.
  • Develop a recommendation on advisory organization registration beyond our existing Arizona registration and own this strategy on an ongoing basis as the regulatory landscape continues to evolve.
  • Partner with Legal on the privilege, contractual, and compliance questions that arise from filings and regulator engagement.

You'll own the filing program:

  • Own Nearmap rate filing approach end-to-end to support carrier filing programs: scoping, materials, submission coordination, tracking, objection response, and close.
  • Coordinate on and collaborate with cross functional teams to support a rate filing materials library, including model memos, validation summaries, and methodology documentation, for every Nearmap attribute and score used in rating.
  • Maintain state-by-state command of filing requirements, permissible confidentiality treatment, and filer eligibility.
  • Manage version control and re-filing triggered by model updates, new attributes, validation findings, or regulator feedback.
  • Monitor regulatory filings across all states and maintain up-to-date database of rating plans that use aerially derived data.

You'll help shape the rules, not just follow them:

  • Track NAIC, NAMIC, and NCOIL activity on insurance AI and imagery, including the NAIC AI Systems Evaluation Tool, and represent Nearmap's perspective in those venues.
  • Advise product and data science on filing implications before new attributes and scores ship, so regulatory risk is designed out and new products are released in a “filing-ready” state.

You'll make the field credible:

  • Equip Sales, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success with accurate positioning on what our filing history does and does not transfer to a given state.
  • Build the filing schedules, metrics, and playbooks the whole insurance vertical works from.

Experience

  • 8 to 12 years in property and casualty rate filings, regulatory affairs, or state product management. Personal lines property especially.
  • Hands-on experience managing complete filing lifecycles and interacting directly with state insurance regulators. California experience is a significant advantage.
  • Experience preparing regulator-ready materials: filing narratives, methodology summaries, actuarial exhibits, statistical plans, forms, and rate pages.
  • Bachelor's degree in insurance, actuarial science, public policy, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Skills

  • You know SERFF and multi-state prior-approval processes cold, and you know which states behave differently and why.
  • You can translate model documentation and validation output into language a regulator will accept the first time.
  • You work towards many parallel deadlines you do not control, and you do not drop them.
  • You hold your own in a room with carrier actuarial and regulatory teams.
  • You write clearly, and you can explain a technical method to a reviewer without losing the substance.

What makes you stand out

  • Actuarial credentials such as ASA or ACAS, or relevant regulatory training or certification.
  • Prior regulator-side experience inside a department of insurance.
  • Experience with AI, predictive model, or catastrophe model filings, and familiarity with model governance frameworks.
  • Experience standing up or maintaining advisory or rating organization status.

You’ll be successful if you are:

  • Comfortable being the first person in a function and writing the playbook while the work is live.
  • Calm under deadlines set by other people, which is most of them.
  • Commercially aware. You understand that filing approval is a revenue event, and a delay is not just an inconvenience.
  • A strong communicator in writing, in conversation, and on a call with a regulator.

Why you'll love working at Nearmap:

We move fast and work smart; often wearing multiple hats. We adapted to remote working with ease and are continually looking at ways to improve. We’re proud of our inclusive, supportive culture, and maintain a safe environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging and can be themselves.

In addition to your annual leave, Nearmap offers:

  • 4 extra "YOU" days off each year—take a break, no questions asked!
  • Company-sponsored volunteering days to give back.
  • Generous parental leave policies for growing families.
  • Work from Overseas Policy - explore the world in the approved list of cities while you work!
  • Discounted Private Health Insurance plans.
  • A Nearmap subscription (naturally!).

Learn More About The Work We Do:

YouTube Page

LinkedIn Page

Thanks, but we got this! Nearmap does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies and search firms. Please do not email or send unsolicited resumes to any Nearmap employee, location or address. Nearmap is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Property intelligence is reshaping how the world understands the built environment, and Nearmap is driving that. We put powerful aerial imagery, AI-driven analytics, and geospatial tools into the hands of the people who plan, build, insure, and govern the places we all live and work. Our technology turns property uncertainty into decisive action, and our culture brings out the best in the people who build it.

raw.description:
We’re not just behavioral health people—we’re crisis people.
Connections Health Solutions is a leading provider of immediate-access behavioral health crisis care. Our team combines medical and recovery-oriented treatment to stabilize individuals in crisis and connect them to community-based resources for ongoing recovery.
Founded by emergency room psychiatrists Dr. Chris Carson and Dr. Robert Williamson, our model is physician-led and data-driven, drawing upon more than 15 years of crisis care expertise. Recognized by SAMHSA and the National Council for Mental Wellbeing as a national best practice, we’ve delivered invaluable treatment to hundreds of thousands of individuals facing crises. Our commitment remains consistent, to improve access, inspire hope, and provide the right support.
Our values shape our decisions, define our culture, and foster continuous learning and growth.
We accept people as they are, creating safe spaces where they feel valued and respected. We inspire hope by walking with people side-by-side, showing them grace and compassion. We act with intention, holding ourselves and each other accountable, and doing the right thing. We work as one team, trusting and supporting each other. We embrace change and innovation, striving to find better ways to fulfill our mission.
We are on a mission to change the face of behavioral health. Help us save lives and make a difference.

What You'll Do:

Under the direction of the Director, RCM Implementation, the Credentialing Coordinator manages the end-to-end credentialing, re-credentialing, and payer enrollment process for behavioral health providers, behavioral health support (BHS) staff, and facilities across Connections Health Solutions (CHS). This role serves as the subject matter expert for credentialing requirements across licensed clinical providers and non-licensed behavioral health support staff, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant credentialing files that support billing, payer enrollment, and delegation of authority obligations.

  • Provider Onboarding & Data Entry
    • Manages new provider onboarding from initial HR/Talent Acquisition notification through completion of the provider’s Medallion profile. Enters and maintains provider information, including NPI, licensure, practice locations, and payer information, using the provider’s CV and supporting documentation.
  • Provider Communication
    • Initiates and tracks onboarding communications with providers to request required documentation, including CAQH, PECOS, state licenses, DEA registrations, board certifications, diplomas, and other required credentials. Conducts timely follow-up to ensure provider profiles reach 100% completion.
  • Verbal Provider Support
    • Initiates and responds to phone calls and text messages with physicians and other providers to explain credentialing and enrollment requirements, resolve outstanding items, and answer questions when direct communication is needed to keep the credentialing process moving forward.
  • Provider Licensing Research
    • Researches and interprets state licensing board requirements across provider types, including MDs, DOs, NPs, and PAs, to determine applicable licensure, supervision or collaborative agreement, and scope-of-practice requirements by market. Maintains current knowledge of regulatory and licensing board changes that may impact credentialing.
  • Primary Source Verification (PSV)
    • Monitors and completes required primary source verifications within the credentialing platform, including NPI, NPDB, Medicare/Medicaid opt-out, state licensure, DEA, OIG, and SAM checks. Escalates adverse findings through the appropriate credentialing committee review process prior to the provider’s start date.
  • Malpractice & Insurance Coordination
    • Coordinates with the organization’s insurance broker to add new providers to the applicable malpractice policy. Uploads resulting facesheets, certificates, and other required documentation to the credentialing platform and CAQH.
  • Payer Enrollment & Maintenance
    • Manages provider enrollment with applicable commercial and government payers by market. Monitors applications through completion, escalates stalled or non-compliant applications, and verifies effective dates, payer IDs, and recredentialing dates are accurately documented following approval.
  • CAQH & Attestation Management
    • Maintains and re-attests provider CAQH profiles, ensuring practice locations, liability coverage, and other required information remain current and accurate for payer enrollment.
  • Multi-State & Telehealth Licensing
    • Supports cross-state licensure and payer enrollment for telehealth providers, including updates to practice location and licensure information and coordination of additional malpractice insurance coverage for new markets.
  • State-Specific Registration Processes
    • Facilitates state and program-specific registration requirements, including prescriptive authority and collaborative agreement registration for advanced practice providers, state Medicaid portal enrollment, domain transfers, surrogacy requests, and Medicare enrollment through CMS/PECOS.
  • BHS Staff Credentialing
    • Manages NPI acquisition and state Medicaid enrollment for applicable behavioral health support staff. Tracks enrollment status through supplemental tracking tools and distributes recurring compliance reports, including missing NPI and Medicaid enrollment information, to HR and operational leadership for follow-up.
  • Facility Credentialing
    • Manages facility-level enrollment and maintenance within applicable state Medicaid systems, including linking servicing providers to facility records and maintainingaccurate facility enrollment information.
  • Offboarding
    • Processes provider and BHS staff terminations by deactivating credentialing platform profiles and notifying applicable payers of provider departures in accordance with market-specific requirements.
  • Ongoing Maintenance & Recredentialing
    • Performs routine monitoring of OIG/SAM and NPDB databases and tracks provider recredentialing cycles, typically every three years. Monitors license and board certification renewal requirements and completes necessary updates to prevent credentialing or enrollment lapses.
  • Delegation of Authority
    • Completes credentialing documentation under applicable delegation of authority requirements and ensures activities remain compliant with delegated credentialing agreements.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Partners with Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, Medical Leadership, and operational leadership to facilitatetimely provider onboarding, resolve credentialing or compliance issues, and support new-hire orientation timelines.
  • Committee Participation & Reporting
    • Participates in quarterly Credentialing Committee meetings and prepares regular reporting on provider, BHS staff, and facility credentialing and enrollment status for Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and operational leadership.
  • Process Documentation
    • Supports the development, implementation, and maintenance of standardized credentialing workflows, reference guides, process documentation, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned to support organizational and departmental objectives.

This is a fully remote position in these states: AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MT, NC, NJ, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, WA, WI

What You'll Bring:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • 2 years of experience in provider and/or facility credentialing, payer enrollment, or related managed care administrative work
  • General knowledge of regulatory requirements related to credentialing and payer enrollment, including a solid understanding of Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care processes and rules
  • Ability to research and interpret state licensing board requirements across provider types (MD, DO, NP, PA) and apply them accurately to credentialing decisions
  • Experience working within a credentialing software platform (e.g., Medallion) or comparable credentialing management system
  • Working knowledge of provider enrollment systems such as PECOS, CAQH, and state Medicaid provider portals
  • Strong customer service orientation and soft skills, with comfort communicating by phone or text with physicians and providers to resolve credentialing questions and outstanding items, in addition to email-based correspondence.
  • Advanced user of Microsoft Office products, particularly Excel.
  • The Company has a mandatory vaccination policy. All successful applicants must be fully vaccinated, including showing proper documentation, or otherwise be exempt pursuant to the Company’s exemption process prior to their start date as a condition of employment.

It would be great if you had:

  • Bachelor's degree in health care administration or a related field
  • 3+ years of credentialing or payer enrollment experience within a behavioral health environment
  • Familiarity with CAQH attestation processes and delegated credentialing requirements
  • Experience supporting multi-market or multi-state credentialing and enrollment operations

What We Offer:

Full-time only:

  • Employees (and their families) are offered comprehensive health insurance, including Medical, Dental, Vision, Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity
  • CHS pays for Basic Life, AD&D, Short and Long-Term Disability
  • Voluntary Life insurance option for employees and their families

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (health care and dependent care)
  • 401k company match after 6 months (50% of deferrals up to 6% of compensation)

  • Company‑paid parental leave available to eligible employees

All employees (Pool, Part-time and Full-time):

  • Employee Assistance Program to help with confidential emotional support, work life solutions, financial solutions, legal assistance, or online support
  • After 90 days, you are auto enrolled in the 401k Plan

raw.description:
The main purpose of the Amazon Operations Manager is to support the management and day-to-day operations of Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts for This is Unicorn's clients. This includes managing inventory, coordinating shipments, setting up promotions, supporting product launches, uploading content, preparing reports, and resolving operational challenges to help clients improve their performance and grow their businesses on Amazon.

As an Amazon Operations Manager, you will work across multiple client brands and Amazon marketplaces, primarily in the UK, EU, and US, as well as Canada, Mexico, Australia, and Japan. Your responsibilities will involve analyzing sales and inventory data, identifying operational issues and growth opportunities, making recommendations based on your findings, and executing tasks that support each client's goals. You will need to understand how different aspects of Amazon operations affect a brand's performance, from inventory availability and product listings to promotions and new product launches.

A significant part of this role involves problem-solving. Amazon is a constantly evolving platform, and you will regularly encounter situations that require you to investigate unfamiliar issues, evaluate available information, and find practical solutions. You will work closely with the wider This is Unicorn team, receive training on the agency's processes and ways of working, and participate in regular training and feedback sessions to continuously develop your expertise.


About the Role:

Mission statement:

The primary mission of our Amazon Operations Manager is to ensure that the operational activities of our clients' Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts are managed accurately and effectively, while supporting their business growth through data-driven decisions, consistent execution, and proactive problem-solving.

As our Amazon Operations Manager, this will include monitoring and managing inventory, identifying replenishment priorities, supporting product launches and promotional activities, analyzing sales and operational performance, and providing recommendations that help clients make informed decisions. You will be expected to approach challenges logically, take initiative in finding solutions, improve existing processes, and maintain a high standard of accuracy across your work.


General Responsibilities:

  • Managing and supporting the day-to-day operations of assigned clients' Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts across different marketplaces
  • Setting up, monitoring, and managing inventory to support product availability and meet client requirements
  • Analyzing inventory levels, historical sales, and product performance to identify products that require replenishment or are at risk of running out of stock
  • Identifying products with excess inventory and recommending appropriate actions based on sales performance and available stock
  • Setting up and coordinating shipments to Amazon warehouses, ensuring that inventory-related activities are executed accurately
  • Supporting new product launches by completing the necessary operational setup
  • Uploading and updating product content within Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central
  • Monitoring product and listing performance, investigating potential issues, and identifying opportunities for improvement
  • Interacting with Amazon Support to investigate operational issues, resolve problems, and follow up on outstanding matters
  • Creating and maintaining reports that provide insights into sales performance, inventory levels, and other relevant business metrics
  • Analyzing product performance across different product lines, variations, and categories to identify potential growth opportunities
  • Supporting strategic decisions by identifying which products or product lines should be prioritized based on sales performance, available inventory, and other relevant data
  • Identifying products or activities that may need to be deprioritized and explaining the reasoning behind those recommendations
  • Recognizing limitations in available data and identifying additional information needed to make more accurate operational and business decisions
  • Preparing clear, structured explanations of findings, recommendations, and proposed next steps for clients and internal team members
  • Identifying operational problems, investigating their causes, and developing practical solutions to resolve them
  • Taking initiative to research and resolve unfamiliar Amazon-related challenges, with support from the wider team when required
  • Ensuring that assigned operational tasks and recommended actions are implemented effectively and in line with client objectives
  • Participating in regular training, feedback, and professional development sessions to strengthen Amazon platform knowledge and operational capabilities
  • Continuously developing knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, Vendor Central, and related tools to improve the quality and effectiveness of work
  • Contributing to the overall success of assigned clients by improving operational execution, identifying opportunities, and supporting business growth


Position Specs:

  • Fully remote position
  • Ready to start as soon as possible
  • Start on a probationary period at an hourly rate.
  • Opportunity to transition into a full-time position within the Amazon Operations team with fixed-rate monthly salary following a successful probation period
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the probationary period
  • Regular training, feedback sessions, and professional development opportunities

Requirements

About You:

Profile:

The ideal candidate should have practical experience working with Amazon Seller Central or Vendor Central and a strong interest in Amazon, e-commerce, and digital marketing. You should be comfortable navigating Amazon's operational environment, working with product and inventory information, and using data to make logical decisions that support business performance.You should have a solid analytical mindset and enjoy working with spreadsheets, reports, and numerical data. You should be able to look beyond individual products to understand broader patterns across product lines, categories, and variations.

The Amazon Operations Manager should be a curious and resourceful problem-solver who can approach unfamiliar situations with confidence and determination. You will need to investigate issues, identify potential causes, research possible solutions, and take the necessary actions to resolve them. Since Amazon operations frequently involve unexpected challenges, the ability to learn independently, think critically, and adapt your approach is particularly important.

Experience using Amazon-related tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar platforms is expected. You should also be comfortable working with spreadsheets and using them to organize, interpret, and analyze information.

The right person will be detail-oriented, organized, and process-driven, with a strong sense of accountability for the quality and accuracy of their work. You should enjoy turning ideas and recommendations into practical actions and be able to communicate your reasoning clearly to both clients and internal team members. You should be comfortable working in a remote, collaborative environment and contributing to a growing team. A positive attitude, humility, willingness to receive feedback, and genuine motivation to develop your Amazon expertise are important qualities for this position.

Key Requirements:

  • An understanding of Amazon's operational environment, including inventory management, product setup, shipments, promotions, and content uploads

  • Ability to identify patterns and opportunities across different products, product lines, variations, or categories

  • Strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to independently investigate challenges, evaluate possible solutions, and take practical action
  • Experience communicating with Amazon Support or handling operational issues within Seller Central or Vendor Central
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy when working with product information, inventory figures, and operational tasks
  • Ability to create clear reports and communicate findings, recommendations, and next steps in a logical and understandable manner
  • Ability to take initiative, execute ideas effectively, and follow through on assigned responsibilities
  • Ability to work across different Amazon marketplaces and support the operational needs of multiple client brands
  • Genuine interest in Amazon, e-commerce, and digital marketing, with a willingness to continuously expand your technical knowledge

  • Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills, with a positive, humble, and team-oriented attitude
  • Willingness to receive feedback, participate in training, and continuously improve professional performance
  • Comfortable working remotely and collaborating with a distributed team
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Fluency in additional European languages is a plus
  • A long-term mindset and motivation to grow within the Amazon Operations team
  • Ready to start as soon as possible

Finch is a performance marketing agency. We run digital advertising and SEO for e-commerce and B2B brands. We’re looking for an agency-side Account Manager to be the main strategic contact for a portfolio of our clients, the companies that hire Finch to run their marketing. You’ll lead each relationship and its strategy, and work with our channel specialists (Paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic/DSP, SEO, Creative, Analytics) to deliver on each client’s business goals.

What you’ll do

  • Own the strategy for each client account: goals, KPIs and quarterly roadmaps.
  • Run recurring client meetings, manage stakeholders and document next steps.
  • Read performance against business metrics (ROAS, CPA, CAC vs. LTV, organic growth) and coordinate actions with Finch’s specialists.
  • Find and scope growth opportunities: new channels, tests and budget expansions.
  • Flag retention risks early and build mitigation plans across your portfolio.

Why Finch

  • Work globally, stay flexible: Join a fully distributed team across the US, LATAM, Europe, and APAC.
  • Meaningful impact from day one: Your work directly influences client outcomes and how Finch grows.
  • A culture built on curiosity, transparency, and ownership: We share context and empower people to make decisions.
  • High-caliber teammates: Collaborate with specialists in Paid Search, Paid Social, SEO, DSP, Creative, Analytics, and more.
  • Learning as a default: We encourage experimentation, cross-training, and growth as the company scales.
  • Real work-life balance: We value high performance, not overwork.

Requirements

You’ll be a great match if you have

  • 5+ years as an Account Manager or Account Director at a marketing agency (performance or digital).
  • Experience owning several B2B client accounts at the same time: managing the client relationship, growing the account, and running the project management behind it.
  • Experience as the Account Manager on advertising-driven accounts (Paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic/DSP), coordinating the specialists who run each channel, with a solid grasp of attribution, KPIs and optimization logic.
  • Fluent written and spoken English, and comfort leading strategic conversations with senior client stakeholders.
  • A base in Latin America or Africa (or anywhere up to UTC+2), with availability to work roughly 9am–5pm US Central/Mountain time.

This role is not the right next step if most of your experience is in

  • Customer service or support, or customer success for consumers (B2C) or for a software product, even if the title was “Account Manager” or “Customer Success Manager”.
  • Working at an ad platform or affiliate network, managing advertisers on its behalf.
  • Managing a brand’s own e-commerce store or marketplace channels.
  • In-house marketing for a single company, without an agency client portfolio.
  • Sales or business development, without ongoing account management after the sale.
  • Account management at a branding, PR or creative agency, without performance accounts.

Nice to have

  • Experience with SEO-driven accounts.
  • Experience with US or international clients.

Discover your 100% YOU with MicroSourcing!

Position: QA Tester – Agentic Web Application

Location: Philippines

Work setup & shift: 100% Work From Home | Dayshift (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Manila Time)

Why join MicroSourcing?

You'll have:

  • Competitive Rewards: Enjoy above-market compensation, healthcare coverage on day one, plus one or more dependents, paid time-off with cash conversion, group life insurance, and performance bonuses.
  • A Collaborative Spirit: Contribute to a positive and engaging work environment by participating in company-sponsored events and activities.
  • Work-Life Harmony: Enjoy the balance between work and life that suits you with flexible work arrangements.
  • Career Growth: Take advantage of opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement.
  • Inclusive Teamwork: Be part of a team that celebrates diversity and fosters an inclusive culture.

Your Role:

As a QA Tester – Agentic Web Application, you will own hands-on functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing for a healthcare web application that integrates AI agents, APIs, databases, background workers, and external systems. You will help ensure application quality, identify defects before they reach customers, and provide reliable test coverage while the US engineering team is offline.

  • Execute Test Plans: Create and maintain practical test plans, test cases, and regression checklists for new features, bug fixes, integrations, and production releases.
  • Validate End-to-End Workflows: Test application functionality across browser interfaces, APIs, databases, webhooks, background workers, queues, and third-party integrations.
  • Test AI and Voice Agents: Interact with voice-based AI agents through phone calls and evaluate their responses, tool usage, workflow execution, error handling, and ability to follow instructions across realistic scenarios.
  • Develop Automated Tests: Create and maintain repeatable QA scripts and automated tests using Playwright, pytest, API testing tools, or comparable technologies, leveraging AI tools to improve testing efficiency and coverage.
  • Investigate and Document Defects: Use browser developer tools, application logs, network requests, screenshots, and database records to identify root causes and produce clear, actionable bug reports.
  • Validate Data Integrity and Integrations: Verify that patient and practice configurations, call records, appointments, transcripts, and job statuses remain consistent across connected systems.
  • Test Edge Cases and Failure Scenarios: Evaluate authentication, permissions, duplicate requests, retries, timeouts, delayed webhooks, provider outages, and partial workflow failures.
  • Maintain QA Documentation: Establish a practical testing framework, such as a daily test tracker with pass/fail indicators, and submit a written summary of testing results, outstanding defects, and risks before signing off.

What You Need:

Non-negotiables

  • Prior professional experience in QA testing for production web applications, with strong functional, exploratory, and regression testing skills. This role requires an experienced QA professional who can work independently without junior-level training.
  • Hands-on experience with test automation and writing QA testing scripts using Playwright, pytest, or comparable tools.
  • Strong browser testing skills, including the ability to use browser developer tools to inspect network requests, API responses, errors, and application behavior.
  • Excellent written communication skills and the ability to produce clear, concise, reproducible bug reports with expected versus actual results, supporting evidence, and severity.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Codex, Claude Code, or Cursor to generate test cases, develop scripts, analyze logs, and support defect investigation.
  • Near-conversational US English proficiency with clear, understandable speech to communicate effectively with voice-based AI agents through phone calls.
  • Ability to reason across user interfaces, APIs, databases, and asynchronous processes rather than relying solely on visible browser behavior.
  • Strong attention to detail, data integrity, privacy, permissions, and security in a healthcare-oriented application.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote setup and provide consistent QA coverage during the US engineering team's off-hours.

Preferred skills/expertise

  • Hands-on experience testing AI-driven applications, LLMs, conversational AI, voice agents, or tool-calling systems.
  • Experience testing asynchronous workflows, message queues, background workers, webhooks, scheduled jobs, retries, and event-driven systems.
  • SQL proficiency for validating application data and database states.
  • Familiarity with Python, Flask, HTTP/REST APIs, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, Redis, and automated testing frameworks.
  • Experience with AWS services and CloudWatch logs, Docker, GitHub Actions, or similar deployment and monitoring tools.
  • Exposure to healthcare technology, electronic health records (EHR), FHIR integrations, or other security- and privacy-sensitive applications.
  • Experience with third-party integrations involving telephony, identity providers, CRM platforms, external APIs, and browser automation.
  • Ability to troubleshoot flaky automated tests, improve regression coverage, and develop reusable test scenarios with AI-assisted workflows.

About MicroSourcing

With over 9,000 professionals across 13 delivery centers, MicroSourcing is the pioneer and largest offshore provider of managed services in the Philippines.

Our commitment to 100% YOU

MicroSourcing firmly believes that our company's strength lies in our people's diversity and talent. We are proud to foster an inclusive culture that embraces individuals of all races, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and backgrounds. We provide space for everyone, embracing different perspectives, and making room for opportunities for each individual to thrive.

At MicroSourcing, equality is not merely a slogan – it's our commitment. Our way of life. Here, we don't just accept your unique authentic self – we celebrate it, valuing every individual's contribution to our collective success and growth. Join us in celebrating YOU and your 100%!

For more information, visit

Inside Sales Representative (Part Time Internship, Remote)

Storage Scholars is a high-growth company that’s undergone 100% year-over-year growth since its inception in 2017. Our goal is to change the way college students across the country move in and out of residence halls with our all-inclusive moving, storage and shipping service. Storage Scholars is fast-moving, tenacious, innovative, and core-product-focused. We strive to be the premium option among the competition by offering the best user experience available, which is dependent on continuously improving our technology. We expect passion and buy-in from every team member, no matter the role. We believe everyone, regardless of their position, brings unique knowledge, skills, and perspective that makes us who we are. All voices are not just welcomed but encouraged to be a part of the decisions and direction of the organization. At Storage Scholars, egos are left at the door, wins are celebrated as a team, and learning never stops.

As an Inside Sales Representative (Part Time Internship) at Storage Scholars, your primary responsibility is being a consultative guide for customers seeking solutions for student move-in, move-out, storage, and shipping. As a member of the greater Customer Experience Team, you will be a crucial link between the customer and their understanding and adoption of the services that we offer.

What you’ll do:

  • Field inbound leads from both lead form submissions and inbound calls.
  • Make proactive phone calls to existing and former customers to promote service usage.
  • Provide service estimates for customers via call, SMS, and email.
  • Guide customers through their order flow in our online portal to book their moves.
  • Promote additional services and service upgrades to customers, as well as generate referrals.

Required:

  • Exceptional communication with strong sales aptitude.
  • Strong critical thinking skills.
  • Ability to handle fast-paced changes and intense workloads.
  • Strong phone presence.
  • High emotional intelligence to understand fellow team members and clients alike.
  • Technologically savvy, with the ability to learn new software rapidly.

Preferred:

  • 1–2 years of customer-facing experience (such as retail, hospitality, or customer service).

Scope:

  • Part time, seasonal role: 15–25 hours/week on average, up to 40 hours/week during March - May.
  • The ability to work a flexible schedule on evenings and weekends as necessary during our peak season (March - September).
  • Preferred Start Date: 1/25/27
  • Tentative End Date: 8/1/27

Compensation:

  • Estimated seasonal earnings: $4,500 – $10,000+
  • Base pay plus per-customer commission. Earnings depend on hours worked (15–25 hrs/week) and monthly sales performance.

Other Benefits:

  • Fully Remote
  • Ability to grow with our rapidly growing company and team.

Location:

  • Remote

How Our Core Service Works:

Customers sign up on our web portal to schedule services on their respective campuses. Packing supply kits are shipped out to students as requested. The student packs their items, uploads a few photos to our portal, selects their desired insurance, locks it in their room, and can leave at will. Thanks to our partnership with the university, our staff comes in once the campus is vacant and moves all of the student belongings into a storage facility for the summer. The best part is that the items will be ready and waiting in the customer’s new housing assignment whenever they return.

Storage Scholars is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Media buying has changed.

In 2026, a great media buyer is not just a button pusher. They understand the full system: creative, offer, conversion rate, platform dynamics, competition, and what to test next.

At Sweat Pants Agency, we are hiring a performance media buyer who can drive growth across Meta ads for DTC and ecommerce brands.

This role is for someone who can run paid media and also think like a marketer.

You will build testing roadmaps, guide creative strategy, communicate with clients, and help us scale what works.

If you've built or scaled your own eCommerce brand, we want to hear from you.

If you love following SOPs and repeating the same campaign structure forever, this is not the job.

If you love thinking, testing, and building frameworks that win, keep reading.

We're growing fast and we keep the bar high.

We believe the best media buyer today is a sharp marketer who uses AI every day. We built an internal creative analysis tool that connects to Claude, and we use Pipeboard to read and write to ad accounts and run heavy analysis. You don't need to know our stack yet. You do need to actually use AI in your work, not be afraid of it, and teach yourself what you don't know.

Requirements

What You'll Do

  • Own paid media strategy for DTC/eCommerce clients on Meta
  • Build creative testing roadmaps: develop angles, write briefs for editors, analyze what's working
  • Manage ad budgets ranging from $30k / mo to $1m / mo per client
  • Diagnose the full funnel: spot whether issues are creative, offer, or conversion
  • Communicate clearly with clients: present results, plans, and next steps
  • Work with UGC creators: source talent, write scripts, direct content when needed

You're A Great Fit If...

You have hands-on experience scaling eCommerce brands:

  • You've managed Meta Ads with real spend and can show results (CPA, ROAS, revenue)
  • Bonus: You've built/operated your own Shopify store or eComm brand

You understand creative is the lever:

  • You can pull insights from reviews, competitor ads, and comments to generate new angles
  • You've written UGC scripts or creative briefs
  • You can work with editors to create winning ad variations
  • Video editing or design skills are a plus

You're a strategist, not a robot:

  • You challenge assumptions and adapt fast
  • You don't blindly follow "best practices"
  • You can explain what you're doing and why
  • You use AI tools daily and teach yourself new ones

You have ownership and urgency:

  • You act like it's your money
  • You move fast and follow through
  • You don't wait to be told what to do

Benefits

Why This Role Is Exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You will be surrounded by people who move fast, care a lot, and take the work seriously.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

raw.excerpt: About Life360Life360's mission is to keep people close to the ones they love.
raw.description:
About Life360

Life360's mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.

Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

Life360 Ads is our advertising business. We help advertisers reach relevant audiences across screens, informed by our direct, ongoing relationship with Life360 members. Ads Marketing makes that value clear. We are product marketers, creatives, content and brand people, and event builders, and we work side by side with sellers every day. We say what we think, we move fast, and we judge ourselves by whether our work brings advertisers into the conversation. If you like building from the ground up and seeing your work show up in real deals, you'll fit right in.

About the Job

Advertisers get pitched all day. The Sr. Demand Generation Associate builds the system that makes Life360 Ads easy to find, easy to trust, and easy to talk to. You own the path from a first search or click to a sales conversation: website and landing-page operations, search, lead capture and routing, and email and LinkedIn campaign delivery. You'll partner with the Content Manager, who owns the message and editorial calendar, and with sellers, who follow up with buyers and tell you what is working.

Here is the honest starting point. We have HubSpot, but today it mostly runs website forms. We don't yet have a consistent lead process or clear handoff to sellers. You will build this in stages with the Senior Director, Sales, and Sales Operations. First, make forms, seller handoff, event follow-up, essential website updates, and basic reporting reliable. Next, launch focused account campaigns, email follow-up, and selected paid campaigns. Add more advanced scoring, search improvements, and testing as the basics work and buyer activity supports them. You'll report to the Senior Director of Ads Marketing. The Senior Director and events team handle paid media relationships and negotiations with industry partners; you support campaign tracking and buyer follow-up.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $102k - 152k USD. We take into consideration an individual's background and experience in determining final salary - therefore, base pay offered may vary considerably depending on geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes a wide range of medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits[, as well as equity: confirm with HR].

What You'll Do

  • Build our first lead process with Sales: agree on lead stages, buyer fit, a qualified opportunity, follow-up timing, and routing. Start with simple rules and clear next steps; introduce more advanced scoring when useful data is available.
  • Own Marketing's use of HubSpot and the lead handoff into Salesforce. Partner with Sales Operations and system administrators on integration, permissions, account ownership, data quality, and reporting. Coordinate changes with the teams that control the systems.
  • Own Life360 Ads website and landing-page operations. Build and improve pages within the available tools, partnering with life360.com owners, developers, and agencies for technical work. Content owns the words and Design owns the visual assets; you own forms, testing, tracking, and conversion.
  • Lead search-engine optimization (SEO) for Life360 Ads. Prioritize keyword strategy, useful page structure, and on-page improvements, and brief developers on technical fixes and structured data. Sequence the work against buyer needs and available support.
  • Improve visibility in AI search: work with Content on clear, accurate pages that answer advertiser questions, coordinate technical improvements, and track observable citations and referrals. Use what we learn to improve; placement in AI answers is not guaranteed.
  • Plan, run, and improve selected paid search and LinkedIn lead-generation campaigns, with priorities and spending agreed with the Senior Director. Establish reliable tracking and Sales follow-up before expanding.
  • Own email and LinkedIn campaign operations: audiences, lists, sends, forms, ad accounts, testing, and reporting. The Content Manager owns the message and editorial calendar. Agree on campaign goals and timing together.
  • Build useful campaign pages and forms, using gated content where it serves a clear purpose. Make sure event and website inquiries reach the right seller and receive timely follow-up.
  • Support account-based campaigns aimed at named brands and agencies.
  • Set up tracking and practical dashboards with Sales Operations. Check lead capture and follow-up weekly; report monthly on lead quality, sales conversations, qualified opportunities, and campaign spending. Use cost per lead as one measure, not the main definition of success. Explain the results and recommend what to improve.
  • Test pages, offers, and campaigns. Do more of what works and stop what doesn't.
  • Meet with sellers regularly to hear what is working and fix what is not.
  • Work with Content, Product Marketing, Design, Events, and PR on a shared campaign schedule. Partner with life360.com owners, developers, and Sales Operations on technical delivery. Make support needs and dependencies clear before committing to timelines.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in B2B demand gen, marketing operations, or digital marketing, with a track record of measurable lead and pipeline growth.
  • Builder's track record: you have set up lead scoring, routing, and nurture programs in HubSpot yourself, and you can show us.
  • Hands-on HubSpot and Salesforce skills, including how data moves between them.
  • Website ownership: you have managed a website and built landing pages, and you know how to brief and check the work of developers and agencies.
  • SEO foundation: keyword strategy, on-page and technical SEO, site structure, and structured data, with results you can show.
  • AI search know-how: you understand how AI tools find and cite content, and you have shaped content to improve visibility in them.
  • Paid search and LinkedIn Campaign Manager experience, with results you can show.
  • AI-native operator: you use AI tools in your daily work (research, analysis, reporting, building) and can guide them to produce work that fits the brand.
  • Data-driven decision maker who can build dashboards, spot problems early, and explain what the numbers mean for the business.
  • Proficiency with HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and an SEO tool such as Ahrefs or Semrush (or equivalent).
  • Strong cross-functional partner who works well with Sales, Content, Creative, Events, and PR, and can influence priorities without direct authority.
  • Clear, confident communicator who explains technical things in plain words to sellers and non-technical teammates.
  • Experience marketing to advertisers or in media, and account-based marketing experience, are strong pluses.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for employees)
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns
  • Learning & Development programs
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers

Life360 Values

Our company's mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference.

  • Be a Good Person: We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect: We communicate directly, even when it's hard.
  • Members Before Metrics: We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High Intensity, High Impact: We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful. Even if you don't meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!

Are you a cloud engineer who runs production SaaS on Azure and AWS and owns it end-to-end, from the Terraform code to the RCA?

CXT Software provides the technology backbone for delivery processes, empowering courier, route delivery, and healthcare companies to maximize operational potential. Our customers run their daily delivery operations on our platform, so uptime is what they buy from us.

We are looking for a SaaSOps Engineer to own a production SaaS platform across several product lines and two clouds, Azure first and AWS second. You will write the infrastructure code, build the pipelines, run the Windows and SQL Server estate, own the alerts, and lead the response when something breaks, from provisioning a customer environment to writing the RCA after an incident. You will work daily with Engineering, Support, and Security, in Terraform, GitHub Actions, Grafana Cloud, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, CloudWatch, incident.io, Jira, and Confluence. Reporting to the Director of SaaSOps, you will shape how the platform is built, changed, and monitored.

If you want whole-platform ownership, hold a high bar on every change, and are ready to carry on-call for the systems you run, we would love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Build and change Azure and AWS infrastructure in Terraform.
  • Build and maintain GitHub Actions pipelines for application and infrastructure deployments.
  • Provision, upgrade, and tear down customer environments.
  • Operate Windows Server (Remote Desktop Services, IIS, Active Directory, Group Policy) and SQL Server / Azure SQL: patching, backups, restores, and performance.
  • Automate repeat operational work in PowerShell.
  • Carry on-call: keep alerts paging on customer impact, respond to incidents, fix the cause, and write the RCA.
  • Enforce least-privilege access, collect SOC 2 evidence, and keep runbooks current.

Requirements

  • 5+ years as a cloud engineer running production workloads (compute, managed databases, identity, networking) on Azure or AWS.
  • You have deployed and changed production infrastructure with Terraform through CI/CD pipelines you built or maintained.
  • You write PowerShell automation used in production.
  • You have run SQL Server or Azure SQL in production: backups, restores, and performance troubleshooting.
  • You have carried production on-call and taken incidents from evidence to a single root cause and a written RCA a teammate can act on without follow-up questions.
  • You work 08:00–17:00 ET, Monday to Friday, and join the after-hours on-call rotation.
  • Professional English at C1 level or above, spoken and written.
  • You can be engaged as an independent contractor and can start within one month of an offer and no later than December 31, 2026.

Nice to have

*Production experience on Azure.

  • Windows Server administration in production (Remote Desktop Services, IIS, Active Directory, Group Policy).
  • AZ-104, AZ-305 or AZ-400, or AWS Solutions Architect Associate or SysOps Administrator Associate.
  • Experience preparing SOC 2 audit evidence.
  • Uses AI-assisted coding and operations tools at work.

Benefits

More than just perks, they're the essential components of a rewarding career at CXT Software.

  • 100% Remote and Global: Enjoy the freedom to live your best life from anywhere in the world.
  • Flexible Work Environment: Work at times that suit you best. We prioritize results and customer satisfaction over rigid schedules.
  • Dedicated Growth Path: Receive consistent, meaningful feedback and support tailored to help you achieve your personal career goals.
  • Access to Leading Tools and Technology: Enhance your skills with the latest tools, playbooks, and technology.
  • Engaging Community Activities: Participate in coffee chats, happy hours, cooking classes, book clubs, and more!
CXT Software is an equal opportunity employer. This is a fully remote independent contractor engagement and is not eligible for company-sponsored employee benefit programs. We welcome applications from any country where we can lawfully engage you. If you need an accommodation during the application process, you can request it once you apply.
