title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist
description: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

raw.title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist
raw.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
raw.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

raw.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Observability team builds the platform every Affirm engineer relies on to understand the behavior and performance of our systems. Our platform ingests 200+ TB/day of metrics, logs, and traces from hundreds of services across 80+ Kubernetes clusters, and when a user's checkout fails, our data is how engineers find out why. Over the next year, we’re moving to wide events, with one context-rich event per request, improving the signal-to-noise ratio to make debugging faster. We’re also introducing log sampling and building observability best practices into agentic development and code review, so that AI-assisted code is well instrumented by default.

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be the technical lead for Observability. You’ll spend most of your time hands-on while defining the roadmap, driving cross-functional projects, mentoring a team of six engineers, and partnering closely with infrastructure and product teams.


What You'll Do

· You will own the architecture of Affirm’s telemetry pipeline, balancing reliability, query performance, and cost at 200+ TB/day.
· You will design log sampling strategies that significantly reduce volume and cost without losing the signal engineers need during incidents.
· You will shape how observability fits into agentic development, so that AI coding agents and code review catch instrumentation gaps before code ships.
· You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects.
· You will collaborate across teams in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics to ensure technical sustainability, risks and trade-offs are well understood and managed.
· You will act as a force-multiplier for your team through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes.
· You take ownership of your team’s operations and availability by ensuring you have the right monitoring, triage rotations, playbooks, polcities, testing and alerting in place to support “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
· You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
· You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.


What We Look For

· You have 8+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
· You have an extensive track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, Flink and Kubernetes.
· You have built or operated high-volume telemetry systems (metrics, logs, and/or traces) using technologies like OpenTelemetry, Kafka, and Terraform.
· You have a well-informed point of view on modern observability practices such as structured and wide events, sampling, cardinality management, and SLOs.
· You have driven adoption of a platform standard across many engineering teams, through both tooling and engagement.
· You have experience delivering major features, system components or deprecating existing functionality in a system through the definition of a technical and execution plan. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
· You thrive in ambiguity, and are comfortable moving from low level language idioms all the way to the architecture of large systems to understand how they work.
· Your growth and impact trajectory demonstrates that you have mastered gathering and iterating on feedback from your engineering and cross-functional peers.
· You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.

Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels.

About Us:

Candescent is a leading provider of digital banking solutions, helping financial institutions transform customer experiences with cutting-edge technology. Our platform enables banks and credit unions to offer seamless, secure, and innovative digital banking services. We are seeking a skilled Pre Sales Consulting Engineer to join our team and play a key role in delivering tailored solutions to our clients.

Role Overview:

As a Pre Sales Consulting Engineer, you will serve as a key technical advisor and product expert, working closely with sales, product, and implementation teams to provide tailored solutions for our digital banking clients. You will engage with financial institutions to understand their business needs, demonstrate product capabilities, and guide them through the solution adoption process.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Act as a trusted advisor to prospective and existing clients, understanding their digital banking needs and challenges.

  • Collaborate with product management and development teams to relay customer feedback and influence future product enhancements.
  • Assist in the implementation process by ensuring the proposed solutions align with client expectations and technical requirements.

In addition, be an advocate within the field to articulate the Platform’s strategic direction and priorities to deliver an outstanding financial institution and end user experience.

raw.description:
What You Can Expect

As Senior Manager, Product FP&A, you serve as the financial backbone of Zoom’s product portfolio, partnering directly with Product General Managers and senior leadership to shape how the company invests and grows. You translate complex financial data into clear strategic direction, operating at the intersection of finance, product, and go-to-market strategy in a high-growth enterprise SaaS environment. This is a role for someone who wants their analysis to land, their recommendations to stick, and their work to visibly move the business forward. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales Operations, Marketing, and Customer Success to optimize revenue performance and support scalable, sustainable growth.


About the Team

The Sales FP&A team sits within Zoom’s broader Finance organization, operating at the intersection of finance, sales, and business strategy. We are a talented, diverse group focused on high-impact work that directly shapes Zoom’s growth trajectory. Our team partners closely with GTM leaders across the business to drive smarter investment decisions and stronger revenue outcomes.


Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end product financial planning, including target-setting, key assumptions, and investment trade-offs for each product in the portfolio
  • Own the revenue forecast and annual budget for assigned products, maintaining accuracy and accountability across all planning cycles
  • Influence portfolio investment decisions by identifying where returns are strongest and providing clear recommendations on where to reallocate
  • Partner with General Managers on monthly business reviews, delivering precise analysis of what changed, why it changed, and what to do next
  • Analyze key growth drivers including churn, pricing, and product mix, converting findings into actionable business recommendations
  • Support pricing and packaging decisions through rigorous financial modeling and scenario analysis
  • Evaluate product investment cases spanning headcount, R&D, and go-to-market spend
  • Prepare materials for executive staff, board, and investor discussions with clear, compelling financial narratives
  • Drive the planning calendar across budget, forecast, and long-range planning cycles
  • Improve forecast accuracy by refining inputs, models, and cross-functional handoffs with Sales Finance and Data Science
  • Coach and develop analysts who support your work

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years in FP&A, corporate finance, or strategic finance within SaaS or subscription businesses, with a demonstrated track record of influencing senior leaders on investment and resource allocation decisions
  • Strong command of subscription metrics including revenue, net revenue retention, churn, bookings, and revenue recognition fundamentals
  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills, with experience in Anaplan, Adaptive, or a comparable enterprise planning tool, and proficiency with SQL and BI tools such as Tableau or Salesforce
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex financial data into clear, compelling narratives for non-finance audiences
  • Experience supporting a product-led or sales-driven organization with complex sales motions
  • Direct, collaborative communication style with the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively alongside senior stakeholders
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; MBA or CPA is a plus


Salary Range or On Target Earnings:

$126,500.00 - $276,700.00

In addition to the base salary and/or OTE listed Zoom has a Total Direct Compensation philosophy that takes into consideration; base salary, bonus and equity value.

Note: Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience.


We also have a location based compensation structure; there may be a different range for candidates in this and other locations

11/13/26

Ways of Working
Our structured hybrid approach is centered around our offices and remote work environments. The work style of each role, Hybrid, Remote, or In-Person is indicated in the job description/posting.


Benefits
As part of our award-winning workplace culture and commitment to delivering happiness, our benefits program offers a variety of perks, benefits, and options to help employees maintain their physical, mental, emotional, and financial health; support work-life balance; and contribute to their community in meaningful ways. Zoomies help people stay connected so they can get more done together. We set out to build the best collaboration platform for the enterprise, and today help people communicate better with products like Zoom Contact Center, Zoom Phone, Zoom Events, Zoom Apps, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom Webinars.
We’re problem-solvers, working at a fast pace to design solutions with our customers and users in mind. Find room to grow with opportunities to stretch your skills and advance your career in a collaborative, growth-focused environment.

raw.description:
​​​​​Role Summary

The Director of Product leads Greenshades' product organization — owning roadmap strategy, delivery execution, and product experience quality across our payroll, HR, and tax compliance solutions. This role carries a specific mandate to reorient product strategy for the AI era: identifying where AI can reshape workflows, unlock new efficiencies, and differentiate the platform. This role manages a team of Product Managers and a Product Experience/UX designer, and partners closely with Engineering, Customer Experience, and Product Marketing to ensure the roadmap reflects real market and customer signal. As part of an integrated Product and Marketing organization, this role is central to tightening the loop between what customers need and what gets built.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Product Managers and the Product Experience/UX function; set clear priorities, coach on craft, and manage performance and growth.
  • Own and maintain a groomed, prioritized product roadmap that reflects the highest-value initiatives across Greenshades' product lines, grounded in customer and market signal.
  • Drive Greenshades' product strategy into the AI era — evaluating where AI/ML can create step-change efficiency and experience improvements across the product line, and ensuring roadmap prioritization reflects that lens going forward rather than treating AI as a bolt-on feature.
  • Own Product Experience: ensure usability, design consistency, and overall product quality are considered alongside feature delivery, not treated as an afterthought.
  • Drive day-to-day product delivery in close partnership with Engineering, ensuring features ship on time, within scope, and aligned with roadmap priorities.
  • Partner with Customer Experience to strengthen how customer and market signal flows into intake, triage, and prioritization — bringing structure and clarity to how requests become roadmap decisions.
  • Serve as a key product escalation point for significant customer and internal issues, working with Support, TPE, and Engineering to resolve or route issues appropriately.
  • Partner with Product Marketing to ensure roadmap priorities, positioning, and launch timing are aligned and well-sequenced.
  • Build and maintain deep working knowledge of payroll, HR, and tax business processes, including how AI is reshaping those domains, through customer research, competitive analysis, and ongoing industry engagement.
  • Partner with the CMO on Product team budget, resourcing, and prioritization tradeoffs; report on progress against roadmap and team capacity.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Requirements

  • 5-7 years of product management experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise software, including 5+ years leading a team of Product Managers or equivalent ICs.
  • Experience managing a complex domain (payroll, HR, tax, compliance, or similar), or a track record of quickly mastering a new business domain, with a specific example you can describe.
  • Have shipped AI or ML-enabled capabilities in a B2B product, or led a roadmap shift toward AI.
  • Experience hiring, coaching, and developing product talent, including managing performance and supporting career growth.
  • Experience balancing roadmap strategy with hands-on delivery, including keeping features on schedule and in scope alongside Engineering.
  • Experience working day to day with Engineering, Customer Success/CX, and Marketing to align product decisions with business priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including explaining product strategy and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience presenting product strategy, roadmap progress, and resourcing tradeoffs to executive leadership, with the judgment to tailor depth and framing for an ELT audience.

Travel Required: Up to 15%

Location: This is a remote position.

raw.description:
The Claims Director (an individual contributor, not a people leader) manages all components of claim handling for general liability claims, with a concentration on Construction, Crane, Mining and E&S specialty lines of business. The role reviews and provides direction on reserve and settlement authority, where required, for complex, specialized claims, and/or high exposure claims. The Claims Director supports business partners through communication about specific claims, identification of claim trends, input on development, and marketing support. The role monitors claim quality and customer feedback to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, customer satisfaction, and achievement of corporate objectives. The Claims Director independently operates within broad company guidelines and authority levels in the settlement of claims makes appropriate decisions on coverage and resolution of claims.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

  • Ensure execution of proper claim handling strategies, including appropriate determinations of coverage, liability, and claim resolution.
  • Ensure proper reserving in compliance with corporate policy.
  • Manage litigation on claims in litigation, including strategizing with defense counsel and experts on defending such.
  • Analyze coverage and prepare coverage letters on complex matters with the guidance from coverage counsel, if warranted.
  • Negotiate settlements and attend mediations, arbitrations, and trials, if appropriate.
  • Prepare the required Large Loss Reports, Reinsurance and Trial Alerts.
  • Manage and control Loss Adjusting Expenses incurred by counsel, experts, vendors, claims/cases in litigation, as well as declaratory judgment actions.
  • Contribute to the review and analysis of claim reports to identify and address trends. Assist with the development and implementation of strategies to correct adverse trends.
  • Maintain a strong professional knowledge of competitive, regulatory, and legal environments and apply this information effectively. Consults with other staff and participate in related projects.
  • Anticipate and meet customer needs (internal and external), as needed.
  • Prepare for and attend claim review meetings with business partners within specialized business units.

Qualifications, Education and Experience Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • Insurance Designation and/or MBA desired.
  • Minimum of 15 years of commercial general liability, excess and specialty lines claims experience or related insurance education.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Must possess high level skills and extensive claims technical knowledge including products and industry.
  • Extensive knowledge of legal principles, and contract interpretation.
  • Must possess expert analytical, decision making, negotiation, problem-solving, project management, organizational, and teamwork skills.
  • Must demonstrate superior written and oral communication skills and the ability to communicate with all levels of the organization.
  • Demonstrated strategic thinking capabilities.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with computer software including Microsoft 365 Products and other claims tracking tools.

Compensation & Benefits

The applicable base salary for this opportunity is $140,000 - $160,000. The base pay offered will be determined by factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, education, and any applicable minimum wage requirements. In addition to the base salary, this opportunity may be eligible for performance-based incentives.​ We are excited to offer a competitive total rewards package which includes health and welfare benefits, tuition and professional certification assistance, 401k savings, elective participation in the Employee Stock Purchase Program, paid time off, paid holidays, and child bonding leave, as well as other employee assistance.

Role: Sr Manager/ AD- Product Management, Bangalore
Experience: 6+ years
Salary: 20- 28 LPA

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced product leader to drive the strategy and development of technology-enabled learning products. The role will focus on understanding user needs, shaping product experiences, defining roadmaps and validating innovations through research and data. Working closely with cross-functional teams, the individual will translate insights into scalable, user-centric products that improve learning experiences and outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Strategy, Discovery & Problem Framing

  • Lead product discovery and problem definition, drawing on user research, programme insights and field realities.
  • Identify user needs, pain points, constraints and opportunities across learners, educators and other stakeholders.
  • Conduct user interviews, stakeholder consultations and field immersions to validate problem statements.
  • Translate qualitative and quantitative insights into clear product opportunities and solution directions.
  • Ensure product strategy is aligned with organisational priorities, user needs and intended learning outcomes.

2. Product Experience & Journey Ownership

  • Own end-to-end user journeys, from exploration and decision-making to learning and career transitions.
  • Define experience principles, product flows and interaction requirements across digital platforms and supporting touchpoints.
  • Work closely with UX and Learning Experience Design teams to create intuitive, engaging and accessible experiences.
  • Identify friction points affecting user engagement, retention, completion and learning outcomes.
  • Champion learner- and educator-centric design, particularly for users in low-resource and diverse learning environments.

3. Product Definition & Execution

  • Translate product opportunities into clear product requirements, PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Define feature scope, expected outcomes, dependencies and success measures.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Design teams to assess feasibility and ensure effective product delivery.
  • Guide teams through product trade-offs while maintaining focus on user value and strategic priorities.
  • Ensure alignment between product requirements, content experiences, technology and programme implementation.

4. Product Roadmap & Prioritisation

  • Develop and manage the product roadmap in alignment with strategic objectives and user needs.
  • Prioritise initiatives based on user value, learning outcomes, organisational priorities and evidence from research and experimentation.
  • Balance immediate product improvements with long-term product vision and scalability.
  • Continuously review and refine priorities based on user behaviour, performance data and emerging insights.
  • Build stakeholder alignment around product direction, timelines, priorities and trade-offs.

5. Product Analytics, Experimentation & Validation

  • Partner with Analytics and Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) teams to define product success metrics, behavioural indicators and learning outcomes.
  • Drive data-informed product decisions through user behaviour analysis, feedback and performance insights.
  • Design and oversee A/B testing, usability studies, pilots and other product experiments.
  • Establish hypotheses, validation criteria and measurement frameworks for new features and initiatives.
  • Interpret experiment findings and translate them into actionable product recommendations.
  • Identify whether challenges are related to product design, content quality or implementation, and use evidence to determine appropriate interventions.

6. Innovation & Product Governance

  • Lead product-related contributions to innovation frameworks, validation processes and stage-gate reviews.
  • Define MVP assumptions, learning questions and validation criteria for new product opportunities.
  • Work with Programme, Product Operations, Analytics and Knowledge Management teams to assess and validate innovations.
  • Use evidence from pilots and experiments to determine whether initiatives should be scaled, refined, redesigned or discontinued.
  • Contribute to portfolio reviews, innovation assessments and strategic product decisions.
  • Ensure that product innovations are supported by clear adoption, engagement, learning and impact measures.

7. Experience Quality & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish and maintain standards for usability, accessibility, consistency and overall product experience.
  • Monitor product health indicators and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Work with Design, Engineering and Learning Experience Design teams to improve product quality and user satisfaction.
  • Ensure product experiences remain simple, relevant and effective across different user groups and operating contexts.

8. Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Provide strategic direction and functional leadership across product experience initiatives.
  • Build strong working relationships with cross-functional teams, senior stakeholders and external partners.
  • Facilitate collaboration between Product, Design, Engineering, Analytics and Programme teams.
  • Drive clarity, accountability and alignment in complex and evolving product environments.
  • Mentor team members and contribute to building a culture of user-centricity, experimentation and evidence-based decision-making.

Required Experience & Skills:

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in product management or product development, preferably within learning applications, EdTech or digital learning platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience in product discovery, product strategy, UX-driven development and end-to-end product ownership.
  • Strong understanding of user research methodologies, journey mapping, problem framing and experience design.
  • Experience designing, conducting and interpreting A/B tests, usability studies, pilots and product validation experiments.
  • Proven ability to take products, features or innovations from concept through validation, iteration and scale.
  • Experience developing product roadmaps, defining requirements, writing PRDs and prioritising product initiatives.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use behavioural, engagement and learning data to inform product decisions.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams across Design, Learning Experience Design, Analytics, Engineering and Programme functions.
  • Ability to distinguish between product, content and implementation challenges through research and evidence.
  • Familiarity with MVP development, innovation frameworks, experimentation methodologies and stage-gate processes.
  • Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities and drive outcomes in dynamic environments.
  • Prior experience in education, skilling, employability, youth development or social impact is preferred.

Certified as a Great Place to Work®, with 100% of employees saying they love working here, Rise8 is where bold ideas become real capabilities. Where mission meets meaning. And where fewer bad things happen because of bad software.

About You

  • You’re mission-driven and measure success by impact (lives saved, time returned, missions advanced), not activity.
  • You think big, start small, and scale fast. You treat time as the biggest vulnerability and security as something that enables speed.
  • You lead with kindness and candor: you give honest feedback, take it well, and raise the bar for everyone around you.
  • You’re an owner. You thrive with autonomy, act decisively, and stay steady when things are uncertain.
  • You're building with AI and see it as a force multiplier not a shortcut.

As a Senior Software Engineer at Rise8, you will:

  • Work with clients who may be new to modern software practices such as design thinking, AI-assisted and agentic engineering, continuous-release deployment, backlog management, or even interacting directly with the users they provide software to.
  • Decompose business problems into clear, actionable instructions and specifications for agentic development.
  • Be responsible for learning how your client likes to learn, how they like to receive feedback, and what ubiquitous language they use so you can speak in terms that resonate with them.
  • Learn, teach, and refine your approach constantly to best collaborate towards a new way of thinking about engineering.
  • On enablement engagements, pair with client developers, engineers, and military service members. Accelerate how they develop and deliver user stories that provide business value, technical feasibility, and user-driven functionality.
  • Ensure that development is delivered week over week and continuously gauge feedback from real users in real time.
  • Work with a balanced team in mind while building software that fits the user needs, business objectives, and stakeholder vision so the team can quickly make informed engineering decisions based on validated assumptions.
  • Plan for and build delivery and user metrics into the software systems you create, so the team can measure real outcomes.
  • Lead within your Rise8 product team by tracking and managing tech debt, facilitating engineering discussions, and leveling up less experienced engineers.

Qualifications

  • Must have an active DoD security clearance.
  • Must have working proficiency to advanced Palantir Foundry / Warp Core experience
  • 6-10 years of Software Development experience in a variety of programming languages.
  • Strong communication skills and interest in a pair-programming environment.
  • Experience leveraging AI in software development.
  • Experience with Test Driven Development (TDD) and agile methodologies, including using AI tools to write and maintain tests.
  • You have a strong understanding of algorithms, programming language theory, software architecture, networks, databases, and design patterns, and understand how to apply them.
  • Experience with both frontend and backend.
  • Experience using container technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with DevSecOps tools and processes such as Git, Ansible, GitLabCI, SonarQube, Fortify, and ThreadFix.
  • Demonstrated experience with API Development.
  • You are comfortable running your software in Linux environments.
  • You have strong facilitation skills.
  • BA/BS in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in training, mentoring and/or up-skilling engineers.
  • Experience developing cloud-native applications.
  • Experience leading a product or development team.
  • Experience building and deploying in a continuous delivery environment.
  • Experience working directly with clients.
  • Experience with DoD, especially at a DoD "Software Factory".
  • Preferred, not a requirement: located within a commutable distance into Colorado Springs, CO or El Segundo, CA

Travel

Position may require up to 25% travel in support of contract performance, customer site visits, and program activities.

Salary

The annual salary range for this role as it is posted is $143,824 to $179,780 regardless of final candidate location within the United States. The final job level and annual salary will be determined based on the education, qualification, knowledge, skills, ability, and experience of the final candidate(s), and calibrated against relevant market data and internal team equity.

Benefits

  • Flexible schedule in a 100% distributed workforce
  • Premium Insurance: We cover up to 100% of the employee premium and up to 80% of the combined dependent premium on our base health plan depending on pay band. We also cover 100% of the premium for employee and dependent Dental and Vision as well as employee premiums for Life and Disability coverage.
  • Retirement: 401k match at 10% gross pay.
  • Paid time off (PTO): 4 weeks combined accrued vacation and sick leave, 11 Federal holidays, your birthday, jury duty, and bereavement.
  • Education & Training: Accrued budget of up to $4,000 per year for classes, travel, events, and materials.
  • Wellness Budget: To encourage and support a well-rounded healthy lifestyle, we cover 50% reimbursement on a variety of wellness activities and products, up to $500 per calendar year.
  • Equipment: We offer a MacBook Pro and multi-port adapter.

All of Rise8’s work in this area is with Federal Government customers that require our employees involved with their projects be U.S. citizens. As such, this role requires U.S. citizenship. If hired, you would also be required to go through a background investigation.

Rise8 is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that will consider you for this role regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, gender identity or expression, national origin, genetics, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Job Title: Business Development Manager

Who We Are

LanguageBird® is an accredited online language school providing personalized language learning experiences to learners around the world. Through one-to-one instruction and partnerships with schools and organizations, we help learners build language skills through meaningful human connection, flexibility, and learning experiences designed around their goals.
As LanguageBird continues to grow, we’re expanding our reach and building partnerships that help more schools and learners experience what LanguageBird has to offer.

Our company core values are Growth Mindset, Relationships, Ownership & Outcomes, Work with Intention & Momentum, Team Energy & Positivity, and Human Connection. They guide how we work, make decisions, and show up for our learners, partners, and one another. We look for team members who embrace these values and bring them to life in their work each day.

About the Role

LanguageBird is seeking a Business Development Manager to develop and grow referral and outbound channels that connect prospective learners and parents/guardians with LanguageBird's personalized language learning programs.

This role is responsible for leading our Independent Educational Consultant (IEC) recognition program and affiliate partner program, building meaningful relationships with advisors and organizations that influence enrollment decisions, and developing outbound opportunities that generate new learner interest and enrollments.

Working closely with the Chief Revenue Officer and cross-functional teams, the Business Development Manager will help expand LanguageBird's reach through strategic partnerships, relationship development, and new market opportunities. This position offers significant ownership of referral programs and the opportunity to shape how these channels grow over time.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and develop LanguageBird's IEC recognition and affiliate partner programs, including program structure, partner engagement, and ongoing improvements
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with IECs, affiliate organizations, and other referral partners through proactive outreach and consistent communication
  • Identify and develop new referral partnerships and affiliate opportunities that align with LanguageBird's target audiences and growth objectives
  • Represent LanguageBird at industry conferences, events, and regional meetings to strengthen relationships and expand referral opportunities
  • Develop and execute personalized outbound outreach strategies targeting prospective learners, previous inquiries, and new audience segments
  • Research and identify new markets, lead sources, and partnership opportunities that support referral and outbound channel growth
  • Manage partner recognition activities, engagement tracking, and referral program reporting
  • Maintain accurate partner, prospect, and pipeline information in HubSpot, including relationship history, activity, and next steps
  • Monitor referral and outbound channel performance, using data and market insights to recommend improvements and guide priorities
  • Work closely with the Chief Revenue Officer and cross-functional teams to support revenue growth and continuously strengthen business development strategies

Required Qualifications

  • Three or more years of experience in business development, channel sales, partnership management, or a closely related role
  • Demonstrated experience building or managing referral, affiliate, or partner programs with measurable outcomes
  • Strong relationship-building and communication skills, particularly with professional audiences such as advisors, counselors, and organizational partners
  • Experience with outbound prospecting and pipeline development using a consultative, research-driven approach
  • Proficiency with HubSpot or a comparable CRM for pipeline and relationship management
  • Ability to represent an organization professionally and credibly at conferences, events, and partner meetings
  • Strong organizational skills, initiative, and accountability, with the ability to work independently and manage competing priorities in a remote environment
  • Must be able to travel by air and motor vehicle to attend conferences, industry events, and partner meetings as required
  • Must reside in and be eligible to work in the United States

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with or marketing to IECs or the broader college counseling community
  • Familiarity with education-related conferences, particularly IECA or HECA, and their guidelines around referral and affiliate relationships
  • Background in education, educational technology, or a premium consumer services brand
  • Experience developing outbound strategies for businesses with longer customer consideration cycles
  • Experience designing or developing tiered partner or referral programs from the ground up

raw.title: Principal Engineer, Agentic AI
raw.excerpt: Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop.
raw.description:
Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry. In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

About the Role

We're growing our world-class engineering team to usher our CRM platform into the next generation of software — and we're looking for a Principal Engineer, Agentic AI to join our Core Platform Team

Most Lead roles at "Big Tech" companies involve maintaining a single microservice or acting as a small cog in a 100-person machine. At Steer, you aren't just a contributor; you are the architectof a platform aiming for 100% market dominance. This is a high-impact role for someone who doesn't just write great code, but who can see around corners, challenge conventions, and lead entire products from vision to launch.

We are actively refactoring our existing teams to be agentic-first — meaning our engineers don't just use AI as a tool, they architect systems around autonomous, AI-driven workflows. This is not a future initiative; it is how we build today.

We’re looking for builders who bring exceptional focus, ownership, and commitment to their work. At Steer, we want engineers who are “all in” on our mission, fully engaged with their work, and invested in our shared success. This means making Steer your primary professional focus and bringing the dedication and accountability needed to deliver exceptional results.

Why Steer?

  • True Ownership: You will lead massive products from start to finish within lean, high-velocity teams.
  • Hyper-Growth & Vision: We are currently at a fraction of our total addressable market in the automotive industry. The potential for scale is massive, and you will be a leading developer shaping this space
  • Freedom to Innovate: You don't need side projects to explore new techniques. We provide the autonomy and the platform to experiment with and implement the latest tech directly into our core product.
  • AI-First & Agentic Culture: We are refactoring our teams to be agentic-first. We prioritize high-level problem-solving and AI/LLM expertise, and we actively encourage the use of AI tools to accelerate coding across any language and to power autonomous production workflows.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Strategy & Ownership: Focus on the core components of the Steer CRM, specifically optimizing how we ingest and process data to revolutionize our automation tools.
  • Architectural Vision: Lead the design of reusable full-stack components and services that ensure our platform remains performant as we scale toward market dominance.
  • Adaptive Development: Pivot at a moment's notice based on evolving business needs, shifting focus between new integrations and core infrastructure to keep our ecosystem seamless.
  • Customer-Centric Engineering: Partner closely with Product to understand user pain points, ensuring every architectural decision adds tangible value to the auto repair shops we serve.
  • Code Excellence: Champion best practices in security, test automation, and maintainability. Conduct deep-dive code reviews that elevate the entire engineering organization.
  • Modern DevOps & Agentic Infrastructure: Influence our CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and IaC practices. Design and maintain AI-integrated, agentic-ready infrastructure that enables autonomous workflows.

What You Have

Must Have:

  • 7+ years of professional experience building complex, web-based SaaS products.
  • The “All-In” Mindset: A deep commitment to Steer’s mission and success. We look for engineers who take exceptional pride in their work, hold themselves to high standards, and demonstrate full ownership and accountability for their projects. They approach complex, seemingly impossible challenges with determination, proactively drive solutions, and are committed to delivering exceptional results in a fast-paced environment.
  • AI & LLM Integration: Hands-on experience working with LLMs and prompt engineering. You use AI to bridge gaps and accelerate development.
  • AI in Production: Proven experience deploying AI-powered features and autonomous (agentic) workflows in production-grade infrastructure.
  • AI-Driven CI/CD: Hands-on experience integrating AI tooling into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., automated code review agents, AI-assisted testing, or agentic workflow orchestration).
  • Database Expertise: Proficiency with both relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis) databases, including schema design and query optimization.
  • Exceptional Communication: The ability to translate complex technical concepts into product outcomes and collaborate effectively with leadership.

Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with our current stack: .NET, Node.js (TypeScript), and React.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Previous experience as a founding engineer or in an early-stage startup environment.
  • Experience building or integrating with Claude marketplace plugins (Anthropic ecosystem), including prompt chaining, tool use, or MCP integrations.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screen — 30 min with Lead Recruiter
  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 60 min with the Head of Engineering & Product
  3. Technical Interview — 60 min with a Principal Engineer
  4. Collaborative Interview — 30 min with Lead Product Manager

What We Offer

  • Equity Options: Own a piece of the company's success.
  • 100% Remote: Work from anywhere in the US.
  • 100% Employer-Paid Medical Insurance.
  • Flexible PTO: With a 15-day minimum.
  • FSA, HSA, and 401k options.
  • Learning Stipend & WFH Equipment: Everything you need for a world-class home office.
  • Innovative Culture: A seat at the table to influence the latest AI technology in a collaborative, agentic-first environment.

Why Join Steer?At Steer, we align our mission of transforming the auto repair experience for shop owners and their customers with your passion for growth, innovation, and excellence.

Here, you’ll find opportunities to expand your skills, take on career-shaping challenges, and contribute to the future of the auto repair industry, all while enjoying comprehensive benefits and flexible work arrangements to support your well-being.

Join Steer to be part of a forward-thinking, flexible, and collaborative culture where you are empowered to do meaningful and impactful work.

We value diversity and believe that forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We welcome applications from those with diverse backgrounds and industries.

Our hiring process looks beyond just credentials. The school you went to at 18 doesn't define your potential to thrive and enrich our culture. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we invite you to apply.

Overview

Interface Engineer (Implementation) - EMR (Electronic Medical Records) supports the delivery of innovative products that allow patients to make life-changing decisions. Myriad Genetics, Inc. is a genetic screening and testing company that provides actionable information to empower people to make critical and timely healthcare decisions. As a technical resource for the Interface Engineering team, the Interface Engineer works on complex technical problems of diverse scope. While focused directly on EMR-related work, they remain aware of broader technical and workflow needs, and how they relate to EMR-based solutions.

Responsibility

    • Manage onboarding and continuing technical support for multiple projects with high levels of complexity to automate receiving electronic orders and sending electronic results.
    • Perform preliminary assessment of new data sources. Assist clients and project managers with estimating our level of effort and refining the project scope to identify requirements and tasks.
    • Lead development, testing and support for networking and interoperability solutions between Myriad and external clinics and providers.
    • Familiarity with core programming concepts and tools, including source control, dev environment management, code merges and deploys.
    • Be technical lead and advocate for best practices and improvements to interface implementations and data transformations.
    • Provide training and ongoing technical support to non-technical teammates.
    • Use effective written and verbal communication to navigate difficult client conversations with a professional demeanor.
    • Create detailed documentation for projects, to allow for a clean hand-off to our support teams.

Qualifications

  1. Bachelor’s degree required.
  2. Expert knowledge in HL7 (V2.x), ability to read specifications for other industry standards like HL7 v3 (C-CDA), FHIR (r4), IHE ITI, or EDI X12 (Claims).
  3. Expert in Mirth, including JavaScript or other common interface engines, and able to lead efforts to administer, setup, maintain and automate interfaces.
  4. Understand network protocols, connectivity types and how to design interoperability solutions securely.
  5. Intermediate level in SQL and must be comfortable writing queries with complex joins, limited to querying and reporting.
  6. Software engineering fundamentals for web based and cloud-based applications.
  7. Ability to investigate and troubleshoot production issues on multiple platforms.
  8. Python and/or software development knowledge is a bonus.
  9. Exposure to Extract, Transform and Load (ETL) concepts and processes.
  10. Active Advanced Mirth Certification preferred.

raw.description:
THE POSITION:

At EVERSANA, our Global Medical Affairs & Medical Information teams play a pivotal role in supporting some of the most scientifically advanced and emerging biopharmaceutical organizations around the world to deliver innovative therapies across all therapeutic areas, including oncology, hematology, rare disease, immunology, neurology, cardiology, etc. Through our fully integrated commercialization and medical support model, we partner with clients across the product lifecycle to deliver meaningful, patient- and healthcare professional-centered solutions.

The Executive Director, Global Medical Affairs is a high-impact senior leader reporting to the EVP, Global Medical Affairs & Information. This individual will play a critical role in shaping and advancing EVERSANA’s position as a forward-looking thought leader and trusted partner in Global Medical Affairs strategy, innovation, and operational excellence / execution across a diverse and growing client portfolio.

This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution, driving the development and delivery of scalable, high-impact, and technology-enabled Medical Affairs solutions that address evolving client needs. The Executive Director will be responsible contributing to overall Global Medical Affairs strategy regarding our services and thought leadership; will lead Global Medical Affairs strategic operations and be responsible for operational efficiency and results driven execution of services; manage, lead and develop the Global Medical Affairs team; and be responsible managing Global Medical Affairs P&L.

We are seeking a highly experienced, high-functioning Medical Affairs leader with a proven ability to drive operational excellence, lead complex transformations, and deliver measurable results through cross-functional teams. This individual will bring broad functional expertise, a strong digital and innovation mindset, and the ability to operate autonomously while influencing and executing through others.

The ideal candidate thrives in a dynamic, matrixed environment and is passionate about building scalable, forward-thinking solutions that enhance Medical Affairs impact and redefine how value is delivered to clients, healthcare professionals, and patients / caregivers.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

Strategic Execution & Program Leadership

  • Lead and support the execution of Global Medical Affairs Excellence & Strategy initiatives across multiple clients and engagements
  • Translate strategic priorities into actionable plans, structured programs, and measurable outcomes
  • Drive enterprise-level and cross-functional initiatives with strong project management rigor and accountability for results
  • Contribute to the evolution of innovative and scalable Medical Affairs operating models

Operational Excellence

  • Drive operational excellence, efficiency, and scalability across Medical Affairs programs and delivery models
  • Identify and implement opportunities to modernize workflows, tools, and processes, including digital and data-driven enhancements
  • Establish and monitor performance metrics to ensure consistent, high-quality execution and continuous improvement
  • Establish and own development and maintenance of applicable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Working Instructions, Training, etc.

Client Management, Leadership & Delivery

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to clients, including Global Medical Affairs leadership
  • A applicable, function as Overseeing Director and / or Client Manager for assigned projects
  • Deliver strategic and operational guidance across the full spectrum of Medical Affairs functions
  • Ensure client delight and that service are both value- and quality-driven

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partners across EVERSANA business units (Medical Information, Value & Evidence, Medical Communications, Agency, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory, Quality, Field Medical, Patient Services, etc.) to deliver integrated, end-to-end solutions
  • Contribute to holistic commercialization and medical strategies spanning the product lifecycle
  • Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, modeling inclusive leadership and behaviors
  • Be able to work within a matrix environment and drive results through others

Thought Leadership

  • Develop and execute thought leadership strategy for Global Medical Affairs
  • Develop the annual plan and collaborate with the team to develop and execute on the deliverables that drive new business opportunities
  • Stay abreast of industry best practices, trends, applicable laws / regulations, etc. that have an impact on Global Medical Affairs and our service offerings
  • Represent EVERSANA and the Medical Affairs team at professional meetings and associations

Financial Performance

  • Support business development through RFPs, proposals, and client presentations, contributing to growth and expansion opportunities
  • Develop and own the Medical Affairs capabilities presentations and technology offerings / demos
  • Ensure the timely review and execution of Global Medical Affairs SOWs and contracts, including follow-up for renewals
  • Develop strategic ways to drive new business opportunities via networking, professional associations, thought leadership
  • Own the P&L for Medical Affairs services, ensuring financial goals are meet and contributing to monthly and quarterly financial planning

Team Leadership / Development

  • Establish, lead, and develop growing Global Medical Affairs team across various services
  • Establish processes, procedures, and training that ensure efficient and effective onboarding of both FTEs and contractor / contingent workers / consultants
  • Build an operationally and cost-efficient global staffing model that ensures effective operational delivery of services based on client requirements and financial goals
  • Establish collaborative relationship with staff agency partners and grow network of independent consultants
  • Identify staffing needs and ensure timely development of applicable job descriptions and job requisitions
  • Ensure results-orientated and results-driven delivery of services via effective management of Global Medical Team, leveraging both FTEs and contractor / contingent workers / consultants as applicable

PEOPLE LEADER

People leaders must possess both the skills to effectively accomplish these tasks and the emotional intelligence to do so in alignment with our cultural values. In addition to the critical management and leadership tasks listed above, this role also includes the following unique responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and scale high-performing teams and subject matter experts, fostering a culture of accountability and innovation
  • Drive results through influence, delegation, and cross-functional leadership
  • Mentor and develop talent, supporting career growth and capability building
  • Establish clear performance expectations and provide ongoing coaching and feedback
  • Oversee talent processes including hiring, performance management, promotions, and development planning
  • Promote a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and high performance

EXPECTATIONS OF THE JOB:

  • Travel Up to 20%
  • Hours 40+ Hours per week

The above list reflects the general details necessary to describe the expectations of the position and shall not be construed as the only expectations that may be assigned for the position.

An individual in this position must be able to successfully perform the expectations listed above.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

  • Education PharmD, MD, or PhD required.
  • Experience and/or Training
    • 8–12+ years of pharmaceutical or life sciences industry experience, including significant experience within a biopharmaceutical organizations or applicable service provider
    • Strong and diverse experience across multiple Medical Affairs functions, including:
      • Medical Strategy & Planning
      • Medical Communications / Publications
      • Medical Information
      • Medical Affairs Operations
      • Advisory Boards, IIS, and lifecycle management
    • Demonstrated success in leading complex initiatives and driving operational excellence and transformation
    • Strong project and program management capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders
    • Proven ability to lead people, influence stakeholders, and deliver results through cross-functional teams
    • Experience working in matrixed, fast-paced environments
    • Strategic and structured thinker who connects vision to execution
    • Operational excellence driver focused on scalability, efficiency, and quality
    • Results-oriented leader with accountability for measurable impact
    • Strong program leader capable of executing complex initiatives effectively
    • People leader with experience developing high-performing teams
    • Collaborative influencer across functions and stakeholder groups
    • Self-directed operator who thrives in autonomous, high-ownership roles
  • Technology/Equipment
    • Experience with Medical Affairs technologies, including:
      • Medical Information platforms
      • Content and publication management systems
      • MSL tools and CRM platforms
      • Digital engagement and analytics tools
    • Experience leveraging advanced analytics, automation, and emerging technologies (including AI) to modernize Medical Affairs delivery and enhance impact

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience and/or Training
    • Consulting or multi-client experience
    • Experience supporting U.S. and/or global product launches
    • Exposure to multiple therapeutic areas and organization types (including emerging biopharma)

PHYSICAL/MENTAL DEMANDS AND WORKING ENVIRONMENT:

The physical and mental requirements along with the work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an individual encounters while performing the essential functions of this position.

Office: While performing the essential functions of this job the employee is frequently required to reach, grasp, stand and/or sit for long periods of time (up to 90% of the shift), walk, talk and hear; occasionally required to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderately quiet, with frequent interruptions and multiple demands.

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Take Action I am empowered and empower others to act now.

Grow Talent I own my development and invest in the development of others.

Win Together I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

Communication Matters I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.

Embrace Diversity I create an environment of awareness and respect.

Always Innovate I am bold and creative in everything I do.

Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.

EVERSANA is committed to providing competitive salaries and benefits for all employees. If this job posting includes a base salary range, it represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position and is not applicable to locations outside of the U.S. Compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, other job-related qualifications/skills, and geographic location (to account for comparative cost of living). This role is eligible for hire in select U.S. locations based on business and operational considerations. For a full list of locations, visit eversana.com/careers. More information about EVERSANA’s benefits package can be found at eversana.com/careers. EVERSANA reserves the right to modify this base salary range and benefits at any time.

From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws, it is the policy of EVERSANA to provide reasonable accommodation when requested by a qualified applicant or candidate with a disability, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship for EVERSANA. The policy regarding requests for reasonable accommodations applies to all aspects of the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the interview and hiring process, please contact us at .

Follow us on LinkedIn | Twitter

At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!

Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Payments International Engineering team builds and operates the systems that enable bank and card payments across Affirm’s international markets. Based in Europe, with teammates across the UK, Spain and Poland, we give customers familiar, local ways to pay, while building shared capabilities that make expansion into each new country easier.

Our work spans improving existing payment experiences and building the foundations for launches in new countries. We solve challenges across currencies and local customer needs, creating reusable solutions that support Affirm’s international ambitions. We work closely with product and engineering teams across Affirm, connecting the customer experience with the financial systems behind it.

We own our work from design through to production, combining the pace of international expansion with the reliability, security and operational readiness that payments demand. Testing, monitoring and supporting our systems are integral to how we build. As a growing team, we also shape the architecture, tools and engineering practices that support this growth.

Joining Payments International means helping build the foundations of a global payments platform, with a direct connection between the systems we create and the customers Affirm can serve.

What you’ll do

  • You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers on your team through ambiguity to solve open-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery.

  • You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.

  • You will proactively identify project, process, technology or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them.

  • You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.

  • You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.

  • You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

What we look for

  • You have 4+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.

  • You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes.

  • You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.

  • You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely.

  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.

  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.

Base Pay Grade - N

Equity Grade - 5


Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.


Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidised medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

GBP base pay range per year: £120,000 - £168,000

Location: Remote UK
Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.
